scheme_name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Direct income support of Rs. 6000 per year to small and marginal farmers with landholding up to 2 hectares, paid in three equal installments.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students

summary: Financial assistance to SC students pursuing post-matriculation courses including professional and technical education.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
summary: Provides loans up to Rs. 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises through three categories: Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme - Widow Pension
summary: Monthly pension support for widows aged 18-59 from BPL families, providing financial security to bereaved women.

scheme_name: Employees State Insurance Scheme (ESIC)

scheme_name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools for ST Students
summary: High quality education to tribal students in remote areas through residential schools with facilities at par with Navodaya Vidyalayas.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension of Rs. 300-500 for persons with severe/multiple disabilities aged 18-79 from BPL households.

scheme_name: Rajasthan Kisan Karj Mafi Yojana
summary: Loan waiver scheme for small and marginal farmers in Rajasthan who have outstanding agricultural loans up to Rs. 2 lakh.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Scholarship for OBC students pursuing post-matriculation education to support academic advancement of backward classes.

scheme_name: Construction Workers Health Insurance Scheme
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: Health insurance coverage for registered building and construction workers and their families, covering hospitalization and accident benefits.

scheme_name: Immediate Relief Assistance (under Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to the families (legal heirs) of missing fishermen in Puducherry. It aims to compensate for the loss of the breadwinner and support the family financially. The assistance is disbursed in two installments.
required_documents: Proof of Age of Missing Fisherman
Declaration of Non-Beneficiary of Old Age Pension Scheme (Missing Fisherman)
Membership Certificate from Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society

scheme_name: AICTE SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME-SFURTI SCHEME
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: The AICTE Short Term Training Programme-SFURTI Scheme provides financial assistance to AICTE-approved institutions for conducting training programs for faculty and students in technical education. These trainings aim to equip participants with skills to develop small-scale businesses and understand project management for rural economic development. Institutions can receive up to ₹4,00,000 in funding for successfully conducting these programs.

scheme_name: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
department: M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides funeral assistance of ₹3,000 and ex-gratia payments for death or permanent disability of unregistered laborers during construction work. It aims to support construction workers in the unorganized sector who are not registered under the Board and lack a valid identity card.

F.I.R. And a copy of Panchnama

Disability certificate obtained from District Medical Board (in case of permanent disability)

Construction workers in the unorganized sector

scheme_name: Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme
summary: The Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme aims to promote products and services of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) by facilitating their participation in government and private tenders. It helps MSEs market their goods/services individually or collectively through consortia, providing support for enlistment and tender participation.
required_documents: Passport size photograph of Proprietor/Partner/Director/Society office bearers
Self-attested copy of G.P. Registration Certificate
Power of Attorney / Board Resolution / Society Resolution (authorizing to deal with NSIC)
Bank attested specimen signature of authorized persons

scheme_name: Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expense
summary: The Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to poor Brahmins in Andhra Pradesh to cover the funeral expenses of a deceased Brahmin. The scheme is implemented by the Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation and covers all 13 districts of the state.
required_documents: White Ration Card/Income Certificate (issued by Mee Seva/Revenue Department)
Income Certificate of the Applicant (issued by Mee Seva/Revenue Department)
Passbook of SB Account in Andhra Bank or SBI (in the name of Applicant)
Self-declaration (the applicant is the legal heir)

scheme_name: Incentive For The Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Tribe Community
summary: This scheme, launched by the Government of Karnataka, offers an incentive of ₹2,00,000/- to married couples where both partners belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community but are from different sub-castes. To qualify, the couple must reside in Karnataka, have a combined annual income below ₹2,00,000/-, and apply within one year of their marriage. The marriage must have taken place on or after April 1, 2018.

scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: State Capital Investment Subsidy
department: Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal
summary: This scheme offers a 20% capital investment subsidy on new age shuttleless powerloom plant and machinery to eligible Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in West Bengal's powerloom sector. It aims to boost production of quality fabrics, create employment, and foster a sustainable ecosystem for MSMEs in the textile industry. The scheme is applicable for enterprises that commenced production between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2024.

scheme_name: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana
summary: The Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana (IMSUPY) is a Rajasthan state scheme designed to empower women entrepreneurs by offering financial assistance and support. It aims to encourage women to establish their own businesses, fostering self-employment and reducing unemployment. The scheme also supports the growth of women-led micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in Rajasthan.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Shramik Aujaar Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Mukhyamantri Shramik Aujaar Sahayata Yojana, launched by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh, provides 10,000 free tool kits annually to registered construction workers. Beneficiaries must be registered with the Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board for a minimum of 90 days to be eligible.

scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Jeevan va Bhavishya Suraksha Yojana
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Nirman Shramik Jeevan va Bhavishya Suraksha Yojana, launched in 2016 by the Government of Rajasthan, provides financial security and social protection to registered construction workers and their families. It offers insurance and pension benefits by integrating with central schemes like Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, and Atal Pension Yojana. The scheme aims to reimburse premiums for these linked central schemes.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students

scheme_name: Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana

It covers fees for special coaching for professional courses like engineering, medical, CA, and MBA for students in class 10th and above.
required_documents: Mark certificate of previous year exam

scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive for Adventure Tour Operators

It offers reimbursement for the purchase of adventure and sports equipment to units that have successfully attracted over 50 international or 100 domestic inbound tourists in a financial year, supported by SGST payments. The scheme aims to promote tourism and entrepreneurship by assisting self-employed youth and generating employment.

It offers an additional incentive to eligible tourism units by covering their contributions towards Employees State Insurance (ESI) and Employees Provident Fund (EPF) schemes. scheme_name: AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme Of Farmers Other Than SC/ST
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat (excluding SC/ST farmers in 208 specific talukas) for purchasing agricultural equipment to enhance farm mechanization. It aims to increase agricultural production efficiency and reduce costs by promoting the use of modern farm machinery. The scheme is 100% state-sponsored.

scheme_name: AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For ST Farmers
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe farmers in Gujarat for purchasing agricultural equipment and inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and plant protection equipment. It aims to increase agricultural production and improve the livelihood of ST farmers by promoting scientific farming practices.
required_documents: Government-approved photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card)
Disability Certificate from Competent Authority (only for disabled, if applicable)

scheme_name: AFFDF-Financial Assistance For Treatment Of Serious Diseases To Non Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)/Widows
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen (all ranks) and their widows for medical expenses related to serious diseases like cancer, renal failure, and heart surgery. The assistance is provided for treatment at approved government hospitals, with a maximum limit of Rs 1,25,000 (one-time) for most diseases and Rs 75,000 per annum for cancer/dialysis.

eligibility_rules.value: non-pensioner ESM, widow of non-pensioner ESM

required_documents: Photocopy of ESM / widow I Card
Original medical bills duly countersigned by attending doctor
Hospital admission and discharge report duly countersigned by hospital authority
A certificate from applicant that he/she has not taken any money/grant from the State Government

scheme_name: AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For SC Farmers
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste farmers in Gujarat for purchasing agricultural equipment to enhance crop production and promote agricultural mechanization. It aims to help farmers achieve higher quality and quantity of farm produce at lower costs by utilizing natural resources effectively through mechanization.

scheme_name: AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance To Purchase Tractors
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for purchasing tractors. It aims to increase farm mechanization and ensure competitive pricing for tractors across the state. The assistance varies based on the tractor's horsepower.

scheme_name: AICTE - Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship
summary: This fellowship utilizes the expertise of highly qualified and experienced superannuated professionals to inspire students and faculty at AICTE-approved institutes. It offers an honorarium for interactions and covers travel expenses, aiming to leverage their contributions to society.

eligibility_rules.value: acknowledged leader in field of specialization

required_documents: 3-5 day schedule to Deliver lectures throughout the year
Bank account details including IFSC code

scheme_name: AGR-61 Agro Service Providers for the Purpose of Making Farming More Profitable With the Help of Farm Mechanization
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: This scheme from the Gujarat government provides financial assistance to Agro Service Providers for farm mechanization. It aims to enhance agricultural productivity and cost-effectiveness for farmers by offering subsidies for establishing Agro Service Provider Units.

eligibility_rules.value: Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS),Farmer Groups,Farmer Producer Companies,Cooperative Institutions,Self-Help Groups (SHGs),Sakhi Mandals
Diploma in Agriculture,Graduate in Agriculture,Postgraduate in Agriculture,Bachelor of Rural Studies (B.R.S.)

required_documents: Registration Certificate (for Farmer Groups, SHGs, PACS, etc.)

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to technical institutions in the North Eastern Region to address infrastructural problems. It supports projects for solving water problems, providing alternative power supply (solar or generators), and high-speed internet connectivity. The goal is to improve the daily learning environment for students in these regions.

eligibility_rules.value: Government/Government-aided technical/engineering colleges/University Departments including Polytechnic Institutes

required_documents: Abstract of the estimates of the project
PWD/CPWD rate certificate of the project
Conformity with AICTE norms and CSR rates of the region

scheme_name: AICTE - YOUTH UNDERTAKING VISIT FOR ACQUIRING KNOWLEDGE (YUVAK): STUDY TOUR OF ATAL TUNNEL, HIMACHAL PRADESH
summary: This scheme provides financial grants to teams of one faculty member and ten students from AICTE-approved institutions for a study tour of the Atal Tunnel in Himachal Pradesh. The objective is to provide firsthand knowledge of advanced tunneling techniques, construction challenges, and to foster research and innovation in engineering education.
required_documents: Details of faculty member going as team leader

scheme_name: AICTE - Research Promotion Scheme (RPS)
summary: The AICTE - Research Promotion Scheme (RPS) promotes research in identified thrust areas of technical education. It provides funding up to ₹25,00,000 for a duration of three years to eligible technical institutions and university departments.

eligibility_rules.value: AICTE approved Technical Institutions/University Departments with relevant PG programs
Full-time regular faculty with research experience and publications

required_documents: Statement of Expenditure on completion of each financial year

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students (SPICES)
summary: This AICTE scheme provides financial support to eligible technical institutions to develop student clubs. The aim is to foster students' interests, creativity, and ethics, promoting their well-rounded development. These clubs are intended to serve as models for other institutional clubs.
required_documents: Photographs showing various activities during club events
Feedback from members of the club

scheme_name: AICTE – Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
summary: This scheme is a collaborative research internship program between AICTE (India) and MITACS (Canada) for STEM students. It offers a 12-week research internship in Canada, with AICTE and MITACS jointly funding the program to cover various expenses including airfare, visa, accommodation, and a stipend.
required_documents: Official yearly transcripts for all years in university
One (1) reference letter from a post-secondary academic supervisor or researcher
Any other document(s) mentioned in MITACS GRI Portal

scheme_name: AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS)
summary: The AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS) provides subscriptions to various e-resources like Web of Science, Scopus, ASME, ASCE, and Bentham Science to eligible technical institutions. Its objective is to enhance access to e-resources for students, faculty, and researchers, thereby fostering a research culture and improving the quality of technical education.
required_documents: AICTE's Approval Letter for current year
National Basketball Association (NBA) Accredited Approval Letter
Details of number of publications in last three years
Technical Education Quality Improvement Programme (TEQIP) Documents
Details of consultancy project completed in last three years
Details of research project completed in last three years

scheme_name: AICTE- TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY JOINT TRAINING PROGRAMS FOR TEACHERS
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to technical universities to conduct six-day residential training programs for faculty members. The goal is to enhance teaching-learning methodologies and prepare educators for success in their profession. AICTE and the university equally share the program's expenditure.

eligibility_rules.value: AICTE approved institutions affiliated with the partner university

required_documents: List of resource persons invited with full address, contact details, topics etc.
List of participants attended the training program
Copy of question paper and mark sheet for the test conducted at the end of program

scheme_name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to specially-abled students pursuing technical education at the diploma level in AICTE-approved institutions. Beneficiaries receive ₹50,000 per annum for college fees, computer, stationery, books, and other educational expenses. The scholarship aims to encourage and support their academic and career development.

eligibility_rules.value: First year of Diploma level course OR Second year of Diploma level course through lateral entry in AICTE-approved institutions

required_documents: HSC/12th certificate (In case of Degree level) & mark sheet
ITI certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Diploma level) & mark sheet
Diploma certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Degree level) & mark sheet

scheme_name: AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Librarians
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to technical universities for conducting five-day residential training programs for librarians. The goal is to enhance librarians' skills in providing quality user-centered library and information services, thereby supporting teaching, learning, and research in a knowledge society. AICTE and the technical university share the program's expenditure.
required_documents: List of resource persons invited with full address, contact details, topics etc.
List of participants attended the training program
Copy of question paper and mark sheet for the test conducted at the end of program
Minimum five photographs of the program

scheme_name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
summary: The AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to specially-abled students pursuing technical education at AICTE-approved institutions. It offers ₹50,000 per annum for up to four years to cover college fees, study materials, and equipment, aiming to empower them for a successful future.

eligibility_rules.value: admitted to First year of Degree level course OR Second year of Degree level course through lateral entry in AICTE-approved institutions

required_documents: HSC/12th certificate (In case of Degree level) & mark sheet
ITI certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Diploma level) & mark sheet
Diploma certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Degree level) & mark sheet

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Distinguished Visiting Professorship Scheme
summary: This scheme promotes industry-institute interaction by facilitating knowledge dissemination from experienced industry professionals to technical education institutions. It aims to integrate rich industrial experience with academic learning through lectures, project guidance, and curriculum development. The scheme is open to industry experts and retired INAE Fellows.

eligibility_rules.value: graduate degree in engineering or equivalent

required_documents: Copy of AICTE letter of approval
Specialized training in research/ design/ management/projects

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
summary: This scheme by AICTE aims to establish IDEA Labs in approved institutions to foster hands-on learning, creativity, and problem-solving skills among students. It provides financial assistance for setting up these labs, which serve as common facilities for converting ideas into prototypes. The goal is to enhance students' practical application of STEM fundamentals and develop 21st-century skills.
required_documents: Endorsement from the Head of Institute (PDF)

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to AICTE-approved institutions and universities to conduct training programs for technical education faculty. The objective is to update knowledge, improve pedagogical skills, and familiarize teachers with modern engineering practices and technological advancements.

eligibility_rules.value: AICTE approved institutions/University departments imparting technical education
full time regular faculty with adequate experience in teaching and research with publications

Minimum five photographs and Pen drive

scheme_name: AICTE-National Initiative for Training of Technical Teachers (for Inductee Teachers) Scheme
summary: This scheme, launched in 2020, provides a three-phase training program for inductee teachers in AICTE-approved technical institutions. It aims to enhance their pedagogical skills through MOOCs, industrial internships, and mentor-based training, leading to a completion certificate upon successful completion.

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: This scheme provides partial travel assistance and registration fees to Bachelor's and Master's level engineering students from AICTE-approved institutions. It aims to encourage research by supporting students presenting research papers at international scientific events. The grant covers a portion of airfare, registration, and visa fees.

eligibility_rules.value: Pre-final year B.E./B.Tech, Final year B.E./B.Tech, Integrated M.Tech, First year M.E./M.Tech, Second year M.E./M.Tech, MS Research, M.Sc. in Engineering, Dual degree B.Tech and M.Tech, Any degree with minimum 4 years of engineering studies
Yes (for presenting a research paper at an international event abroad)
No (eligible only once during the course of study)

A brief on Expected Outcome from the paper presented

scheme_name: AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD
summary: The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD recognizes efforts by AICTE-approved institutions to promote equality and fairness for women. It encourages stakeholders, especially girl students, to address gender discrimination issues and showcase successful contributions to women's emancipation and empowerment. The scheme aims to raise awareness and improve literacy and digital skills among women.

eligibility_rules.value: AICTE approved technical institution/Deemed to be University
last two years from award announcement

required_documents: Geotagged photograph of the location where the program/ intervention/ activity has been executed (If multiple please combine them in the form of pdf)
Proof such as Appreciation Letter issued by the Government/ Institution/ Any Organization etc (If more than one, please convert into single PDF and upload maximum 5)

scheme_name: AICTE-PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT SCHEME
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to regular faculty of AICTE-approved institutes and AICTE officers to present research papers at international conferences both within India and abroad. It aims to help them interact at an international level and stay updated with global changes in their fields of specialization.

eligibility_rules.value: Full time regular faculty from AICTE approved Institute/AICTE approved University Department, Officers of Assistant Director and above on regular and deputation basis in AICTE

required_documents: Certified attested copy of passport indicating visa/immigration

scheme_name: AICTE-Margdarshan scheme
summary: The AICTE-Margdarshan scheme, launched in 2018, aims to improve the quality of technical education by facilitating accreditation among AICTE-approved institutions. It designates well-established 'Mentor Institutes' (MIs) to guide up to 10 nearby 'Mentee Beneficiary Institutes' (MBIs) in achieving accreditation and enhancing overall quality. MIs receive grant-in-aid for their mentoring activities.

eligibility_rules.value: Centrally Funded Institutes such as IITs/ NITs /IIITS/IISc/ISERs/IIMs

required_documents: Number of MBIs proposed in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Consent of all MBIs proposed in DPR
Programme wise (Diploma/UG/PG) Pre-Qualifiers for each MBI

scheme_name: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
summary: This scheme provides scholarships to faculty members of AICTE-recognized degree-level colleges to pursue doctoral degrees (Ph.D.) at top 500 foreign universities. It aims to enhance the qualifications of Indian faculty, reduce local competition, and strengthen research capabilities.

eligibility_rules.value: Ph.D programme from Foreign University of Listed ranking system

Copy of the 'Undertaking' furnished to parent Institute in India

scheme_name: AICTE-SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME (STTP) (UT-J&K,LADAKH AND NER)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance from AICTE to institutions in the North-Eastern Region and UTs of J&K and Ladakh to conduct short-term training programs for faculty members in technical education. The goal is to equip faculty with techniques to prepare students for a knowledge-based society. It is a six-day residential program.

scheme_name: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation Scheme
summary: This scheme by AICTE promotes technical education in Indian scheduled regional languages by providing financial support to faculty, writers, and translators. It aims to create a knowledge base in local languages and encourage the development of new technical content.

eligibility_rules.value: Faculty (retired or working in AICTE approved institutions), Researchers in AICTE approved institutions
command over subject and chosen language

required_documents: Details of the Writer of the book/Translator
Details of the Book to be Evaluated
Academic credentials of the book writer

scheme_name: AICTE-Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports
summary: This scheme provides funding to AICTE-approved technical institutions to conduct two-week residential training programs for Physical Education Trainers, Sport-Games Teachers, and Directors of Sports. The aim is to enhance participants' skills in promoting physical fitness through traditional and fun games, updating them on modern sports techniques, and empowering them in sports management and technology.
required_documents: Original Statement of actual expenditure & Utilization Certificate in prescribed proforma
Audited Statement of actual Expenditure & Utilization Certificate (for self-financing/private institutions)

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanatha Scholarship Scheme For Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: This scholarship scheme provides financial support to orphans, wards of parents who died due to Covid-19, and wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action. It aims to enable these students to pursue technical education in AICTE-approved institutions. Eligible students can receive ₹50,000 per annum for their degree or diploma studies.

eligibility_rules.value: currently studying in AICTE Approved institutions and courses at the Degree/Diploma level in regular mode
orphan, ward of parents who died due to Covid-19, ward of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action

10+2 / equivalent and 10th Mark sheet (for Degree Level)

Wards of Armed Forces martyred in action
Wards of Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action
Students pursuing Degree/Diploma in AICTE Approved institutions

scheme_name: Aahar Anudan Yojana
department: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
summary: The Aahar Anudan Yojana provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to women and girls from specific backward tribes (Baiga, Bharia, Saharia) in Madhya Pradesh. This scheme aims to combat malnutrition within these special tribal families by ensuring access to nutritious food.
required_documents: Bank Account Details (e.g., Copy of Bank Passbook)

scheme_name: ARAVANAIPPU
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry
summary: The ARAVANAIPPU scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1200 to lactating mothers in Puducherry. It aims to improve the status of girl children and ensure nutritious food. Assistance is provided for up to two girl children born after April 1, 2005.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department
Birth Certificate of the Girl Child

scheme_name: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
summary: This scheme aims to boost the production of Kufri Chipsona-1 potato variety in Bihar for processing, thereby increasing farmers' income. It provides certified quality seeds and financial assistance to farmers for expanding the cultivation area of this specific potato variety.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
summary: This fellowship scheme supports young researchers and scientists from ASEAN member countries to conduct research at Indian academic and R&D institutions. It aims to enhance their research skills, foster collaboration, and build a network between Indian and ASEAN scientific communities.

eligibility_rules.value: working/studying and/or affiliated with any national R&D or academic institution in home ASEAN Member Country

required_documents: Copy of relevant pages of valid Passport
Copy of endorsement letter from present employer
Copy of acceptance letter from Indian scientist/institution

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
summary: The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme providing death and disability coverage to unorganized workers, rural landless households, and members of 48 specific occupational groups. Beneficiaries aged 18-59 years pay a subsidized annual premium, and the scheme also offers scholarships for their children studying in grades 9-12.

eligibility_rules.value: Head of the family, Earning member
Below Poverty Line (BPL), Marginally Above Poverty Line

required_documents: Identity card issued by reputed employer/Government Department
Police Conclusion Report / Final Report (for accident claim)

scheme_name: Aamar Dukan On Wheels
summary: This scheme introduces a mobile retail module, 'Aamar Dukan On Wheels', delivering essential non-PDS items to consumers' doorsteps at below MRP using eco-friendly E-rickshaws. It aims to control commodity prices by eliminating middlemen, provide affordable essentials, and generate employment for educated unemployed youth while promoting cashless transactions.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
summary: The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana is a centrally sponsored scheme providing insurance and scholarship benefits to landless laborers in rural areas of Maharashtra. It offers financial security through various death and disability benefits, with a subsidized annual premium.

scheme_name: Aapki Beti Hamari Beti
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to girl children in Haryana. The state government invests ₹21,000 with LIC for eligible girls, which they receive upon turning 18. The scheme aims to improve the child-sex ratio, promote girls' education, and change societal attitudes towards girl children.
required_documents: Self-attested copy of the birth certificate
Passport Size photographs of the beneficiary

scheme_name: Aastha Yojana
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan
summary: The Aastha Yojana provides BPL-equivalent benefits, including free medical treatment and ration supplies, to families in Rajasthan with two or more specially-abled members. Beneficiary families must possess an Aastha Card and have an annual income not exceeding ₹1.20 lakh.

scheme_name: Aapki Beti Yojana
department: School Education Department, Government of Rajasthan
summary: The Aapki Beti Yojana provides financial assistance to girl students in Rajasthan from Class 1 to 12 who are studying in government schools. It targets girls from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families who have lost one or both parents, offering ₹2,100 annually for Class 1-8 and ₹2,500 for Class 9-12 to support their education.
required_documents: Passport size photo of the applicant
Jan Aadhaar Card of Family Head or the Girl
Bank Account Passbook linked with Jan Aadhaar

scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Assistance of Interest Subsidy

scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: EPF Reimbursement
summary: This scheme provides financial support to eligible Mega Industrial Units in Gujarat by reimbursing the employer's contribution to the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) for new employees. It aims to support growth, investments, and employment in the state's mega-industry sector, contributing to the 'Aatmanirbhar Gujarat' and 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' visions. The reimbursement is provided in 20 equal annual installments.

scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: EPF Reimbursement

scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Patent Registration

It covers 75% of the patent application costs, including attorney fees, up to a maximum of ₹25,00,000 per applicant. The initiative aims to support innovation and growth within the state's MSME sector.

scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Interest Subsidy to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (Service Sector)

The subsidy amount and duration vary based on the enterprise's location (Taluka category).

1 year from first loan disbursement, commercial production/services, or GR issue date (whichever is later)

scheme_name: Advocate Grant
department: Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala
summary: The Advocate Grant scheme provides financial assistance of ₹12,000 per year for three consecutive years to law graduates from backward classes in Kerala who are facing financial difficulties. It aims to help them start their practice as advocates and ensure adequate representation of OBCs in the judiciary.

scheme_name: Afforestation Schemes Providing Incentives And Employment To Tribals In Forest
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: This scheme aims to incentivize unemployed tribals by offering financial grants to participate in forest operations and afforestation activities. It promotes sustainable forest management while creating livelihood and employment opportunities for tribal communities.
required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority)
Proof of residence in the tribal/forest area

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
summary: The Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (AC&ABC) scheme aims to supplement public extension services, support agricultural development, and create gainful self-employment opportunities for unemployed agricultural graduates and allied science professionals. It provides start-up training and facilitates special start-up loans for establishing agri-ventures that offer expert advice and services to farmers.

eligibility_rules.value: Agricultural graduates, Agricultural diploma holders, Biological science graduates with PG in agri-related courses

required_documents: Aadhaar enrolment ID slip or alternative ID (Voter Identity Card, PAN, Passport, Ration Card)
beneficiary_categories: Biological science graduates with PG in agri-related courses

scheme_name: Agricultural Extension
summary: The Agricultural Extension scheme aims to bridge the gap between scientific research and farmers by providing up-to-date agricultural knowledge and professional extension services. It supports initiatives like SMAE, ATMA, Kisan Call Centres, and creates self-employment opportunities for agricultural graduates.

eligibility_rules.value: Graduates in agriculture and allied subjects, Diploma holders in Agriculture

required_documents: Aadhar enrollment ID slip/ Copy of request for Aadhaar enrolment
Passbook of Bank or Post Office

scheme_name: Advance for Purchase or Construction of House (GBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides registered construction workers in Goa with financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 as an advance for the outright purchase or construction of a house. The sanctioned amount is recovered in equal instalments as determined by the Board.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board

scheme_name: Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities
department: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam
summary: The Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities scheme provides financial loans of up to ₹10,00,000 to eligible persons with disabilities in Haryana. The financial assistance supports various agricultural endeavors including production, irrigation, horticulture, purchasing machinery, and product marketing.

scheme_name: Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme For Women Farmers And Farmers
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation
summary: The scheme provides agricultural skill development training and guidance to women farmers, male farmers, and youth in scientific methods and allied aspects. It aims to enhance agricultural productivity and inform participants about various state and central development schemes.

scheme_name: Agnipath Yojana
summary: Agnipath Yojana is a recruitment scheme for Indian youth to serve in the Armed Forces as Agniveers for a period of four years. It aims to create a youthful profile of the Armed Forces by providing an attractive monthly package, risk and hardship allowances, and a one-time 'SevaNidhi' package upon completion.
required_documents: Proof of Identity i.e. Aadhaar Card
Written pledge regarding non-involvement in violent protests

scheme_name: Agriculture Research Stations and Laboratories Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
summary: The Agriculture Research Stations and Laboratories Scheme conducts adaptive research trials on different crops in research farms and farmers' fields for adaptability and use of bio-pesticides and bio-agents. It provides farmers with training on soil management, soil health cards, and soil surveys.

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
summary: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund provides a medium to long-term debt financing facility for investments in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. It aims to improve agriculture infrastructure, reduce post-harvest losses, and increase farmers' value realization and overall income through incentives and financial support.
required_documents: Bank’s loan application form / Customer Request Letter for AIF Loan duly filled and signed
Passport size photographs of the promoter/partners/director
Identity proof – Voter ID card/PAN card/Aadhaar card/Driving license
Address Proof (Residence: Voter ID card/Passport/Aadhaar card/Driving license/Electricity Bill/Latest property Tax Bill; Business Office/Registered Office: Electric)

scheme_name: Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme
summary: The Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme is a state plan scheme by the Government of Meghalaya that sponsors eligible students for 4-year undergraduate degree courses in Agriculture and Horticulture. It provides financial assistance in the form of monthly stipends, book grants, and sponsored seats.
required_documents: Caste Certificate in respect of SC, ST and OBC

scheme_name: Agriculture And Processed Foods Export Promotion Scheme Of APEDA For The 15th Finance Commission Cycle (2021-22 To 2025-26)
department: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
summary: The Financial Assistance Scheme by APEDA aims to facilitate the export of agricultural and processed food products by providing financial support. It assists exporters across three broad areas: Export Infrastructure development, Quality Development, and Market Development to overcome export challenges.

scheme_name: Agroforestry component under RKVY
summary: The scheme focuses on Quality Planting Material by providing financial assistance for the establishment of new nurseries and raising saplings. It aims to promote climate change adaptation, enhance soil fertility and productivity, and create additional livelihood opportunities.

scheme_name: Akanksha Housing Scheme
summary: The Akanksha Housing Scheme provides affordable housing on a no-profit no-loss basis to serving State Government employees of West Bengal. The housing project is located in New Town, Kolkata, and offers flats across various categories through a transparent lottery system.
required_documents: Online application with deposit challan of ₹25,000 application money

scheme_name: Akanksha Scheme
summary: The Akanksha Scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free coaching for national entrance examinations like JEE, NEET/AIIMS, and CLET from reputed institutes for Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 11th and 12th. Students are selected based on an entrance exam merit list, helping them prepare for professional courses while completing their higher secondary education.

scheme_name: Allowance To Dwarf
summary: The Dwarf Allowance Scheme introduced by the State of Haryana provides financial assistance of Rs. 2500 per month to eligible dwarfs residing in the state. The scheme aims to offer social security and support equal opportunities for dwarf individuals.
required_documents: Certificate of dwarfism from District Medical Officer / Civil Surgeon
Photocopy of the first page of the bank account

scheme_name: Allowance To Eunuchs Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Allowance to Eunuchs Scheme, launched by the Government of Haryana, provides monthly financial assistance to eligible eunuchs residing in the state. Beneficiaries receive a monthly allowance, which is revised periodically, currently set at ₹2750/- per month.
required_documents: Certificate from Civil Surgeon confirming status as an Eunuch

scheme_name: Allowance for 100% Blind
ministry: Ministry of Social Welfare and Social Education, Tripura
department: Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education
summary: The Allowance for 100% Blind scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹2,000 to eligible blind individuals in Tripura. It aims to offer financial assistance and social support to persons with 100% blindness aged 10 years and above belonging to low-income families.

scheme_name: Airavata Scheme
summary: The Airavata Scheme partners with corporate aggregators like Ola and Uber to facilitate self-employment for rural SC/ST youth through radio taxi ventures. It provides training, mentoring, and a subsidy of Rs. 5,00,000 to purchase a light motor vehicle for generating sustainable livelihoods.

scheme_name: AICTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: The AICTE-Distinguished Professionals Scheme leverages the expertise of eminent professionals, emeritus professors, and senior officials to enhance the quality of technical education in India. It enables experts to interact with students and faculty, promote research, innovation, startups, and industry connectivity in AICTE-approved institutes, offering an honorarium for their visits.
required_documents: Educational Document (Degree, Master, Ph.D. in chronological order)
Evidence for Recognized Contribution in your field
Evidence of career commitment to excellence in teaching research or creativity activities

scheme_name: Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana
summary: The Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana provides financial assistance and maintenance allowances to meritorious students from minority communities in Madhya Pradesh. It aims to support students facing financial constraints to pursue higher education and promote inclusivity.

scheme_name: Alpsankhyak Muslim Parityaqta/Talaqshuda Mahila Sahayata Yojana
department: Minority Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
summary: This scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to divorced, abandoned, or destitute Muslim women from minority communities in Bihar. The objective is to strengthen their economic condition and make them self-dependent.

eligibility_rules.value: Divorced, Abandoned by husband for more than 2 years, Husband is completely mentally handicapped

required_documents: Proof of age (birth certificate, matriculation/equivalent certificate, voter identity card, passport, or executive magistrate certificate)
Certificate from the District Civil Surgeon in case of the husband's mental handicap

scheme_name: Alpasankhyak Post-Maitrik Chhaatravrtti Yojana
summary: The Alpasankhyak Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to students from minority communities in Madhya Pradesh pursuing post-secondary education. It offers scholarships for tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other educational expenses to alleviate financial burdens and promote inclusive growth.

scheme_name: Amar Fasal Amar Gola
summary: The Amar Fasal Amar Gola scheme by the West Bengal government provides financial assistance and subsidies ranging between Rs. 5,000 and Rs. 25,000 to marginal farmers for building their own storehouses. It aims to support farmers in storing and selling their produce directly while crediting subsidies directly to Kisan Credit Card-linked bank accounts.
required_documents: Proof and details of land holding
Bank Account Details linked with Kisan Credit Card

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
summary: The Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (ATUFS) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at facilitating investment, employment, productivity, and quality in the textile industry. It supports capital investment in sectors like handloom, silk, jute, technical textiles, and garment manufacturing under the Make in India initiative.

value: Processing fibres, fabrics, made-up, garments and yarns

scheme_name: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
summary: The Amma Two Wheeler Scheme aims to empower working women by providing financial assistance and subsidies to purchase gearless or auto-geared two-wheelers, making their daily commute to workplaces and banks easier. Beneficiaries can also receive retro-fitted three-wheeler scooters if they are differently abled.

scheme_name: Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000 per month for up to 10 months a year to eligible students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and EWS categories. It is designed for students residing in rented accommodations while pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses at district-level government colleges in Rajasthan.
required_documents: Certificate of Regular Enrollment in a government college

scheme_name: Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme provides financial assistance to meritorious Scheduled Caste (SC) students in Rajasthan pursuing Ph.D. research in specified subjects. Selected candidates receive a monthly fellowship of ₹15,000 for up to three years to support their doctoral studies.

scheme_name: Animal Husbandry
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Animal Husbandry scheme provides Adi Dravidar and Tribal beneficiaries in Tamil Nadu with a 50% to 75% subsidy on sheep units, milch animals, and calves. It also offers comprehensive veterinary care, including animal health cover and artificial insemination services.
required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority)

scheme_name: Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund
department: Department of Women Empowerment and Child Development
summary: The Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund is a social security scheme by the Government of Uttarakhand that provides financial assistance to anganwadi workers and helpers upon reaching 60 years of age. Eligible beneficiaries receive a minimum amount of ₹30,000, which increases based on their years of service.

scheme_name: Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-I
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 and one sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam to support the marriage of orphan girls in Tamil Nadu. The bride must be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
required_documents: Death Certificate of Father & Mother or Orphan Certificate (Issued by a Member of Parliament (MP)/ Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA))
Bills towards the Purchase of Marriage Articles for ₹1,000/-

scheme_name: Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-II
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-II, launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu, provides financial assistance and gold for marriage to eligible orphan girls. The scheme offers ₹25,000/- and one sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam through Electronic Clearing Service.
required_documents: Death Certificate of Father & Mother or Orphan Certificate
Bills towards the Purchase of Marriage Articles for ₹1,000/-

scheme_name: Annal Gandhi Memorial Award
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Annal Gandhi Memorial Award provides financial assistance to encourage academic excellence among students from the Hindu Adi Dravidar community in Tamil Nadu. Students who secure the first rank in the plus 2 Public Examinations in their district are eligible for monetary awards in their first year of higher education and subsequent years.

eligibility_rules.value: First rank in plus 2 Public Examinations in district

required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed)

scheme_name: Andaman & Nicobar Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay Establishment Scheme
department: Directorate of Tourism, Andaman & Nicobar Administration
summary: The Andaman & Nicobar Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay Establishment Scheme provides quality, standardized home stay facilities for both domestic and foreign tourists. It allows visitors to stay with local families to experience Indian customs, traditions, and authentic cuisine while supplementing local accommodation availability.

scheme_name: Annual Medical Assistance Scheme (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Annual Medical Assistance Scheme by the Government of Bihar provides a yearly financial assistance of ₹3,000/- to construction workers who are registered with the board. The applicant must have an active membership with at least one year of duration with the board.
required_documents: Identity Proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Identity Card of the Registered Worker

scheme_name: Annual Tour to the Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Annual Tour to the Differently Abled Persons scheme by the Government of Puducherry offers free annual tours to places of cultural and historic importance for differently abled individuals from weaker sections. It aims to help beneficiaries acquaint themselves with cultural heritage and travel freely.

scheme_name: Antarjatiye Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
summary: The Antarjatiye Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana is an initiative by the Government of Bihar to eradicate the caste system and encourage inter-caste marriages. It provides a one-time financial assistance grant of ₹1,00,000 to eligible couples from poor families where one partner belongs to a Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) and the other to a general caste, provided they meet residency and age criteria.
required_documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant (Bride & groom)
Latest photograph of the married couple
Identity proofs (e.g., Voter ID Card, Driving License etc.)

scheme_name: Annath Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development
summary: Annath Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB) is a 100% state-sponsored scheme by the Government of Jharkhand that provides family pension benefits to orphans below 18 years of age upon the death of a registered construction worker pensioner. The pension is evenly divided among eligible orphan children.
required_documents: Proof of Age / Date of Birth
Document establishing the relationship between the deceased and the applicant

scheme_name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: The Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme promotes economic development for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu. It provides a 35% capital subsidy and a 6% interest subvention on loans for procuring machinery and equipment for manufacturing, service, and eligible trading enterprises.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. copy of Election ID Card/ Aadhaar card

scheme_name: Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan
summary: The Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana by the Government of Rajasthan provides financial assistance of ₹5,000 to registered voluntary organizations and NGOs for performing the dignified last rites of unclaimed and destitute deceased individuals. The scheme ensures proper cremation and funeral arrangements for those who have died without known family or relatives within the state's jurisdiction.

scheme_name: Antayoshti Sahayata Yojana
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development
summary: Antayoshti Sahayata Yojana is a state-sponsored scheme by the Government of Jharkhand that provides financial assistance of ₹ 10,000 for funeral rites in the event of the death of a registered construction worker. The scheme aims to support the families of eligible deceased workers who were registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board).
required_documents: Proof of Registration as a Construction Worker
Document establishing the relationship between the deceased and the applicant

scheme_name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana
summary: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana provides financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 to Scheduled Tribe families in Goa for performing funeral and religious ceremonies. The assistance covers the actual cost or up to the specified limit upon meeting income and caste criteria.
required_documents: Caste Certificate Issued by Competent Authority
Death Certificate of the Deceased / Death & Burial Certificate in Case of Christian Scheduled Tribe Families
Income Certificate Issued by Competent Authority
Any Document Proving a Relationship With the Deceased (Birth Certificate, Marriage Certificate Etc)

scheme_name: Aponar Apon Ghar
summary: The 'Aponar Apon Ghar' scheme provides home loan subsidies up to ₹ 2,50,000 on home loans up to ₹ 40,00,000 for permanent residents of Assam. It aims to help eligible citizens purchase their first house at subsidized interest rates.
required_documents: Statement of Salary Account for the Past Six Months
No Dues Salary From the Existing Banker
Proof of Being in Service for a Minimum of Five Years
Statement of Personal Assets and Liabilities in Bank’s Format

scheme_name: Aravanaippu Illam
summary: The Aravanaippu Illam scheme provides safe living conditions, free shelter, food, clothing, medical treatment, and daily necessities for individuals lacking basic needs and proper care in society. It also offers skill training, pocket money, and recreational activities for the beneficiaries.

eligibility_rules.value: lacking basic needs and proper care

scheme_name: Arivu Education Loan Scheme
summary: The Arivu Education Loan Scheme launched by the Government of Karnataka provides financial loans ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per year to students from minority communities for pursuing various professional courses. The scheme aims to support higher education with low service charges of 2% after course completion.
required_documents: Recent Two Passport-size Photos of the Student

scheme_name: Arka Vertical Garden
summary: The Arka Vertical Garden scheme popularizes user-friendly vertical garden structures developed by ICAR-IIHR under RKVY to ensure food and nutritional security. It provides a financial subsidy of ₹15,525 for installing a single unit of the vertical garden structure to eligible residents of Kerala.

scheme_name: Arogya Lakshmi
department: Women Development and Child Welfare Department
summary: The Arogya Lakshmi scheme by the Telangana government provides one nutritious full meal every day along with iron and folic acid tablets to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadi centers. Additionally, it provides supplementary nutrition including eggs and Balamrutham to children below the age of six to reduce maternal and infant mortality rates.

scheme_name: Artificial Limbs and Assistive Devices Supply Scheme
summary: The Artificial Limbs and Assistive Devices Supply Scheme aims to increase the mobility of persons with disabilities in Chhattisgarh by providing artificial limbs and assistive devices worth up to ₹6,900/-. The scheme reduces the impact of disabilities and offers devices free of cost for eligible individuals based on income criteria.

scheme_name: Artificial Limbs/Assistive Equipments Scheme
summary: The Artificial Limbs/Assistive Equipments Scheme provides financial grants to persons with disabilities in Uttar Pradesh to purchase artificial limbs, mobility assistance, and educational equipment. Eligible beneficiaries include those whose family income falls below the BPL limit and who possess a valid disability certificate.

scheme_name: Artisan Promotion
department: Delhi Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Safai Karamchari Finance and Development Corporation (DSFDC)
summary: The Artisan Promotion scheme aims to provide artisans with opportunities to showcase their talents by participating in various national fairs and exhibitions. It offers financial support for participation fees, lodging, boarding, and stipends to help artisans gain exposure and financial benefits.
required_documents: Two Passport Size Photographs of the Beneficiary/Artisan
Copy of Registration Certificate with MSME
Affidavit in the Prescribed Format on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Appropriate Value (Under the Minority Category)

scheme_name: Arun Pig Development Scheme
department: Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development
summary: The Arun Pig Development Scheme aims to improve the genetic stock of indigenous pigs through crossbreeding with exotic breeds to enhance productivity and generate livelihoods. It provides a 75% government subsidy for piggery to eligible farmers and Self Help Groups (SHGs) in Arunachal Pradesh.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.
Application form and farmer details in the prescribed format

scheme_name: Arunachal Pradesh Entrepreneurship Challenge
department: Department of Finance, Investment and Planning
summary: The Arunachal Pradesh Entrepreneurship Challenge (APEC) aims to identify, promote, support, and nurture sustainable and locally relevant business ideas and entrepreneurs in the state. Selected entrepreneurs receive incubation and pre-incubation programs facilitated by IIM Calcutta Innovation Park along with financial grants and soft loans.
required_documents: Proof of Concept or early-stage revenue generation of products/services

scheme_name: Anti Bird Net
summary: The Anti-Bird Net Scheme by the Rajasthan government promotes protected cultivation by providing subsidies for installing low-cost plastic tunnels or anti-bird nets. Eligible farmers receive a 50 percent subsidy for a maximum area of 5000 square meters.
required_documents: Copy of Jamabandi (not more than six months old)

scheme_name: Antim Sanskar Yojana
summary: Antim Sanskar Yojana is a state-level scheme by the Labor Department of Madhya Pradesh that provides lump-sum financial assistance of ₹6,000 to the dependents of registered construction workers for funeral expenses in the event of the worker's death. The scheme aims to alleviate the immediate financial burden on grieving families.
required_documents: Application form in the prescribed format

scheme_name: Arundhati Gold Scheme
summary: The Arundhati Gold Scheme provides financial assistance of Rs. 40,000 to economically weaker parents in Assam to gift gold to their daughters on their marriage. The scheme aims to support families in celebrating their daughter's first marriage while ensuring educational and legal age requirements are met.
required_documents: HSLC/CBSE or equivalent pass certificate for proof of age
Birth Certificate for Tea Tribe and Adivasi Communities
Marriage registration certificate under the Special Marriage Act, 1954

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
summary: The Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana provides financial assistance to the families of registered unorganized workers in Chhattisgarh in the event of their death or permanent disability. It aims to offer social security and empowerment to vulnerable workers and their dependents.

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana provides sewing machines to registered unorganized women workers in Chhattisgarh. The objective is to promote their businesses, foster self-reliance, and empower women engaged in tailoring, embroidery, or weaving.

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana provides financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 to registered unorganized workers in Chhattisgarh for the treatment of serious illnesses such as kidney disease, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS, and paralysis.
required_documents: Disease details by Vikas khand Adhikari / Surgeon / Chief medical officer/ Health Officer
Approximate expenses details by related Medical officer

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana
summary: Launched by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh, this scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered unorganized workers. It offers annual scholarships ranging from ₹500 to ₹4,000 depending on the student's gender and level of education.

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana, launched by the Chhattisgarh government, empowers unorganized workers by providing financial assistance for delivery. Eligible registered workers receive financial help of ₹20,000 to support childbirth and related healthcare needs.
required_documents: A scanned copy of the registration certificate
Authorized verification of pregnancy by a doctor, ANM or Mitanin

scheme_name: Asangathita Shramik Sahayika Prakalpa
summary: The Asanghatita Sramik Sahayika Prakalpa (ASSP) provides financial security to unorganized workers in Tripura through a contributory savings scheme. Workers contribute a nominal amount matched by the State Government, which is refunded with interest upon turning 60 or in cases of death or permanent disability.
required_documents: Certificate issued by concerned Pradhan of Gram Panchayet/Chief Executive Officer of Municipal Council/Mayor/Deputy Mayor/Member of Panchayet Samity/TTAADC/Zilla Parishad or Employer

scheme_name: Ashadeepa Scheme
summary: The Ashadeepa Scheme encourages private sector industries in Karnataka to provide employment and apprenticeship opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates. It provides financial assistance to employers by reimbursing employer contributions towards Salary, ESI, EPF, and stipend amounts paid to apprentice trainees.
required_documents: Proof of ESI and EPF Contribution

scheme_name: Ashirwad
department: Social Welfare and Empowerment, Women and Child
summary: The Punjab Ashirwad scheme provides financial assistance of ₹51,000 to economically disadvantaged families for the marriage of their daughters. It aims to reduce financial burdens and encourage families raising girl children, limited to two daughters per family.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Castes, Christian, Backward Classes, Economically Weaker Sections, Widows, Divorcees

scheme_name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheme for Health Insurance (ANISHI)
summary: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheme for Health Insurance (ANISHI) provides cashless medical treatment benefits of up to ₹5.00 Lakhs per patient per illness. It aims to assist economically disadvantaged residents, BPL families, government pensioners, and permanent residents whose family annual income is below ₹3.00 Lakhs.

scheme_name: Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
summary: The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme provides a financial subsidy of up to ₹50,000 to students pursuing higher education who have taken an education loan. Managed by the Government of Assam, the initiative aims to encourage higher studies by easing the financial burden of loan repayment for permanent residents of the state.
required_documents: Passport Sized Photograph of the Student
Proof of Identity of the Parents
Marksheets / Passing Certificate of the Previous Educational Qualification

scheme_name: Assam Arogya Nidhi Scheme
department: Health & Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Assam
summary: The Assam Arogya Nidhi Scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹3.00 Lakhs to BPL families and families with an annual income of less than ₹5.00 Lakhs for the treatment of life-threatening diseases and injuries from disasters or accidents. The scheme is open to ordinary residents of Assam, excluding government employees and pensioners.
required_documents: Photograph of the patient (Attested by Doctor)
Attested photocopy of Income Certificate by Revenue Circle Officer
Attested photocopy of Identify & Address Proof (Voter ID, ADHAAR CARD, Driving license)
Copy of the medical documents of treatment to be certified by treating Doctor/Hospital Discharge Summary/Prescription

scheme_name: Assam Orunodoi Scheme
summary: The Orunodoi Scheme provides financial assistance of Rs. 1000 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer to poor households in Assam, with women as the primary beneficiaries. It aims to offer socio-economic empowerment and substantial earnings support to low-income families.

scheme_name: Assistance For Delivery / Miscarriage Of Pregnancy / Termination Of Pregnancy To Female Differently Abled Person
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹6,000 (@ ₹1,000 per month) for delivery or ₹3,000 for miscarriage or termination of pregnancy to female differently abled persons in Tamil Nadu.
required_documents: Copy of National Spouse Identity Card and Board Registration Details
Certificate from the hospital where the operation was performed for abortion

scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana
summary: This scheme provides a free cycle to unorganized newspaper delivery workers (hawkers) in Chhattisgarh to empower them. It is designed to assist registered workers who do not receive benefits from parallel schemes.

scheme_name: Ashraya Adhar Scheme
summary: The Ashraya Adhar Scheme provides financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans to members of the Scheduled Tribe community in Goa for the repair, renovation, or reconstruction of their houses. The scheme aims to make housing improvement affordable for ST families who struggle with high commercial bank interest rates.
required_documents: Age proof of applicant (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Driving License)
Self Affidavit on ₹ 50/- Stamp Paper duly notarized
Copy of the latest house tax receipt
N.O.C from Co-owner (if any) on ₹ 50/- Stamp Paper duly notarized

scheme_name: Assistance For Major Ailments (Karmika Chikitsa Bhagya) (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Assistance For Major Ailments scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 to registered construction workers and their dependents in Karnataka for the treatment of specified major ailments. It aims to ensure that eligible workers receive necessary medical care without severe financial hardship.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered with Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board

required_documents: Smart card issued by the Board

scheme_name: Assistance For Purchase Of Spectacles By A Differently Abled Person
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of Rs. 500/- to differently-abled individuals in Tamil Nadu for the reimbursement of the cost of spectacles. It aims to support their vision needs and improve their daily mobility and accessibility.
required_documents: The Receipt of buying nose glasses

scheme_name: Assistance For Purchase of Aids/Appliances
department: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development Chandigarh
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to physically handicapped persons in Chandigarh for purchasing aids and appliances to increase their mobility. It covers 100% of the cost of artificial limbs and appliances up to a maximum of ₹40,000/- to help individuals perform tasks independently.
required_documents: Residence Proof for the last three years duly attested (Voter Identity Card, Ration Card, Electricity Bill)
Copy of Disability Certificate/Identity Card with 40% Disability
Recommendations of Medical Authorities (General Hospital, PGIMER)

scheme_name: Assistance On Death Of The Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Assistance on Death of the Unregistered Worker scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- to the legal heir or dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies due to an accident at the workplace. It aims to support grieving families by alleviating immediate financial distress following a fatal workplace accident.
required_documents: Copy of FIR in regard to the accident
Recommendation report of the concerned officer after an investigation
Copy of the employer's statement related to the accident

scheme_name: Assistance Scheme For Construction Worker In Case Of General Or Accidental Death Or Injury
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and compensation of up to Rs. 5 lakhs to registered construction workers and their families in Rajasthan in the event of accidental death, permanent disability, or injury. It also covers medical expenses incurred for treatment of injuries sustained during accidents at construction sites.

scheme_name: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to Rs. 5000/- for the reimbursement of visa expenses to registered construction workers from Rajasthan who have secured employment abroad. It aims to reduce the financial burden of obtaining a visa and support workers in accessing international employment opportunities.
required_documents: Copy of the beneficiary registration identity card
Copy of the beneficiary Aadhaar card and Jan Aadhaar card
First page of the beneficiary savings bank account passbook
Copy of the employment contract issued by the foreign employer

scheme_name: Assistance Scheme for Handicraft Artisans
summary: The Assistance Scheme for Handicraft Artisans (ASHA) provides one-time financial grant assistance to eligible artisans and micro-enterprises in the handicrafts sector for setting up enterprises, covering fixed capital investments such as work sheds, tools, machinery, and technology support.
required_documents: Self-attested copy of the identity card of the applicant
Self-attested copy of the resolution towards applying for this assistance in case of a unit other than proprietary
Self-attested copy of Udyam Registration of the unit
Copy of Caste Certificate (Attested by Gazetted Officer) in case of SC/ST artisans

scheme_name: Assistance Towards Expenses Incurred for Raising of Funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan
summary: This scheme provides one-time financial assistance of up to ₹15,00,000 to small and medium enterprises in Rajasthan for expenses incurred while raising equity through NSE or BSE's SME exchange platforms. Introduced under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024, it aims to ease liquidity constraints for manufacturing and service sector enterprises.
required_documents: Certificate of Incorporation/Partnership deed or equivalent document
Memorandum of Association & Article of Association or equivalent documents
Board Resolution/Power of attorney in the name of Authorized Signatory
CA certified expenditure statement as per Annexure 2.2 with expense vouchers/bills

scheme_name: Assistance for Daughter's Marriage
summary: The 'Assistance for Daughter's Marriage' scheme provides financial support of ₹25,000 per daughter for up to two marriageable daughters of widows of ex-servicemen. It aims to assist families of ex-servicemen up to the rank of Havaldar who are natives of Rajasthan and not receiving similar grants from the Kendriya Sainik Board.
required_documents: Attested copy of the ex-serviceman's discharge book/Service Particulars
Proof of Daughter's Name in Official Records

scheme_name: Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases provides free medical treatment and monthly financial assistance up to ₹3,00,000 to registered construction workers suffering from specified occupational diseases or serious injuries. The scheme offers ₹1500 monthly for less than 90% disability and ₹3000 monthly for 90 to 100% disability under normal circumstances.

eligibility_rules.value: Occupational disease or serious injury resulting in disability

required_documents: Proof of age (Birth certificate/Driving Licence/PAN Card/Voter ID Card)

scheme_name: Assistance for Cattleshed, Gaman, Water Tank and Bucket
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: This scheme provides financial aid up to ₹30,000 to farmers and cattle rearers belonging to the Scheduled Caste community in Gujarat for constructing cattlesheds and purchasing cattle feed containers, water tanks, and buckets. The assistance helps improve animal husbandry infrastructure and animal welfare at the farm level.
required_documents: Land ownership or 10-year lease agreement documents

scheme_name: Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy
summary: This scheme offered by the Tamil Nadu Folk Artiste's Welfare Board provides financial assistance to registered female folk artists for child delivery, miscarriage, or termination of pregnancy. Beneficiaries receive ₹6,000 for child delivery, and ₹3,000 for miscarriage or termination, subject to having fewer than two children and no board dues.
required_documents: Registration Card of the Folk Artist
Birth Certificate of Child or Certificate of miscarriage of pregnancy, or termination of pregnancy (from Registered Maternity Doctor)

scheme_name: Assistance for Funeral Expenses (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Assistance for Funeral Expenses scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to the nominee of a deceased registered building and construction worker in Odisha to help meet funeral expenses. The scheme is aimed at supporting the families of registered construction workers upon their death.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy

scheme_name: Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan
summary: This scheme aims to promote digital transformation and enhance the eCommerce capabilities of MSMEs in Rajasthan. It provides financial reimbursement for purchasing digitization software/equipment and for registering on eCommerce platforms.
required_documents: Invoices for purchased software/Equipment for digitization along with payment proofs
Documentary proof for registration on eCommerce Platform for reimbursement of eCommerce fee
Certificate of Incorporation/Partnership Deed/Firm Registration or equivalent document related to incorporation of the enterprise

scheme_name: Assistance for Installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: This scheme provides financial subsidies to farmers and institutions in the Union Territory of Puducherry for installing sprinkler or drip micro-irrigation systems. Marginal, small, SC/ST, and women farmers receive up to 90% subsidy, while big farmers and institutions receive up to 70%, capped at ₹25,000 per hectare.
required_documents: Electricity policy card of the tubewell

scheme_name: Assistance for Marriage
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Assistance for Marriage scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides financial aid of ₹2,000/- to meet the marriage expenses of a differently abled person or their son or daughter. Applications are processed offline through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.

scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat
