summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to 75% or ₹18,000/- (whichever is less) to dairy farmers of the General Caste category in Gujarat for purchasing electric powered chaff cutters. The goal is to help dairy farmers reduce fodder wastage and make dairy farming more profitable.
required_documents: Identity proof of the applicant i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP- ST Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to dairy farmers belonging to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category in Gujarat for purchasing electric powered chaff cutters. This helps reduce fodder wastage and promotes profitable dairy farming.
required_documents: Identity proof of the applicant i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to 75% or ₹18,000/- to dairy farmers belonging to the Scheduled Caste category for purchasing electric powered chaff cutters. The initiative aims to reduce fodder wastage and support profitable dairy farming in Gujarat.
required_documents: Identity proof of the applicant i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of Bi-cycle (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Assistance for Purchase of Bi-cycle scheme provides a one-time reimbursement of up to ₹4,000 to registered construction workers in Odisha for purchasing a bicycle. Beneficiaries must produce the original bill or voucher and meet specific registration and contribution criteria.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy

scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of House (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Assistance for Purchase of House scheme provides an interest-free loan of up to ₹2,00,000 to eligible registered construction workers in Haryana for purchasing or constructing a house. The facility is available once in a lifetime for workers who have a minimum of five years of regular membership.

scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of Safety Equipment (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement of up to ₹1,000 to registered building and construction workers in Odisha for purchasing essential safety equipment such as helmets, safety shoes, and hand gloves. Beneficiaries must produce original bills or vouchers along with proof of active registration and up-to-date annual contributions.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy
Original Bill/ Voucher for Safety Equipment

scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles - Folk Artists
summary: The Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹500/- to registered folk artists for purchasing spectacles. Administered by the Tamil Nadu Folk Artiste's Welfare Board, the benefit is restricted to two thousand registered folk artists per year on a first-come-first-serve basis.
required_documents: Registration Card of the Folk Artist

scheme_name: Assistance for Quality Enhancement
summary: The Assistance for Quality Enhancement scheme under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 supports Micro and Small Enterprises in improving product and process quality. It offers one-time financial reimbursement for obtaining quality certifications, system certifications, and Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs).
required_documents: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney in the name of Authorized Signatory
Copy of Certification/IPR and other related documents
Bills of Eligible Expenses and Proof of Payment

scheme_name: Assistance for Funeral Rites
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Assistance for Funeral Rites scheme offers financial support of ₹500/- to economically disadvantaged SC/ST families in Tamil Nadu. The goal is to ease the burden of funeral expenses and ensure dignified funeral rites for deceased family members.
required_documents: Death Certificate of the deceased family member

scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers belonging to the General Category, as well as farmer groups and cooperative societies, for purchasing tools, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. Individual farmers can receive up to 75% of the cost or ₹3,750, while farmer groups and cooperative societies can receive up to 90% or ₹7,50,000 for PHM equipment installation.
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by Competent Authority (if applicable)
Copy of bank passbook/ cancelled cheque
Copy of forest rights Letter (if applicable)

scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme aims to reduce fodder wastage in dairy farming by providing financial assistance for purchasing power-driven chaff cutters. It helps farmers efficiently chop green and dry fodder, leading to better resource utilization and increased profitability.
required_documents: Bank Passbook copy or cancelled cheque
Caste Certificate (Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe applicants)

scheme_name: Assistance in Case of Accidents (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Assistance in Case of Accidents scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers or their nominees in Odisha in the event of accidents resulting in permanent total disability, loss of one limb or eye, or other permanent disabilities. Financial support ranges from ₹40,000 to ₹1,50,000 depending on the severity of the disability.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy

scheme_name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: This scheme supports livestock owners belonging to the General Category during the critical post-parturition period by providing 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed free of cost. It aims to ensure the health and well-being of both the mother cattle and the newborn calf.
required_documents: Certificate of calving of an animal from Govt. Livestock inspector
Disability certificate from competent authority (If beneficiary is disabled)

scheme_name: Ashram Schools (Scheduled Tribes)
department: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
summary: The Ashram Schools scheme provides free accommodation, mess, and education facilities to Scheduled Tribe students in Madhya Pradesh. It aims to support the educational needs of underprivileged students by ensuring they have access to necessary residential and learning infrastructure.

scheme_name: Assistance to Farmers to Purchase Heavy Farm Equipment (Tractor)
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The scheme aims to support farmers by offering subsidies for the purchase of tractors to enhance agricultural productivity and efficiency. It provides financial assistance ranging from ₹45,000 to ₹60,000 based on the tractor's engine capacity.

scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe farmers, farmer groups, and cooperative societies in Gujarat for purchasing agricultural tools, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. Individual farmers can receive up to 75% of the cost or ₹3,750/-, while farmer groups and cooperative societies can receive up to 90% of the cost or ₹7,50,000/-.
required_documents: Scheduled Tribes Certificate issued by competent authority
Disability Certificate issued by Competent Authority (only for PWDs) (if applicable)
Copy of forest rights Letter (if applicable)

scheme_name: Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: This scheme provides a 65% subsidy (up to a maximum of ₹50,000 per tubewell per individual) to general category farmers in Puducherry for installing submersible or centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories. It aims to support agricultural irrigation by aiding eligible landowners with registered tubewells.
required_documents: Certificate for the ownership of the land issued by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar
Copy of the Registration certificate, Permit and Energisation Certificate issued by the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry
Original bills for the expenses incurred towards the construction of the tubewell or bank loan documents

scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste farmers, farmer groups, and cooperative societies in Gujarat for purchasing tools, equipment, sorting/grading machinery, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. Individual farmers receive up to 75% of the cost or ₹3,750/- (whichever is less), while groups and societies can receive up to 90% of the cost or ₹7,50,000/-.
required_documents: Scheduled Castes Certificate issued by competent authority
Disability Certificate issued by Competent Authority (only for PWDs)
Copy of bank passbook/ cancelled cheque

scheme_name: Assistance to Law Graduates
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Assistance to Law Graduates scheme provides financial support of ₹50,000 to differently abled law graduates. The funds are intended for enrolment in the Bar Council as a lawyer and for purchasing law books.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to fishermen in Gujarat who own small boats with Outboard Motors (OBM) by subsidizing the cost of kerosene or petrol. It aims to support the local fishing community and promote fisheries by offering a per-litre assistance of ₹50/- throughout the year.
required_documents: Kerosene/Petrol Card issued by the government
Aadhaar Card or any government-issued ID proof

scheme_name: Assistance on Death- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: The Assistance on Death scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- in the event of the death of a Silicosis victim. The amount is payable to the widow or widower if the deceased was married, or to the nominee if the deceased was unmarried.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Proof of relation with the deceased worker

scheme_name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000 to specially-abled individuals in Rajasthan for purchasing artificial limbs, prosthetic aids, and equipment to overcome physical disabilities and aid in self-employment. Eligible beneficiaries receive support for items such as tricycles, wheelchairs, hearing aids, and Jaipur Foot.

scheme_name: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: This scheme provides a 90% subsidy (up to ₹1,80,000) to Scheduled Caste farmers in Puducherry for the construction of tubewells or filter points. Eligible farmers must meet residency requirements, hold at least 1.5 acres of land with a clear title for 2 years, and obtain the necessary permits from the Ground Water Authority.
required_documents: Permit from Pondicherry Ground Water Authority

scheme_name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The 'Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries' scheme by the Government of Gujarat boosts inland fisheries by supporting SC fishermen and fish farmers. It provides financial aid for fish seed rearing, stocking, transportation, boats, nets, fish sale equipment, and skill-enhancement training with stipends.

scheme_name: Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers
summary: The scheme aims to revive the traditional pottery industry by providing financial assistance to traditional pottery workers belonging to the OBC category in Kerala for purchasing modern machinery and modernizing production techniques. Beneficiaries receive financial support of ₹25,000/- for upgrading their occupation.

scheme_name: Assistance to Training Institutions Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Assistance to Training Institutions Scheme provides financial aid to Ministry of MSME training institutions and state-level Entrepreneurship Development Institutes (EDIs) for infrastructure development, expansion, and covering revenue deficits. It aims to strengthen training capabilities through physical infrastructure development, equipment procurement, and faculty training.
required_documents: MSME registration certificate/ Udyam Registration of the unit

scheme_name: Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This central sector scheme aims to involve voluntary organizations to improve the educational and socio-economic conditions of Other Backward Classes (OBCs). It provides financial support for skill development training projects to help beneficiaries start income-generating activities or secure gainful employment.
required_documents: Audited/Unaudited Accounts of the Previous Year
Budget Estimates for the Current Financial Year
Performance Report with Statistical Data for the Previous Year

scheme_name: Assistance under SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act
summary: The scheme provides immediate relief, compensation for loss, and rehabilitation to victims of atrocities belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. It aims to support affected individuals under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act.
required_documents: Recent Passport-Size Photograph of the Applicant

scheme_name: Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti
department: Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
summary: The Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,850 per annum to students from Class 1 to Class 10 whose parents are engaged in unclean and hazardous occupations. The objective is to motivate marginalized students to pursue their education.
beneficiary_categories: Children of workers in unclean occupations

scheme_name: Aswasakiranam
summary: Aswasakiranam is a welfare scheme by the Kerala government that provides a monthly financial assistance of Rs 600 to informal caregivers who look after bedridden patients or individuals with severe physical and mental disabilities. The scheme aims to support low-income families who bear the social and economic burden of full-time home care.
required_documents: Medical certificate attested by Govt./ Vayomithram / NRHM doctors
Attested copy of BPL ration card / BPL certificate issued by Panchayat or Municipality or Corporation / Income certificate issued by village officer
Attested copy of Aadhar card/confirmation slip received

scheme_name: Atal Asra Yojana
summary: Atal Asra Yojana provides financial assistance of up to ₹ 3,00,000 to Scheduled Tribe individuals in Goa for the construction, reconstruction, or repair of their houses. The scheme aims to improve living conditions by supporting safe and stable housing for economically weaker ST families.
required_documents: ST Certificate Issued by Competent Authority
Sanction Order under JAY / RAY (if any)
Detailed Estimate from Registered Engineer / Architect / Contractor who is registered under PWD / GSIDC / Government Department or Autonomous Body
Photograph of the Existing Along With the Applicant

scheme_name: Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
summary: The Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana provides free residential education, accommodation, meals, and other facilities to children of registered construction workers and orphaned children in Uttar Pradesh. The initiative aims to support underprivileged children and improve their standard of living through quality education.
required_documents: Mark sheet of previous class attended

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
summary: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana provides financial relief in the form of cash compensation to insured persons who have become unemployed. Beneficiaries receive 50% of their average per day earnings for up to a maximum of 90 days of unemployment, provided they meet specific employment and contribution criteria.
required_documents: Salary Slip for last two months
Any other relevant documents, if required

scheme_name: Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: The scheme provides a 65% subsidy up to a maximum of ₹1,50,000 to general category farmers in Puducherry for the construction of tubewells or filter points. Beneficiaries must meet specific land ownership and permit criteria to avail of the financial assistance.
required_documents: Certificate for land ownership issued by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar
Copy of the PERMIT obtained from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry
Registration Certificate for the tubewell/filter point issued by Pondicherry Ground Water Authority

scheme_name: Atal Mission For Rejuvenation And Urban Transformation
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: The Atal Mission for Rejuvenation And Urban Transformation (AMRUT) ensures every household has access to a water tap and sewerage connection. It focuses on increasing urban amenity value through parks, reducing pollution via public and non-motorized transport, and improving storm water drainage across selected cities.

scheme_name: Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana
summary: The Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana provides financial relief to domestic consumers in Madhya Pradesh by subsidizing electricity bills for those with low energy consumption. Consumers with monthly electricity consumption of up to 150 units and an approved load of 1 kilowatt receive automatically adjusted subsidized bills.

scheme_name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: Atal Pension Yojana is a guaranteed pension scheme aimed at workers in the unorganized sector to help them save voluntarily for retirement. It provides a guaranteed minimum pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month starting at age 60.
required_documents: KYC details from active Bank/Post Office Savings account

scheme_name: Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna
summary: Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a state-level initiative by the Government of Himachal Pradesh to reward and incentivize the best-performing Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) based on sanitation, cleanliness, fund utilization, and public infrastructure. Top-performing Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, and Nagar Panchayats are felicitated with cash prizes and the Atal Shrestha Shahar Puruskar.
required_documents: Report of Fund utilization in respect of funds provided during preceding the last FY
Details of the number of sheets registered beneficiaries under Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
Details of increase in ULB's own income (i.e. Property Tax, user charges, rent, and Income from other sources) during the last FY
Details of Audit Paras settled and audited accounts

scheme_name: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana
summary: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana is an umbrella bank-linked credit subsidy scheme by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote the cultivation of various fruits. Under the scheme, beneficiaries receive a 45% government subsidy, 45% bank finance, and contribute 10% on their own.

scheme_name: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana
summary: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana promotes self-reliance in the agriculture sector of Arunachal Pradesh by providing financial assistance and collateral-free loans of up to Rs. 1.60 lakhs. The scheme supports activities such as scientific land terracing, double cropping, farm mechanization, and apiculture to enhance agricultural productivity.

scheme_name: Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice scheme offers financial support and incentives to unemployed Adi Dravidar and Tribal lawyers in Tamil Nadu who are in the early stages of their career. The initiative is designed to help them establish and build a successful legal practice.
required_documents: Certificate of registration as a lawyer

scheme_name: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: This scheme provides Scheduled Caste farmers in Puducherry with a 90% subsidy (up to ₹60,000 per tubewell) for installing submersible or centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories. Eligible applicants must own and hold at least 1.5 acres of land under the tubewell command area for a minimum of 2 years.
required_documents: Nationality, Nativity, Caste Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar
Land ownership certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar
Registration certificate, Permit and Energisation Certificate issued by the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority

scheme_name: Aushadhi Avam Sugandhit Fasal Shetra Vistar
summary: The Aushadhi Avam Sugandhit Fasal Shetra Vistar scheme by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides financial grants and subsidies to farmers for cultivating medicinal and aromatic crops. Farmers can receive a 20 to 50 percent subsidy for expanding their cultivation area for specific medicinal plants, supporting agricultural diversification and income generation.

scheme_name: Award For Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya In The HSSLC Examination (Science Stream)
summary: This scheme provides a one-time financial award of Rs. 10,000 and a certificate to motivate tribal students in Meghalaya who achieve top marks in the HSSLC Science stream examination. It aims to inculcate a scientific temper and encourage interest in Mathematics and Science.
required_documents: Front page of Student Bank Account

scheme_name: Award Of Scholarships To Young Artists In Different Cultural Fields
summary: The 'Award of Scholarships to Young Artists in Different Cultural Fields' scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5000 per month for two years to young artists of outstanding promise for advanced training within India. It covers various disciplines including classical music, dance, theatre, visual arts, and folk arts.
required_documents: Matriculation or equivalent certificate for age proof

scheme_name: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
summary: The Government of Maharashtra provides a monthly stipend to encourage V.J.N.T. and S.B.C. students pursuing technical education in approved ITIs. The scheme offers a maintenance allowance ranging from Rs. 40 to Rs. 100 per month for 10 months to support their studies.

scheme_name: Attendance Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students with Disabilities of Rural Areas
department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development
summary: The Attendance Scholarship Scheme provides financial incentives to rural girl students with disabilities in Punjab to encourage them to continue their education and reduce dropouts. Scholarships ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹3,000 per annum are provided directly to eligible students from the 1st standard up to higher education.
required_documents: Disability Certificate/ UDID showing 40 % and above disability
Income certificate showing less than ₹ 60,000/- P.A. income of parents
Copy of the bank account details

scheme_name: Award for Success in State Public Service Commission, Union Public Service Commission Examination (MPBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial incentives ranging from ₹15,000/- to ₹50,000/- to the sons and daughters of registered construction workers who clear the preliminary or main levels of State Public Service Commission or Union Public Service Commission examinations.

scheme_name: Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person
department: Department of Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: This scheme provides a financial cash incentive of ₹2,50,000 to encourage marriages between a person with a benchmark disability and a person without a disability. The incentive aims to help individuals with disabilities lead normal, dignified lives and promotes dowry-free marriages in the state.
required_documents: Self-attested Post Card Size Joint Photograph of the couple
Aadhaar linked joint bank account of husband & wife

scheme_name: Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education
summary: The Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education, launched by the UT of Puducherry, aims to increase the enrollment of girls aged 11-14 and prevent dropouts. Eligible girl students with high attendance and low family income receive an annual scholarship of ₹200 directly through DBT.

scheme_name: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste parents in Puducherry to compensate for the income shortage when they send their daughters to school instead of engaging them in menial labor. It aims to eliminate girl child labor and encourage education by paying an opportunity cost of ₹3,000 per academic year for girls studying in classes VI to XII.
required_documents: Residence-cum-nativity certificate issued by the competent authority

scheme_name: Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students
summary: The Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students by the Government of Puducherry provides a one-time cash award of ₹1,000 to SC students who score 65% or above in their 10th standard board exams. The grant helps students meet initial admission expenses for pursuing post-matric studies.

scheme_name: Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance, fee reimbursement, and maintenance allowances to Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education in Puducherry. Its objective is to help eligible students successfully complete their education.

scheme_name: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students Studying from VI to X Standard in Government Schools and Government recognised Private Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying in classes VI to X in the Union Territory of Puducherry. Its objective is to support their education up to the secondary level and prevent dropouts.
required_documents: Residence-cum-nativity certificate issued by the competent authority

scheme_name: Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to the Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) studying in standards 6 to 10 in Puducherry. The objective is to reduce the dropout rate of students due to financial constraints by offering monthly scholarships disbursed directly through DBT.

scheme_name: Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
summary: The Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to meritorious students studying in the 11th and 12th standards. It aims to ensure that poverty does not become a barrier for brilliant students to continue their academic careers.

scheme_name: Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani
summary: The Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani scheme provides financial assistance of ₹50,000 to eligible artists and authors/writers in fields such as literature, music, dance, drama, painting and sculpture, and folk arts. A total of 30 awards are presented to recognize their contributions and achievements.
required_documents: Degrees / Honours / National and State Level Certificate

scheme_name: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships to students whose parents are engaged in unclean occupations like scavenging, flaying, and tanning. It aims to improve the socio-economic status of unprivileged communities by supporting students from Class 1st to Class 10th irrespective of their income and caste.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment ID with alternative proof
Certificate of Unclean Occupation Obtained From the Employer by the Parent/s
beneficiary_categories: Children of workers in unclean occupations

scheme_name: Atal Sneh Yojana
summary: Atal Sneh Yojana in Gujarat is a health scheme launched to screen newborns for health defects and illnesses up to two months after birth. It provides immediate treatment, medical referrals, and follow-ups by health workers to ensure better health and prevent malnutrition and disorders.
required_documents: Other relevant documents related to health issues

scheme_name: Award of Scholarships to Outstanding NCC Cadets of the UT of Puducherry
summary: The Award of Scholarships to Outstanding NCC Cadets of the UT of Puducherry recognizes and supports outstanding NCC cadets by providing financial assistance. It offers monthly scholarships of ₹500 for Senior Division cadets and ₹250 for Junior Division cadets. The scheme aims to encourage discipline and excellence among NCC cadets in the Union Territory.

scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
summary: The Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students scheme provides financial assistance to students with disabilities in Puducherry to pursue their education. It covers students from the 1st standard up to Postgraduate and Professional courses.
required_documents: Declaration from the Parent or Guardian

scheme_name: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides cash prizes to Scheduled Caste students who secure top ranks at the state and district levels in Standard X and XII examinations across all streams in Gujarat. The initiative aims to encourage academic excellence among SC students without any income limit constraints.
required_documents: Caste Certificate from the Competent Authorities

scheme_name: Awarding of Tamil Mamani, Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna
summary: The Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry provides a cash award of ₹75,000 to authors and writers who have published books of high repute in poetry, prose, and research articles in Tamil, Telugu, or Malayalam. The scheme aims to recognize senior literary figures who are natives or long-term residents of Puducherry.

scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to the Children who are Recipients of National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and Other National / International Merit Awards
summary: This scholarship scheme recognizes and rewards students in the Union Territory of Puducherry who have received National Child Awards or other prestigious national/international merit awards. It provides a financial assistance of ₹6,000 per annum directly to the students' Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through DBT.
required_documents: Relevant Certificates of Exceptional Achievements in Different Fields of Human Resource Development
Application in Respect of the Applicant Outside UT of Puducherry, Countersigned by the Competent Educational Authority

scheme_name: Awards to Bright Students
ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The “Awards to Bright Students” scheme offers financial assistance to the top performing students from Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities in each district who have excelled in their 10th standard public examinations and continue their studies. Beneficiaries receive ₹800/- for the first year and ₹960/- per year for the next five years.

eligibility_rules.value: Adi Dravidar, Tribal, Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity

required_documents: Proof of continuing education after 10th standard

scheme_name: Award of ₹20,000/- to Best Writers
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The scheme aims to recognize and promote literary talent by awarding a cash prize of ₹20,000 to selected unemployed writers. It primarily benefits writers from the Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar Christian-converted communities, as well as one writer from any other community in Tamil Nadu.

eligibility_rules.value: Adi Dravidar, Tribal, Adi Dravidar converted to Christian, Other

required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority)
A copy of the submitted literary work

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme providing a cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. It aims to achieve Universal Health Coverage by targeting vulnerable rural and urban families based on specific deprivation and occupational criteria.

eligibility_rules.value: Rural Deprived Households and Urban Workers

required_documents: Age & Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card)
Document Proof of the Current Status of the Family (Joint or Nuclear)

scheme_name: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
department: BC & EBC Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
summary: The BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School scheme provides quality education along with free accommodation, food, and modern facilities in a safe environment for girl students from backward and extremely backward classes in Bihar. It covers students from Class 6 to Class 12, offering various supportive allowances and skill development programs.

scheme_name: BPL Scholarship for College Students
summary: The BPL Scholarship For College Students provides financial assistance to meritorious students from BPL families pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in government colleges of Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to help students meet their day-to-day expenses during higher studies through direct benefit transfers.

scheme_name: BPL (Below Poverty Line) Student Welfare Scholarship - Technical Education
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of monthly scholarships to economically weaker students belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category studying in government engineering and polytechnic colleges of Chhattisgarh. B.E. students receive ₹1,000/- per month while Diploma students receive ₹500/- per month for up to 10 months in an academic year.
required_documents: Previous Semester Mark Sheet (attested photocopy) (for renewal)
All Previous Passed Mark Sheets (for students who did not receive a scholarship in previous semesters)

scheme_name: BSR Scheme
summary: The Research Fellowship in Sciences for meritorious students BSR scheme of the UGC provides opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences. It offers financial assistance including fellowships, contingencies, and HRA to eligible scholars.
required_documents: Proof of Ph.D. admission in a UGC-recognized university

scheme_name: Back Ended Interest Subsidy (BEIS)
department: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department
summary: The Back Ended Interest Subsidy (BEIS) scheme aims to reduce the financial burdens of new micro and small manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu. It provides a 5% interest subsidy on term loans for a period of 5 years to eligible enterprises that have availed loans for technology upgradation, modernization, or specific credit schemes.
required_documents: Copy of Udyog Aadhaar memorandum/copy of Udyam Certificate
Copy of Loan Sanction letter from the Bank / Financial Institution
Certificate from the bank for the interest claim for each quarter
Bank statement for the interest paid with bank manager attestation

scheme_name: Back-To-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme
summary: The Back-to-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme offers research and post-doctoral support to unemployed women in Kerala who have experienced a career break, facilitating their re-entry into scientific research. The scheme provides a monthly fellowship along with an annual contingency grant for a maximum duration of 2 years.
required_documents: Proof on permanent residency in Kerala
Marks sheet and Certificate of PG
Reprints of latest Research Publications in SCI indexed journal

scheme_name: Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme
department: Kerala State Council of Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE)
summary: The Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme helps women in Kerala who have faced career breaks due to family commitments to re-enter science research and complete their Ph.D. The scheme provides a monthly fellowship and annual contingent grant for up to three years to support their academic pursuits.
required_documents: Marks sheet and Certificate for Post-Graduate Degree Course
Institute Order on sanction of leave during the course of Ph.D programme

scheme_name: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
department: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: The Backward Classes Student Merit Award Scheme recognizes and rewards academic excellence among backward class students in Madhya Pradesh. It provides monetary awards annually to top-scoring boy and girl students at the district level in their class 10th and 12th board examinations.
required_documents: Mark Sheet of Class 10th/12th Board Examination

scheme_name: Bakri Palan Yojana
summary: Bakri Palan Yojana by the Government of Uttarakhand aims to promote self-employment among economically weaker sections through goat rearing. The scheme provides financial assistance to establish a goat-rearing unit comprising 10 female goats and 1 male goat.

scheme_name: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme
department: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: The Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to backward classes for pursuing higher education, postgraduate courses, research degrees (Ph.D.), and post-research degree programs abroad. Eligible candidates receive monetary support to help cover their educational expenses in foreign institutions.

scheme_name: Bal Ashrams
department: Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir
summary: Bal Ashrams provide free schooling, boarding, lodging, clothing, and medical facilities to orphans and destitute children in Jammu and Kashmir. The scheme aims to eliminate child labor and ensure children receive free, compulsory, and quality education in a secure environment.
required_documents: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State/UT of Jammu & Kashmir
Details of the Bank Account of Self or of the Guardian
Death Certificate of the Mother and Father

scheme_name: Bal Sakha Yojana
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The Bal Sakha Yojana provides expert neonatal care and support to newborns from disadvantaged families. A pediatrician attends eligible newborns at birth to ensure survival through early care, immunizations, and nutrition advice.
required_documents: Authorization by a locally recognized authority

scheme_name: Balika Samrithi Yojana
summary: The Balika Samrithi Yojana by the Government of Pondicherry aims to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food. It offers financial assistance of ₹500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate to eligible girl children born on or after August 15, 1997.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department
Aadhaar Enrolment ID (in absence of Aadhaar Card)

scheme_name: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)
summary: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY) provides financial assistance of ₹1,30,000 to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses for constructing pucca houses. The scheme also includes wage support for unskilled labor and assistance for toilet construction, with funds directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.

scheme_name: Balri Birth Gift Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Balri Birth Gift Scheme by the Punjab BOCW Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹51,000 in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) for the birth of up to two female children of registered construction workers. The FDR can only be encashed at the time of the daughter's marriage.

scheme_name: Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
summary: The Awasiya Vidyala Yojana provides free residential education, accommodation, clothing, and food to the children of registered construction workers. The scheme aims to ensure quality primary, junior high school, and secondary education for children aged 6 to 14 years who would otherwise lack access due to poverty.

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: State Capital Investment Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The State Capital Investment Subsidy scheme offers fiscal incentives to micro and small enterprises set up in designated zones (Zone C, D, and E) of West Bengal. It aims to encourage entrepreneurship, balanced industrial development, resource utilization, and employment generation in the MSME sector.

eligibility_rules.value: Micro Enterprise, Small Enterprise, Medium Enterprise

required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies/partnership deed
Statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
Copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Power Subsidy (PS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Power Subsidy scheme is a sub-scheme under Banglashree for MSMEs, offering financial incentives on electricity consumed for manufacturing activities. It aims to encourage the setup of MSMEs, promote balanced regional development, and generate sustainable employment in West Bengal.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
Statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
Copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS) scheme offers financial assistance to eligible micro, small, and medium enterprises in West Bengal by reimbursing 50% of the expenditure incurred for obtaining patent registration up to a maximum of Rs. 5,00,000. It aims to encourage innovation and protect intellectual property among businesses that commenced commercial production on or after 1st April 2019.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
Statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
Copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS) scheme extends fiscal incentives to eligible micro or small enterprises in West Bengal. It reimburses 50% of the expenditure incurred (up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000) for obtaining ISI, BIS, or various ISO/HACCP certifications.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter issued

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST) is a sub-scheme under Banglashree for MSMEs aimed at providing fiscal incentives to eligible micro, small, and medium enterprises in West Bengal. It offers a refund of net SGST paid for a period of 8 years from the date of commencement of commercial production to encourage entrepreneurship and balanced regional development.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed (wherever applicable)
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter issued

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS) scheme under Banglashree for MSMEs provides financial assistance to eligible micro, small, and medium enterprises in the manufacturing sector. It offers an interest subsidy on annual interest liability on term loans borrowed from approved financial institutions to encourage entrepreneurship and balanced development in the state.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS) is a sub-scheme under Banglashree for MSMEs offering financial assistance to micro and small enterprises. It provides reimbursement of employer contributions towards ESI and EPF if at least 50% of the workforce is locally recruited.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
Statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
Copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The 'Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)' scheme reimburses stamp duty and registration fees paid by eligible MSMEs for document registration within West Bengal. It aims to encourage entrepreneurs to establish manufacturing MSMEs, foster balanced regional development, and generate sustainable employment.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter issued

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance (WCS)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance (WCS) scheme provides fiscal incentives to eligible micro and small enterprises in West Bengal. It offers a reimbursement of 50% of the expenditure incurred for setting up captive Effluent Water Treatment Plants or other pollution control devices, up to a maximum of ₹2,00,000.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter issued

scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles
summary: The Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES) scheme offers financial incentives to micro and small enterprises in West Bengal. It provides a reimbursement for the cost of energy audits and energy conservation installations to promote sustainability and energy efficiency.
required_documents: Copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies / partnership deed
A statement on the name and address of the Directors / Partners / Owners of the enterprise / Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups
A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter

scheme_name: Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme is a sub-scheme under NSSH that reimburses SC/ST MSEs for bank charges paid for issuing Performance Bank Guarantees. It provides financial assistance limited to 80% of the charges or ₹1,00,000, whichever is less, per financial year.
required_documents: Copy of Caste Certificate of proprietor/all partners/directors
Details of shareholding in case of partnership / Pvt. Ltd / LLP firm

scheme_name: Banishree Scholarship
ministry: Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department
department: Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department
summary: The Banishree Scheme, introduced by the Government of Odisha, offers special financial allowances and scholarships to students with special needs. It aims to assist and encourage disabled students to pursue primary, higher, distance, technical, professional, or vocational education without financial hurdles.
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Officer
Mark sheets of the last examination passed

scheme_name: Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing a substantial portion of the loan processing fees charged by financial institutions to SC/ST micro and small enterprises (MSEs). The scheme aims to enhance access to capital, promote inclusive economic development, and strengthen the entrepreneurial ecosystem for SC/ST entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Copy of Caste Certificate of proprietor/all partners/directors
Details of shareholding in case of partnership / Pvt. Ltd / LLP firm

scheme_name: Barbershop Renovation Grant
summary: The Barbershop Renovation Grant provides financial assistance up to ₹25,000 to traditional barbers belonging to Other Backward Communities in Kerala. The scheme aims to modernize traditional barbershops, improve working environments and public health, and uplift the standard of living for this community.

scheme_name: Bank Tie-Up Scheme
department: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC)
summary: The Bank Tie-Up Scheme assists permanent Scheduled Caste residents of Punjab living Below Poverty Line by arranging bank loans coupled with capital subsidies up to 50% (maximum ₹ 10,000/-). It aims to provide financial support for income-generating activities through state-sponsored welfare intervention.
required_documents: Application form duly attested by competent Authority
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Punjab
Valuation Certificate of property to be mortgaged

scheme_name: Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
summary: The Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme provides free short-term vocational training to rural educated unemployed youth in agriculture and allied sectors. It aims to develop entrepreneurship skills, generate employment, and offers a monthly stipend along with seed money to start farm-based activities.
required_documents: Bank Pass Book, copy of the first page of the trainee's own functional Bank Savings Account
Two (2) Number of Passport size photographs & 1(one) Stamp Size photograph
Medical fitness certificate from respective PHC/CHC (Original)

scheme_name: Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana
department: Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha
summary: The Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana provides government-assisted pilgrimage opportunities to senior citizens of Odisha aged between 60 and 75 years. It enables poor and deprived pilgrims to visit various pilgrimage centers across the country with support from the state.
required_documents: Antyodaya/ Annapurna card or Ration Card under NFSA or Widow Pension/ Old Age Pension or MGNREGS Job Card or Panchayati Raj Department inclusion/deprivation criteria document

scheme_name: Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
summary: The scheme provides free battery-operated wheelchairs to individuals affected by muscular dystrophy and tetraplegia in the state of Tamil Nadu. Eligible applicants can apply offline by submitting the prescribed form along with the necessary identity card at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme
summary: The Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme, launched by the Government of Punjab in 2011, aims to balance the gender ratio, prevent female feticide, and promote education for girls. It provides financial assistance of up to Rs. 61,000 to eligible families in stages until the girl child reaches 18 years of age.

scheme_name: Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme- Punjab
summary: The Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme by the Government of Punjab aims to provide clean, comfortable, and affordable accommodation for domestic and international tourists while supplementing homeowner income. It registers fully operational rooms in private properties under Gold and Silver categories, allowing tourists to experience the cultural heritage of Punjab.
required_documents: Additional relevant background information, if any (Annexure-IV)
Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card/Driving License/Passport/Voter Card/Govt. ID Card, Ration Card, PAN Card, Pensioner Card, Freedom Fighter Card)
Proof of Ownership (Allotment letter, Conveyance Deed)

scheme_name: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana
summary: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana, launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, encourages farmers to cultivate seed spices like coriander and fenugreek to enhance production and increase their income. The scheme offers a 50% subsidy on the unit cost of spice cultivation along with access to high-quality certified seeds.

scheme_name: Beej Swalamban Yojna
summary: Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana provides up to 50% subsidy on seeds for small and marginal general farmers and free mini kits for farmers below the poverty line. The scheme aims to encourage farmers to produce their own quality seeds, reducing cultivation costs and promoting agricultural self-reliance.

scheme_name: Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This initiative offers free distribution of Behind-the-Ear (BTE) hearing aids to improve speech capabilities. It specifically targets students from the 6th standard onwards, self-employed individuals, and employed persons with hearing impairments.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: Berojgari Bhatta Yojna
summary: The Berojgari Bhatta Yojna provides financial assistance in the form of unemployment allowance ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 1,500 to educated and unemployed youth of the state until they secure a desired job. It also facilitates online access to private and government job listings through a dedicated portal.

scheme_name: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana
summary: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana is a welfare scheme by the Himachal Pradesh Government providing financial assistance to girl children from BPL families. The government deposits Rs. 21,000 at birth and offers annual scholarships ranging from Rs. 450 to Rs. 5000 to support their education and make them self-reliant.
required_documents: Proof of Date of Birth of the Applicant
Letter from Head Master of the School of the applicant

scheme_name: Bhagwan Budhdh Scholarship
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat
summary: The Bhagwan Budhdh Scholarship is an initiative by the Gujarat government to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste girls for pursuing post-SSC higher education. It supports students who may not be eligible for the standard Post-SSC Scholarship due to parental income limits or family size criteria.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhar card, Voter ID, College ID, etc.)
Residence proof (PAN card, Residence certificate, etc.)
Bank details (Account number, IFSC, MICR code)

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education provides financial assistance of ₹7,000/- per academic year to poor Brahmin students studying in classes 6th to 10th in Andhra Pradesh. It aims to encourage students from the Brahmin community to continue their education, with priority given to orphans, differently-abled students, and children of single parents.
required_documents: Aadhar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number

scheme_name: Bhagyalaxmi Scheme
summary: The Karnataka Bhagya Lakshmi Scheme provides financial assistance and health insurance to female children born in Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. The scheme aims to promote the birth of girl children, prevent child labor, and support their education and upbringing.
required_documents: Application form of the Bhagya Laxmi Scheme
Certified copy of the birth certificate of the girl child
Address proof of the parents of the girl child
Bank details of the girl child card
Photograph of a child with parents

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation provides financial assistance of ₹15,000 to eligible poor Brahmin students in Andhra Pradesh pursuing regular 3-year graduation courses. The scheme aims to encourage students to continue their higher education.

eligibility_rules.value: cleared all subjects of previous year

required_documents: Aadhar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number
Marks Sheets of all the Previous Years

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to poor Brahmin students studying in classes 1st to 5th in Andhra Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage students from the Brahmin community to continue their education and supports eligible families with an annual income below ₹3,00,000/-.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Intermediate or Equivalent
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education provides financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to eligible poor Brahmin students in Andhra Pradesh pursuing Intermediate or equivalent courses like ITI, Polytechnic, D.Ed, TTC, and D.Pharmacy. The scheme aims to encourage students to continue their education and is applicable across all districts of Andhra Pradesh.
required_documents: Aadhar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number
Marks Sheets of all the Previous Years

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 to eligible poor Brahmin students from Andhra Pradesh pursuing professional courses of 4 years or more duration across India. The scheme aims to encourage higher education among the Brahmin community by easing financial burdens.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number
Marks Sheets of all Previous Years

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to eligible poor Brahmin students in Andhra Pradesh pursuing post-graduation courses of 2 years or more. The scheme aims to encourage students to continue their higher education.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number
Study Certificate from the College / Institute / University
Marks Sheets of all the previous years

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to eligible poor Brahmin students in Andhra Pradesh to help them pursue their CA Final education. The scheme aims to encourage higher professional education among the Brahmin community in the state.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Student & Parents
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number
Proof of registration and fees paid for the CA Final exam

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas
summary: The Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas provides one-time financial assistance to eligible Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh pursuing Master's degree courses abroad. Financial aid ranges from ₹5,00,000 to ₹10,00,000 depending on the duration of the course.
required_documents: Senior Secondary Certificate and Qualifying Degree Certificate
SB Account Passbook in Andhra Bank or State Bank of India
Proof of Admission and Fees paid into any Master’s Degree Course Overseas

scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern
summary: The Bharati Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 to eligible poor Brahmin students in Andhra Pradesh pursuing the Chartered Accountancy Intermediate (IPCC) course. It aims to encourage students from the Brahmin community to continue their professional education.

eligibility_rules.value: Received APBWC benefit for same exam earlier

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Student & Parents (with address in Andhra Pradesh)
White Ration Card / Income Certificate Number (issued by Mee Seva)
Proof of CPT clearance OR Graduation Certificate
Proof of registration and fees paid for CA-Inter

scheme_name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana
summary: The Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana protects horticultural farmers in Haryana from market price fluctuations by compensating them with the price difference if they sell their produce below the protected price. It covers 21 specific fruit and vegetable crops to reduce financial risk and encourage agricultural diversification.
required_documents: Proof of land ownership or lease agreement
Registration proof from the Meri Fasal, Mera Byora portal
J-Form for the sale of produce
Bank account details linked with Aadhaar

scheme_name: Bhargava Matching Scheme
summary: The Bhargava Matching Scheme provides matching financial funds to individuals, groups, or organizations representing the Brahmin community in Andhra Pradesh. It aims to create permanent assets like community halls and old age homes, and supports socially relevant activities in education, skill development, and healthcare.
required_documents: Passport-size Photo of a representative of the Society/Trust
Title deed of land, Possession Certificate, and Photo of the land
Project Report along with cost estimation statement
Bank A/c Passbook of Society/Trust with 50% cost deposited

scheme_name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme
summary: The Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme provides financial assistance and subsidies through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to farmers in Maharashtra for the plantation of 16 perennial fruit crops. The financial aid is disbursed over three years, provided the beneficiary maintains a minimum plant survival rate of 80% in the first year and 90% in the second year.

scheme_name: Bhraman - Darshan Yojana
summary: The Bhraman-Darshan Yojana provides fish farmers in Bihar with a two-day educational tour within the state to learn about the latest fisheries techniques. The initiative aims to help participants adopt modern technologies, increase fish production, create new employment opportunities, and boost their annual income.

scheme_name: Bhed Palan Yojana
summary: Bhed Palan Yojana by the Government of Uttarakhand promotes self-employment among economically weaker sections through sheep rearing. It provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for establishing a sheep-rearing unit consisting of 10 female and 1 male sheep.

scheme_name: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan
department: Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) Department
summary: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA) is an umbrella scheme by the Government of Odisha aimed at promoting inclusivity, equal opportunities, and socio-economic rehabilitation for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). The scheme focuses on grassroots empowerment, expanding rehabilitation outreach, and supporting employment, self-employment, and socio-educational services.

scheme_name: Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Bicycle Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 to registered construction workers in Haryana for the purchase of a bicycle once every 3 years. To be eligible, workers must have a minimum of one year of continuous membership with the welfare board.

eligibility_rules.value: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: An undertaking for purchase of cycle giving price, trademark, source, and date

scheme_name: Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section
summary: The Bicycle Distribution Scheme by the Government of Rajasthan provides free bicycles to 5,800 girl students from the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8. The initiative aims to facilitate their daily commute between home and school and encourage continued education.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card of the Student

scheme_name: Bicycle Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Bicycle Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000 to registered workers in industrial and commercial establishments in Haryana to purchase a new bicycle for commuting to work. Workers can avail of this benefit once every five years during their service period.

eligibility_rules.value: registered with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

scheme_name: Bicycle/Sewing Machine Assistance Scheme
department: Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB)
summary: The Bicycle/Sewing Machine Assistance Scheme provides bicycles to registered construction workers in plain areas and sewing machines to registered workers or their dependents in hilly areas of Uttarakhand. This one-time welfare benefit is offered to registered members who have maintained active membership and completed at least three months since registration.

eligibility_rules.value: Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board

required_documents: Certificate of working as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the previous year
Affidavit of construction worker attested by notary
Nominee’s Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Bidya Lakshmi Loan
summary: The Bidya Lakshmi scheme by the Government of Assam provides higher education loans ranging from ₹5,00,000 to ₹10,00,000 at a 4% interest rate for the children of regular State Government employees. It covers professional and technical programs in India and abroad, with additional benefits for lower-income employees under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).

eligibility_rules.value: regular State Government Employee of Assam

required_documents: Electricity Bill or Landline Telephone Bill
Mark sheets and Pass Certificates up to the last qualifying examinations
Offer letter/Bonafide certificate from the institution
Prospectus of the Course and Approval copy AICTE/UGC

scheme_name: Big Loan Scheme
ministry: Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi
department: Delhi Scheduled Castes/Other Backward Classes/Minorities & Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation Limited (DSFDC)
summary: The Big Loan Scheme provides term loans up to ₹5,00,000 to marginalized groups including SC, OBC, Minorities, Safai Karamcharis, and Persons with Disabilities in Delhi for setting up income-generating activities. It aims to foster entrepreneurship and economic independence among these vulnerable populations through financial assistance.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Caste, Other Backward Classes, Minority, Safai Karamchari, Disability

required_documents: Copy of Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes/Other Backward Classes/Persons with Disabilities Certificate or Affidavit for Minority Community
Copy of Aadhaar Card as Proof of Identity and Residence
Income Certificate Issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate

scheme_name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojna
summary: The Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojna provides financial assistance to farmers in Bihar whose crops are damaged due to natural calamities like floods and droughts. It covers specific crops based on yield reduction rates compared to the threshold yield rate.
required_documents: Land Possession Certificate / Revenue Receipt of land should be after 31-03-2022
Self-declaration certificate attested by ward member/farmer advisor

scheme_name: Bihar Disability Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
summary: The Bihar Disability Pension Scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹400/- to persons with disabilities who are not covered under the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme. The scheme aims to offer social security to differently-abled individuals from poor families in the state through Direct Benefit Transfer.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Voter ID Card, Driving License

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries
summary: The scheme aims to provide social security and financial assistance of ₹5,000 to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector of Bihar who suffer accidental injuries. It covers medical assistance and requires proof of residency, age, hospitalization, and the accident.
required_documents: Copy of information given to the police station about the accident or certificate of the Mukhiya/Ward Councilor
Proof of age (Aadhaar card, voter card, etc.)
Certificate issued by the Mukhiya/Ward Member

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi AIDS Pirit Kalyan Yojana
summary: The Bihar Shatabdi AIDS Pirit Kalyan Yojana provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 to AIDS patients residing in Bihar. Fully funded by the state government, its objective is to support the livelihood and medical needs of individuals living with AIDS.
required_documents: Identity proof (e.g., Voter ID Card, Driving License, etc.)

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Death
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to registered workers and artisans in the unorganized sector of Bihar in the unfortunate event of accidental death. It aims to offer social security and support to the families of affected unorganized sector workers and craftsmen.
required_documents: Certificate of dependents issued by the Zonal Officer
Death certificate issued by the competent authority
Copy of information given in the police station regarding the accident or certificate given by the Mukhiya/Ward Councillor

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
summary: This scheme provides medical financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500 to ₹30,000 for workers and artisans in the unorganized sector of Bihar suffering from incurable diseases. It aims to offer social security and support during severe health crises.
required_documents: Certificate from the doctor or hospital providing treatment
Proof of age (Aadhar Card, Voter Card etc.)
Certificate issued by the Mukhiya/Ward Member of Panchayat/Member Panchayat Samiti or concerned Ward Councillor specifying the nature of work

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Natural Death
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹30,000 to the dependents of registered unorganized sector workers and artisans in Bihar in the event of their natural death. It aims to offer social security to vulnerable worker families.
required_documents: Certificate of dependents issued by the Zonal Officer
Death certificate issued by the competent authority
Proof of age of the deceased (Aadhar card, voter card etc.)
Certificate issued by the concerned Mukhiya/Ward Member of Panchayat/Member of Panchayat Committee or Ward Councillor of the concerned urban area

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Total Permanent Disability
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹75,000/- to unorganized sector workers and craftsmen in Bihar who suffer a total permanent disability due to an accident or specified medical conditions. It aims to offer social security and support to affected workers and artisans in the state.
required_documents: Proof of age (Aadhar Card, Voter Card etc.)
One photograph showing the disability status of the applicant
Copy of information given to the police station about the accident or certificate issued by the Mukhiya/Ward Councillor

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme
summary: The Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month to leprosy patients living in Bihar who have Visible Deformities Grade-II. The fully state-funded scheme aims to support the livelihood and welfare of affected individuals.

eligibility_rules.value: Leprosy patient with Visible Deformities Grade-II

required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Voter ID Card, Driving License
Medical reports/documents related to Visible Deformities Grade-II

scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹37,500 to unorganized sector workers and craftsmen in Bihar who suffer a permanent partial disability due to an accident or paralysis. It aims to offer social security and support to vulnerable workers in the state.
required_documents: Proof of age (Aadhar Card, Voter Card etc.)
One photograph showing the disability status of the applicant
Copy of information given to the police station about the accident or certificate issued by the Mukhiya/Ward Councillor regarding the accident

scheme_name: Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
department: Minority Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
summary: The Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana provides free residential education from Class 9 to Class 12 to meritorious students belonging to minority communities in Bihar. The scheme ensures all-round development by offering free accommodation, food, clothing, books, and modern educational facilities.
required_documents: Proof of age i.e. birth certificate

scheme_name: Bihar Startup Policy
summary: The Bihar Startup Policy aims to boost entrepreneurship and accelerate MSME growth in the state. It offers interest-free loans of up to 10 lakh rupees as seed money for ten years, along with enhanced incentives for female entrepreneurs.

scheme_name: Bihar State Journalist Insurance Scheme
