summary: The Bihar State Journalist Insurance Scheme provides financial benefits up to ₹5,00,000 through group mediclaim and personal accident insurance to working media representatives and their families. The government covers 80% of the insurance premium while the beneficiary contributes 20%.
required_documents: Photocopy of Registration Number of the Institution

scheme_name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
summary: The Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹4 lakhs to students for pursuing higher education in authorized institutes. The scheme offers educational loans at minimal interest rates to help students cover course fees, books, and laptops.
required_documents: Xth and XIIth mark sheet and certificate
Copies of the letter conferring scholarship
Previous two year’s income tax return
Proof of residence (Passport, ID, driving license, Voter ID)

scheme_name: Bihar State Madarsa Strengthening Scheme
summary: The Bihar State Madarsa Strengthening Scheme provides essential infrastructure and facilities to recognized Madarsas in Bihar to improve educational quality. The support includes constructing buildings, classrooms, hostels, and laboratories to enhance the learning environment.
required_documents: Approval letter received from Madrasa Board
Original copy of L.P.C of the land belonging to the Zonal Officer
A copy of the proceedings of the Madrasa Management Committee related to the approval of the proposed plan
Maximum 5 photographs of the current building/structure/premises
A photograph of the land designated for the proposal
A visual map of the land designated for the scheme

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Bravery Award
summary: The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award recognizes spectacular acts of bravery performed by citizens. It is awarded annually by the Government of Odisha and includes a cash prize of ₹1,00,000, a silver medal, and a scroll.
required_documents: First Information Report (FIR) or Police Diary filed with the Police Station
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the act of bravery

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching
summary: The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching honours coaches who have dedicated their careers to coaching major sports disciplines and helped sportspersons achieve excellence at national and international levels. Selected coaches receive a cash award of ₹1,00,000, a statue, a scroll of honour, and a blazer with a tie.
required_documents: Details of Career as a Coach (Supported documents)
Details of Qualification as a Coach (Necessary documents)
Details regarding the Sports person(s) who have achieved excellence at National/International recognized competitions under his/her Coaching and guidance
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the claim for the award

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Best Contribution to Promotion of Sports and Games
summary: The Biju Patnaik Sports Award honors individuals and organizations in Odisha for their substantial contributions to the promotion of sports and games. It aims to encourage sports development and inspire young talents by recognizing exceptional service in areas like sports administration, support staff, recruitment, and financial sponsorship.
required_documents: Details of the achievement along with supporting documents/papers
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the claim for the award
Details of the achievement of the organization along with supporting documents

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Sports Journalism
summary: The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Sports Journalism is a state-level award launched by the Government of Odisha to honor journalists who have done significant work in promoting sports and games. The award carries a cash prize of ₹1,00,000, along with a statue, scroll of honor, and a blazer with a tie.
required_documents: Attested photocopy of Accreditation Certificate, if applicable
Details of Sports competition/Championships covered by the applicant including profiles of Sports persons
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the claim for the award

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games for the Year
summary: The Biju Patnaik Sports Award honours meritorious sportspersons of Odisha who have achieved outstanding performance in recognized sports disciplines. The award aims to encourage sports development in the state, motivate young talents, and includes a cash prize of ₹2,00,000 along with a statue, scroll of honour, and blazer.
required_documents: Performance in detail in the field of Sports & Games

scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Lifetime Achievement in Promotion of Sports & Games
summary: The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Lifetime Achievement is the highest sports honour of the Government of Odisha. It is awarded to retired sportspersons with commendable national and international performances who have continuously contributed to the promotion of sports and games in the state.
required_documents: Performance in detail in the field of Sports & Games in previous years at the State/National/International level supported with photocopies of documents
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the claim for the award

scheme_name: Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana
summary: The Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana aims to convert all Kutcha houses into Pucca houses in rural areas of Odisha in a mission-mode approach. It provides financial assistance and incentives to eligible rural households living in Kutcha houses to construct durable Pucca homes.

scheme_name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana aims to provide universal health coverage with financial protection for vulnerable families and women in Odisha. It offers free healthcare services in all State Government health facilities and cashless treatment up to Rs. 5 lakh per family (and an additional Rs. 5 lakh for women members) in empaneled private hospitals for eligible cardholders.

eligibility_rules.value: BSKY Smart Health Card / NFSA / SFSS card holders

scheme_name: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana
summary: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹30,000 directly to 15,000 meritorious +2 and Upshastri students in Odisha for the purchase of a laptop. The scheme aims to empower youth through digital inclusion via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
required_documents: Passbook of Bank Account with Account Number and IFSC Code of the Bank Branch
Admit Card / Hall Ticket of CHSE Exam or Sanskrit Exam

scheme_name: Bima Yojana - Direct Benefit to Artisan
summary: The Bima Yojana - Direct Benefit to Artisan (BYDBTA) scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹8,000 per month to senior and award-winning artisans to ensure their financial security. It supports master craftsperson who have received prestigious awards like Shilp Guru or National Awards. Applications are processed offline through the nearest Handicrafts Service Centre.

scheme_name: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana
summary: The Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana provides comprehensive social security benefits including provident fund, medical assistance, maternity benefits, pension, and death benefits to unorganised workers in West Bengal. It covers various categories of workers such as construction, transport, and self-employed individuals to improve their livelihood and financial security.

scheme_name: Biotechnology Career Advancement And Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme For Women Scientists
summary: The BioCARe Programme aims to enhance the participation of women scientists in India by providing their first sanctioned extramural research funding in biotechnology and allied areas. It is designed to help unemployed female scientists re-enter the scientific mainstream and establish a strong professional foothold.
required_documents: Proof of the All the Educational Qualification (Degree Certificate, and Marksheets)
Proof of passing any National level examinations (NET-CSIR/NET-UGC/GATE/DBT JRF)

scheme_name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme
summary: The Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme (BIG) by BIRAC invests in innovative ideas in the biotech sector with clear commercial potential. It provides grant-in-aid and mentoring to support individual entrepreneurs and start-ups from ideation to Proof of Concept.
required_documents: Letter of commitment from Scientific Advisors/Mentors
Letter of intent of key members of the technical team
Letter of interest/intent from the incubator
Evidence of access to the unique facility needed to execute the project
Evidence of access to key samples needed
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the competent authority if employed or a student

scheme_name: Biotechnology Post-Doctoral Fellowship
summary: The Biotechnology Post-Doctoral Fellowship (BPDF) programme provides monthly stipends and contingent grants to young researchers who have completed their PhD in biotechnology and related fields. It aims to promote independent research under the mentorship of eminent scientists and faculty in reputed institutions.
required_documents: Educational certificates/P.G. Mark list and Certificate
Undertaking regarding not availing financial assistance stipend

scheme_name: Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award
summary: The Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award (BYE) is an annual competition and workshop designed to promote the commercialisation of bioscience ideas and encourage biotechnology entrepreneurship among students. Participants develop a Business Plan judged by experts, and winning teams receive cash awards along with potential facilitation to establish start-ups.

eligibility_rules.value: Biotechnology, bioinformatics, Molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, Genetics, life sciences

required_documents: Certificate from head of the institution

scheme_name: Biponi Scheme
summary: The Biponi scheme by the Government of Assam promotes small businesses, farmers, and artisans by providing financial assistance, market infrastructure development, and training. It aims to create an efficient market ecosystem and facilitate better market linkages and credit facilities.
required_documents: Copy of cancelled cheque with the name of the proprietor printed
Quotation from the fair organization regarding rent to be submitted

scheme_name: Bio Control Laboratory and Pesticides Testing Laboratory Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
summary: The Bio Control Laboratory and Pesticides Testing Laboratory Scheme produces and distributes bio control agents like Trichoderma and Trichogramma to farmers for free. Its objective is to promote organic crop production and plant health management through awareness and demonstration.
required_documents: Proof of having sufficient available cultivable land

scheme_name: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana
department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority & Backward Class Welfare
summary: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,31,500 in three installments to economically weaker Scheduled Tribe families in rural Jharkhand for constructing durable houses. The scheme also includes incentives for local monitoring to ensure timely construction and quality management.

scheme_name: Block Level Institute for Rural Skill Acquisition (BIRSA)
ministry: Ministry of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
summary: The Block Level Institute for Rural Skill Acquisition (BIRSA) is a component of the Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana in Jharkhand, providing free, localized non-residential skill training to rural youth. It aims to enhance employability and self-employment opportunities by offering diverse training trades across multiple districts and blocks.

scheme_name: Boarding House Stipend Scheme (Tripura Govt.)
department: Tribal Welfare Department, Directorate of Tribal Welfare, Govt. of Tripura
summary: The Boarding House Stipend Scheme provides financial assistance and accommodation support to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in Tripura studying in classes 1st to 12th. It aims to improve the educational scenario, reduce dropout rates, and provide residential facilities for students living far from their schools.
required_documents: School admission Document / School ID Card

scheme_name: Boneej Scheme
summary: The Boneej Scheme is a flagship program of the Government of Assam aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and generating employment opportunities for youth. It provides financial assistance, seed money, and support services such as training and mentoring to eligible rural entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Copy of the First page of the Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to the Cadets Belonging to UT of Puducherry and Studying in Rashtriya Indian Military College, Dehradun
department: Directorate of School Education, Union Territory of Puducherry
summary: This scheme provides an annual scholarship of ₹20,000/- to economically weak cadets from the Union Territory of Puducherry who are studying at the Rashtriya Indian Military College, Dehradun. The financial assistance is disbursed directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-seeded bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer.
required_documents: Certificate of Admission issued by the Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun

scheme_name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
summary: The Birsa Harit Gram Yojana aims to promote afforestation and provide sustainable livelihood opportunities for marginalized communities in Jharkhand. It conducts block and linear plantation activities on common and private lands, benefiting vulnerable groups while improving green cover and generating rural employment.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Primitive Tribes, Below Poverty Line (BPL)

scheme_name: Book Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
summary: This scheme provides financial allowances for the purchase of books to the wards of unemployed ex-servicemen or their widows studying in government-recognized institutions. Beneficiaries receive varying amounts annually based on their level of education, ranging from school to professional courses.

eligibility_rules.value: Ward of Unemployed Ex-Serviceman / Ward of Widow of Ex-Serviceman

required_documents: Identity Card of the ESM / Widow of the ESM
Proof of Successful Completion of the Course
Certificate from the Institute (In case of Management Quota)
Certificate showing breakdown of fees signed by the head of the institution (where fee is collected in lump sum)

scheme_name: Book Bank Scheme: II
ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Book Bank Scheme: II provides free access to textbooks for Adi Dravidar and Tribal students pursuing professional courses in Tamil Nadu. Textbooks are purchased by the government and made available in educational institution libraries for students receiving Government of India scholarships.
required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority)
Proof of enrollment in a professional course
Proof of Scholarship received from the Government of India

scheme_name: Border Areas Development Programme
summary: The Border Areas Development Programme aims to meet the special developmental needs and well-being of people living in remote and inaccessible areas near the International Boundary. It provides essential infrastructure in areas like basic infrastructure, health, education, agriculture, water resources, financial inclusion, and skill development.

eligibility_rules.value: within 0-10 Km distance from International Boundary

scheme_name: Book Bank Scheme: I
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Book Bank Scheme: I provides free access to textbooks for professional course students belonging to Adi Dravidar and Tribal communities in Tamil Nadu. Beneficiaries can use the books throughout their course duration by borrowing them from educational institution libraries, provided they receive a Government of India scholarship.
required_documents: Proof of enrollment in a professional course

scheme_name: Book Binder Training by Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme provides free annual book binding training to visually impaired candidates at the Government Higher Secondary School in Poonamallee. It is designed to impart essential vocational skills to enhance employment opportunities for differently abled individuals.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Border Areas Scholarship
summary: The Border Areas Scholarship provides financial assistance to students hailing from notified international border areas in Meghalaya. It aims to support economically disadvantaged students so they can continue their education without interruption.

scheme_name: Breed Multiplication Farm Entrepreneurship
summary: The scheme offers a 50% capital subsidy (limited to Rs. 2.00 Crore) to entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, and companies for establishing breed multiplication farms to produce elite, disease-free heifers using advanced breeding technologies like sexed semen or IVF. It aims to make high-yielding indigenous and exotic cattle and buffalo breeds available to farmers while serving as a training center.

eligibility_rules.value: entrepreneur-aggregator, private individual, SHG, FPO, FCO, JLG, Section 8 company

required_documents: Copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Partnership Deed, if any
Copy of Aadhar card along with a Bank statement (for individuals)
Certificate of experience in breeding and rearing of dairy animals from the local Govt. Veterinarian
Copy of ownership document or lease deed
Commitment letter from the supplier of feed and fodder

scheme_name: Buffalo Entrepreneurship Development Scheme
department: Fisheries and Animal Resources Development Department, Government of Odisha
summary: The Buffalo Entrepreneurship Development Scheme aims to enhance livestock productivity and milk production among marginalized farmers, entrepreneurs, and SHG members in Odisha. It provides financial subsidies for purchasing Graded Murrah She Buffaloes and constructing sheds for eligible beneficiaries across all 30 districts of the state.

scheme_name: Building And Other Construction Scholarship
department: Department of Skill Development & Technical Education
summary: The Building And Other Construction Scholarship provides financial support to SC category students pursuing technical education or ITI/Polytechnic courses in Odisha. It aims to offer social and economic welfare to help students carry out their technical studies successfully based on their merit records.
required_documents: Copy of passbook of Bank account with the account number and IFSC code of the bank branch
College Id Card of the Student
Annual Contribution Certificate of Parent/ guardian
The Marksheet of the last exam passed

scheme_name: Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana
department: Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Federation Limited
summary: This scheme provides monetary incentives to talented children of weaver families in Chhattisgarh who achieve 60% or more marks in their 10th and 12th board examinations. It aims to encourage and motivate the children of weavers for higher education.
required_documents: Attested Copy of Marksheet of 10th or 12th Board Examination
Passport Size Photograph of the Applicant
Verification From the Primary Weaver Cooperative Society About the Membership Status of the Parent
Details of Any Previous Incentive Rewards Received (if Applicable)

scheme_name: Bunkar Parivar Sahayata Yojana
department: Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union Limited, Raipur
summary: The Bunkar Parivar Sahayata Yojana provides immediate financial assistance of ₹20,000 to the families of working weavers in case of their untimely death. The scheme aims to offer financial security to the heirs of weaver members belonging to primary weaver cooperative societies affiliated with the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Union.
required_documents: Photocopy of Membership Register Confirming Society Membership
Certificate of Being a Working Weaver in the Society
Valid Heir to Whom Assistance Amount is to be Provided
Photocopy of Ration Card as Proof of Being a Family Member

scheme_name: Burial Ground-Provision of Burial Grounds and Pathway to Burial Grounds
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: This scheme supports Adi Dravidar and Tribal communities in Tamil Nadu by providing burial grounds and pathways in areas lacking these facilities. It ensures access to dignified burial services and promotes social welfare and respect for cultural practices.

scheme_name: Braille Watches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
summary: The scheme distributes free braille watches to working visually impaired persons in the unorganized sector to help them reach their workplace on time. Applications are accepted offline through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: Bus Passes for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The scheme provides a 50% reimbursement of travelling costs for registered construction workers who travel by bus in search of work. It aims to support registered building and other construction workers by easing their daily commute expenses.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Bus Traveling Facility For Visually Impaired/Bus Concession
summary: The scheme provides free travel facilities in DTC buses for persons with vision impairment who reside in Delhi. Additionally, a 50% fare concession is provided to the escort or attendant of applicants who have 100% blindness.
required_documents: Identity card i.e. Aadhaar card etc.

scheme_name: Buti Foundation Award
summary: The Buti Foundation Award is a biennial award established to recognize innovative and outstanding research in the field of Plasma Science & Technology. It honors scientists and engineers under the age of 45 for their significant contributions with a medal and a cash prize of ₹50,000.
required_documents: Reprints of Five Important Publications (e-files only)

scheme_name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
summary: The Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) aims to facilitate employment generation by assisting unemployed youth in establishing new manufacturing, service, or agro-based ventures. It provides financial assistance through bank term loans and government subsidies based on the project cost and beneficiary category.

scheme_name: CIFE - Institutional Fellowship
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The ICAR-Central Institute of Fisheries Education (CIFE) offers Institutional Fellowships, such as the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), for students pursuing Master's and Ph.D. degrees in fisheries sciences. The fellowship provides a monthly stipend of Rs. 5760/- along with an annual contingent grant for research-related expenses.

eligibility_rules.value: Bachelor's Degree in the concerned field for Master's or Master's degree for Ph.D.

scheme_name: CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme
summary: The CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme provides financial assistance to talented students from reserved and economically weaker sections in Rajasthan for coaching for various competitive examinations like UPSC, RPSC, IIT, and IIM. It aims to support eligible candidates in achieving higher education and securing government jobs.

scheme_name: Calipers and Crutches - Tamil Nadu
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Calipers and Crutches scheme provides free distribution of mobility aids such as calipers and crutches to needy and deserving orthopedically differently-abled persons. The initiative aims to facilitate easy mobility for individuals with orthopedic disabilities in Tamil Nadu.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH): Pre-Matric Remedial Coaching
summary: The CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH) provides free-of-cost remedial coaching in English, Mathematics, and Science to students from minority, OBC, or SC communities in Manipur. The scheme aims to help academically weak students achieve higher grades and marks in their studies.
required_documents: Proof of Age / Date of Birth
Income Certificate of the Parent / Guardian
Proof of the Current Education Qualification
Details of the Bank Account (account holder's name, account number, and IFSC code)

scheme_name: Campus Recruitment Assistance Scheme
summary: The Campus Recruitment Assistance Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 per fresher to eligible IT units in Goa that recruit freshers through campus placements from educational institutes within the state. The initiative aims to promote Goa as a preferred human resource and investment base for IT units.
required_documents: Copy of new unit registration document/certificate
Copies of PAN, Aadhaar, and GST TIN
Copy of first bill generated showing the date of commencement of operations or other relevant document
Details of employees and percentage of employees of Goan origin
Letter(s) from Training and Placement Cell

scheme_name: Cancer Suraksha Scheme
summary: The Cancer Suraksha Scheme provides free cancer treatment up to an expenditure ceiling of ₹50,000 for children under the age of 18 belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Kerala. Registered patients receive cashless treatment at designated government hospitals using funds deposited by the Mission.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar/ Proof of Identity of patient
Proof of age of the patient
Proof/report confirming the diagnosis of cancer
Registered Patient Card under the scheme

scheme_name: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Entrepreneurship Programme
summary: The Entrepreneurship Programme under the CBSP umbrella scheme provides financial assistance to designated institutes to conduct 150-hour entrepreneurship development courses in tourism and hospitality trades. It targets citizens aged 18 and above who have passed at least Class 8th to enhance their skills and market acceptability.
required_documents: Marksheet of Class 8th or Higher Educational Qualification
Bank Loan / MUDRA Loan / e-wallet Receipts / Licenses

scheme_name: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification
summary: The Skill Testing & Certification scheme provides financial assistance to conduct skilling, re-skilling, and capacity enhancement programs for tourism service providers. It aims to train and upgrade manpower at all levels to capitalize on tourism potential, provide professional expertise, and create employment opportunities in both urban and rural areas.
required_documents: Marksheet of Class 8th or Higher Educational Qualification
Details of the Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account
beneficiary_categories: Workers from roadside food outlets, dhabas, and kiosks

scheme_name: Capital Contribution Scheme (Goa)
summary: The Capital Contribution Scheme provides financial support up to ₹1,00,00,000/- to local entrepreneurs, existing functional units, and industrial units utilizing locally developed technology in Goa. It aims to encourage business expansion, research and development, and industrial growth within the state.
required_documents: Copy of Permanent Registration Certificate or necessary proof of registration with the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Audited Statement of Accounts of the preceding 3 years
Post-dated cheques for repayment as security towards the amount sanctioned
Collateral security equal to the quantum of contribution sought

scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme
summary: The Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme aims to provide capital investment subsidies to eligible Information Technology units in Goa. It offers financial assistance up to 20% on capital investments for new office spaces, with an additional 10% for mega businesses, to promote Goa as an IT destination.
required_documents: Copy of new unit registration document/certificate
Copies of PAN, Aadhaar, and GST TIN
Copy of first bill generated showing the date of commencement of operations or other relevant document
Occupancy certificate from developer/local authority for said office space
3 year business plan / detailed project report

scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme for Goan Diaspora
summary: The Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme for Goan Diaspora offers a capital investment subsidy of up to 20% for new IT units developing office spaces in Goa. It aims to position Goa as a preferred destination for IT investments and expansion by the Goan Diaspora.

eligibility_rules.value: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, Limited Liability Partnership

required_documents: Copy of new unit registration document/certificate
Copies of PAN, Aadhaar and GST TIN
Copy of first bill generated showing the date of commencement of operations or other relevant document
Occupancy certificate from developer/local authority for said office space

scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy: Thrust Area Industries
department: Department of Industrial Development (Industries and Commerce)
summary: This scheme provides a capital investment subsidy on plant and machinery to eligible thrust area industries in the Union Territory of Puducherry. It aims to motivate entrepreneurs to start industries, offering 20% subsidy up to ₹20,00,000 for large and medium enterprises, and 35% up to ₹30,00,000 for small and micro enterprises.
required_documents: Caste certificate from the competent authority in the case of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST) Entrepreneurs
Plan Approval from the Pollution Control Board (PPA)

scheme_name: Capital Subsidy
department: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department
summary: The Capital Subsidy scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu assists MSMEs by providing financial support for capital procurement. It offers a 25% subsidy on eligible plant and machinery costs for Micro Manufacturing Enterprises and Small and Medium Enterprises, along with additional subsidies for specific categories like women, SC/ST, and differently-abled entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Copy of Sanction Order from Tamil Nadu Electricity Board (T.N.E.B) for Power Supply with Copy of Meter Card
Copy of Invoices, Cash Bills, and Stamped Receipt Duly Attested
Certificate of Chartered Accountant (CCA) for Fixed Assets created as of the date of commencement of commercial production in the prescribed form (Annexure-A)

scheme_name: Cash Award (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Cash Award scheme offers financial incentives ranging from ₹3,500 to ₹5,000 to children of registered construction workers in Assam who score 55% or above in HSLC, AHM, and H.S. examinations. Awards are distributed to top-performing male and female students across each district.
required_documents: Attested Copy of the ID Card of the Father/Mother
Attested Copy of the Pass Certificate from the Head of the Institution
Attested Copy of the Mark sheet of the Exam
Copy of Payslip of Account Paybook

scheme_name: Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations
summary: This scheme provides cash awards ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 to the top three rank holders in public examinations such as SSLC, SSC, Matriculation, HSC, and Intermediate (2nd Year). It aims to encourage academic excellence among students studying in schools or junior colleges within the Union Territory of Puducherry.

scheme_name: Cash Award to the Meritorious Visually Impaired Students Obtaining First Three Ranks at the State Level in the SSLC and HSC Examination
summary: This scheme provides cash awards ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 to meritorious visually impaired students who secure the first three ranks at the state level in SSLC and HSC examinations in Puducherry. The initiative aims to encourage and recognize the academic achievements of students with visual disabilities studying in government and private schools.

scheme_name: Cash Award (MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
summary: The Cash Award scheme by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides annual cash prizes to the top-scoring male and female children of registered construction workers in each district who excel in the SSLC examination. It aims to encourage education among the children of construction workers.
required_documents: ID Proof of worker (Electoral Card, Ration Card, Driver's License, Aadhaar Card, Passport)
Age proof of concerned building worker

scheme_name: Cash Benefit Scheme Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
department: Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Cash Benefit Scheme provides educational financial assistance to the wards of registered construction workers who achieve the top three ranks at the state or regional level in higher secondary or equivalent examinations. Financial aid is also available for various degree, diploma, and postgraduate courses.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered with Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
1st, 2nd, or 3rd Rank at State or Regional Level in Higher Secondary

required_documents: Higher Secondary or equivalent Public Examination Mark Certificate attested by the Principal/Head of the Institution

scheme_name: Cash Grant in lieu of Sewing Machine
summary: This welfare scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund provides a cash grant of ₹10,000/- to widows of ex-servicemen for purchasing a sewing machine. The financial assistance is directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account via RTGS or NEFT.
required_documents: ID Card of the late Ex-Serviceman

scheme_name: Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)
summary: This scheme provides a cash incentive of ₹1,000 per month to academically meritorious wards and widows of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) pursuing higher education. Applications must be submitted within three months of the exam result publication.

eligibility_rules.value: Ward of ESM, Ward of the Widow of an ESM

required_documents: Identity Card of the ESM / Widow of the ESM

scheme_name: Cash Prizes Scheme (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Cash Prizes Scheme launched by the Government of Bihar provides financial cash prizes of up to ₹25,000 per year to children of registered construction workers who secure 60% or more in their 10th or 12th standard examinations. Up to two children per registered worker are eligible to receive the benefit based on their academic score tiers.

eligibility_rules.value: registered with Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Identity Card of the Registered Worker

scheme_name: Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries in Gujarat for the construction of cattle sheds for at least 2 animals. Beneficiaries receive a subsidy of up to ₹30,000 or 50% of the total construction cost, whichever is less.
required_documents: Identity proof of the applicant i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
summary: This relief and rehabilitation scheme provides central financial assistance of Rs. 5,49,692/- per family through Direct Benefit Transfer to displaced families from PoK and Chhamb settled in Jammu and Kashmir. It aims to offer a one-time full and final settlement to help these families run small businesses, undertake farming, livestock, or other land-based activities.

eligibility_rules.value: Pakistan occupied Jammu & Kashmir 1947 Displaced Persons, Chhamb 1965 and 1971 Displaced Persons

required_documents: Proof of having resided either in PoK or in Chhamb
Details of Aadhaar Seeded Bank Account

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer
summary: The Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer provides financial assistance, skill development, and socio-economic support to rescued bonded labourers. It utilizes Direct Benefit Transfer and annuity schemes to ensure comprehensive rehabilitation for adults, children, and women.
required_documents: Details of each rescued bonded labourer in the prescribed format

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of fellowships to Scheduled Caste students to pursue regular and full-time higher education leading to M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Sciences. It aims to support advanced studies and research in Indian Universities, Institutions, or Colleges recognized by the UGC.
required_documents: Self-attested Degree/Mark Sheet of the last qualifying exam
Fee Receipt of Current Course Year
Bank Details of the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account

scheme_name: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Internship Scheme
summary: The Central Vigilance Commission Internship Scheme engages Indian nationals who are graduate, postgraduate, or research students in reputed universities to supplement the Commission's analytical work. Interns gain exposure to vigilance issues and policy formulation while receiving a monthly stipend of ₹10,000.
required_documents: Letter of NOC from the Present Institution

scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students for studying in India
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and maintenance allowances to Other Backward Class (OBC) students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in recognized institutions in India. It aims to help eligible students complete their education by covering compulsory fees and other academic expenses.
required_documents: Attested copies of certificates, diplomas, and degrees of all examinations passed

scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance through scholarships to school-going children of poorer OBC parents studying in classes 1st to 10th. The objective is to support their education, reduce dropout rates, and encourage regular attendance.
required_documents: Details of the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account

scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students for studying in India
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to students from Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT) to pursue higher education. It covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other academic expenses to help alleviate financial burdens and enable continuous learning.
required_documents: Admission Letter from the Recognized Institution
Freeship Card, issued by State/District Authority
Bank Account Details, for Direct Benefit Transfer

scheme_name: Centrally-Sponsored Scheme Of Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
summary: This centrally-sponsored scheme provides financial assistance and scholarships to Scheduled Caste students studying in classes 9th and 10th. It covers day scholars and hostellers with monthly stipends, annual book grants, and additional allowances for students with disabilities to reduce dropout rates.
required_documents: Self-attested copies of certificates, diploma, degree of passed examinations
Caste certificate signed by authorized Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar

scheme_name: Certification Program for Goan IT Professionals
summary: The Certification Program for Goan IT Professionals provides reimbursement of up to 50% of the expenditure incurred for obtaining relevant IT certifications to improve employability. Launched in 2018 under Goa's IT Policy, it aims to develop Goa as a strong human resource base for the IT industry.
required_documents: Copies of all mark sheets from Class XII onwards

scheme_name: Chai Vikas Yojana
summary: Chai Vikas Yojana aims to foster the tea industry in Bihar by expanding tea plantations and providing subsidies for planting materials and horticultural machines. Farmers in selected districts receive financial assistance through a cost-sharing model based on land ownership and plant survival rates.

scheme_name: Chanakya Scheme for Swayam Upadhi
department: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (ABC) Limited
summary: The Chanakya Scheme for Swayam Upadhi offers one-time financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 to Brahmin entrepreneurs in Andhra Pradesh to help them set up micro-enterprises. The assistance covers up to 50% of project costs ranging between ₹3,00,000 and ₹10,00,000 across various sectors.
required_documents: Certificate of Highest Qualification of the Applicant
Detailed Project Report (DPR) on the Proposed Project
Write-up covering passion, interests, and capabilities

scheme_name: Charmashilpa Scheme
summary: The Charmashilpa Scheme provides financial assistance and modern technical support to leather artisans, SHGs, and cooperative societies to set up mechanized production units. It offers a total assistance of ₹10,00,000 per unit, comprising a ₹5,00,000 subsidy and a ₹5,00,000 bank loan, to help modernize production and enhance market competitiveness.
required_documents: Passport-size Photograph of the applicant and spouse
First page of SHG Bank Passbook

scheme_name: Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Scheme for Micro Entrepreneurship - Transport Operator
summary: The Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Scheme provides financial subsidies to unemployed economically weak Brahmin youth in Andhra Pradesh to purchase four-wheelers for public transport and self-employment. The scheme aims to support livelihood generation by funding a portion of the vehicle cost as a backend subsidy.

scheme_name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
summary: The CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child provides financial assistance of ₹500 per month for a maximum of two years to meritorious single girl students. It aims to recognize parental efforts in promoting girl education and supports their continued studies in Classes 11 and 12 at CBSE-affiliated schools.
required_documents: Details of bank account and fees structure
Passport size photos and scanned signature
Class 11th mark sheet for scholarship renewal
Bank account linked aadhaar card, bank passbook, and canceled cheque
Affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper from the girl or her parents duly attested by the gazette officer SDM or first-class

scheme_name: Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme
summary: The Chetan Chauhan Shramik Krida Protsahan Yojana (CCSKPY) is an initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to provide one-time financial grants to the children or registered construction workers who have excelled in sports at district, state, national, and international levels. The scheme helps young athletes cover training, equipment, and competition expenses.
required_documents: Attested copy of the online application form
Self-certified copy of the beneficiary's bank passbook
Copy of ration card, family register or other government record
Attested copy of Aadhar card of the beneficiary father and mother
Attested copy of the certificate of the office bearer

scheme_name: Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi
summary: The Chhaatron Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi scheme provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged girl students pursuing agricultural education in Rajasthan. It offers annual scholarships ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 across senior secondary, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels to help overcome financial constraints in accessing education.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme promotes value addition, modernization, and export of agricultural produce by supporting the establishment of food processing units and cold chains. It provides financial assistance including a 30% subsidy for factory construction to generate employment and skill manpower in rural areas.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) of the project (Original)
A flow chart of the project's process output

scheme_name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹50,000 to poor and BPL families in Chhattisgarh for the marriage of their daughters. It aims to prevent extravagant expenses, discourage dowry, and promote simple group marriages.

scheme_name: Chhatrawas (Scheduled Caste)
summary: The Chhatrawas scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free residential facilities and financial assistance ranging from ₹1460 to ₹1500 per month for food and other expenses to Scheduled Caste students studying in recognized educational institutions. The initiative aims to support students by offering accommodation, food, and other allied facilities to facilitate their education.
required_documents: Admission receipt or student ID card

scheme_name: Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
department: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
summary: The Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana provides cashless healthcare services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year to indigenous people and state government employees of Arunachal Pradesh. It aims to reduce out-of-pocket expenses during major illnesses and ensure universal access to quality secondary and tertiary healthcare.

eligibility_rules.value: Tribal Communities, Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST), Backward Communities, State Government Employees

scheme_name: Chief Minister BC & EBC Chhatravas Anudan Yojana
department: Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Department
summary: The Chief Minister BC & EBC Chhatravas Anudan Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to students belonging to Backward Classes (BC) and Extremely Backward Classes (EBC). The scheme aims to support students residing in government hostels by helping cover their essential living and educational needs.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Breakfast Scheme
department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
summary: The Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Breakfast Scheme provides free breakfast on all school working days to primary school children studying from 1st to 5th standard in government schools. The initiative aims to improve nutritional status, address anemia, and support the education of young students.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology
summary: The Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology (CM-CAB) programme provides young faculty and scientists in biotechnology with opportunities for national and/or international collaborative research training and exposure to advanced techniques. The fellowship lasts 3-6 months for foreign host institutions or 3-12 months for domestic host institutions, aiming to enhance research capabilities and forge long-term professional relationships.
required_documents: A consent letter from a Host faculty/scientist

scheme_name: Chief Minister Drought Relief Scheme
department: Department of Home, Jail and Disaster Management
summary: The Chief Minister Drought Relief Scheme provides immediate financial assistance to farmer families whose crops have been damaged due to drought in officially declared drought-hit blocks of Jharkhand. Eligible families receive financial relief of ₹3,500 per affected farmer family.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal)
summary: The Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) aims to provide quick welfare benefits, financial assistance, and empowerment to persons with disabilities in the state. It covers self-employment loans up to Rs. 2 lakh, artificial limbs, special education scholarships, and grants for shelter homes and National Trust schemes.

scheme_name: Chief Minister EBC Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana
department: Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Department
summary: The Chief Minister EBC Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana provides financial incentives ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹1,00,000 to students belonging to the Extremely Backward Classes (EBC) of Bihar who have successfully cleared the preliminary examination of various competitive exams. This financial assistance aims to support their further preparation for main examinations or interviews.

scheme_name: Cash Award (APB&OCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh
summary: The Cash Award scheme by the Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh encourages children of registered construction workers by providing cash awards for scoring good marks in Class X and XII board examinations. Cash assistance ranges from ₹500/- to ₹1000/- for eligible top-performing students.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.
Xerox copy of the registration card of the worker
Bank Account number/ front page of the passbook

scheme_name: Chief Minister Floriculture Mission
summary: The Chief Minister Floriculture Mission aims to promote commercial floriculture in Assam by providing planting materials, shade nets, and tool kits to eligible farmers. It supports small and marginal farmers, women Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and unemployed youth in adopting modern cultivation technologies for flower production.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Family Benefit Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Family Benefit Scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to poor families in Bihar upon the sudden death of a member due to an accident (regardless of age) or a criminal incident (if the deceased was aged 18-60). The scheme aims to offer social security and immediate support to the dependents of the deceased.
required_documents: Identity proof of the applicant (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card)
Identity proof of the deceased person (Aadhaar Card)
Death certificate of the deceased person
Proof of age of the deceased person
Below Poverty Line (BPL) Card/ Ration Card
beneficiary_categories: Family members or dependents of the deceased

scheme_name: Chief Minister Help Scheme
department: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
summary: The Chief Minister Help Scheme provides food distribution and material aid to Scheduled Tribe families in Madhya Pradesh. Ration assistance and utensils are offered upon the birth of a first or second child, or upon the death of a family member, provided no family member is employed in government service.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Housing Assistance Programme
summary: The Chief Minister Housing Assistance Programme provides roofing materials as a grant-in-aid to Economically Weaker Section families to improve their existing homes and offers financial assistance for durable houses to Low Income Group families. The scheme aims to help those who cannot build houses with their limited resources through cost-sharing and credit-linked subsidies.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
department: Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan
summary: The Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to talented students from low-income families in Rajasthan to pursue higher education. It aims to support regular students who have secured a position in the top one lakh of the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education 12th merit list with a minimum of 60% marks.
required_documents: Aadhaar number or Aadhaar registration number
Receipt with Jan Aadhaar ID or Jan Aadhaar registration number

scheme_name: Chief Minister Higher Education Encouragement Scholarship Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Higher Education Encouragement Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing graduation or post-graduation in government colleges and state university campuses in Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to students who secure top positions in their academic courses and meet specific attendance and previous year academic performance criteria.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Kanya Utthan Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister Kanya Utthan Yojana aims to prevent female foeticide, encourage girl child birth and registration, ensure complete vaccination, promote education, and curb child marriage in Bihar. It provides financial assistance directly to the bank accounts of the parents or guardians of up to two girl children in a family to make them self-reliant.
required_documents: Attested application form by Anganwadi worker for two girl children

scheme_name: Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to eligible women in Madhya Pradesh to promote women's health, nutrition, and economic self-reliance. The scheme empowers women by making them financially independent and enabling them to play an effective role in family-level decision-making.
required_documents: Family and Family members Samgra ID

scheme_name: Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojana
summary: Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojana aims for the integrated social, cultural, and economic empowerment of women and adolescent girls in Bihar. It provides various support systems including helplines, short stay homes, vocational training, and financial assistance for self-help groups.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Pension Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Pension Scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹500 to eligible senior citizens, widows, and abandoned women in Chhattisgarh. The pension is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account to support vulnerable groups.
required_documents: Proof of age (Birth Certificate/Marksheet/Passport/Driving License or certification by Sarpanch/Mayor/Administrator/Chairman)
Death certificate of husband (In case of widow)

scheme_name: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme provides working capital assistance of up to ₹10,000 as interest-free bank loans and entrepreneurship development training to rural street vendors and small traders in Madhya Pradesh. It aims to empower rural informal economy workers by making low-cost equipment and business capital accessible.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Merit Award
ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Chief Minister Merit Award scheme aims to support 1000 boys and 1000 girls from Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity communities based on their plus 2 exam marks. Selected students receive ₹3,000 annually for five years to support their higher education.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme provides financial assistance to differently-abled residents of Rajasthan. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension ranging from Rs. 750 to Rs. 1,500 based on their age, gender, and specific disability type.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
summary: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana aims to double farm income in Assam through massive investments in rural areas over five years. It utilizes a saturation model covering revenue villages with focused interventions in direct economic activities, logistic support, and community support, including the provision of subsidized tractor units to eligible farmer groups.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yojana 2017
summary: The Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yojana aims to develop 60 Model Villages in Arunachal Pradesh with basic amenities like 24x7 piped drinking water, household electricity, primary schools, health infrastructure, internal roads, and employment generation avenues. It provides an outlay of Rs 1.5 Crores per village to transform them into open defecation-free and self-sustaining model habitations.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
summary: This scheme provides a monthly pension to divorced, widowed, or abandoned women in Rajasthan to help them bear household expenses and lead a normal life. Financial assistance varies based on the age of the beneficiary.
required_documents: Death certificate of husband for widow pension
Certificate issued by the court for divorcee woman pension
Certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer / Development Officer for abandoned women pension

scheme_name: Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme
department: Dept. of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur
summary: The Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme provides direct income support of ₹ 5,000 in two installments to vulnerable individuals in Manipur whose livelihoods were adversely affected by the pandemic. It targets main bread earners employed in the informal sector, such as daily wage workers, street vendors, and public transport drivers, to help them maintain a basic minimum standard of living.
required_documents: Street Vendor card or list of Municipalities or District Councils (for Street Vendors/Women Vendors)
Permit for public transport issued by Transport Dept./Municipalities/District Councils (for public Transport Drivers)
School Van Permit/Certificate (for School Van Driver)

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme provides cashless medical treatment up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year in empanelled government and private hospitals. It aims to reduce financial hardship for economically weaker families by covering a wide range of medical, surgical, and diagnostic procedures.
required_documents: Income certificate from the Village Administrative Officer/Revenue authorities
Self-declaration from the head of the family

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Jeevan Jyoti Swaniyojan Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister's Jeevan Jyoti Swaniyojan Yojana provides self-employment opportunities to educated unemployed youth in Assam across primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors. It facilitates income generation through institutional credit provided by nationalized banks and financial institutions for various entrepreneurial ventures.
required_documents: Age proof (School Certificate/ HSLC Admit card)
PRC from Gaon Burah (For Village Area)
Annual income certificate from Mouzadar or Circle Officer
GMC Householding certificate (for Kamrup Metro Area)

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana provides zero-interest crop loans up to Rs. 3.00 lakhs to farmers in Arunachal Pradesh. It offers an interest subvention of 4% on crop loans and Kisan Credit Card limits, which becomes zero-interest upon timely repayment within one year.
required_documents: Land holding certificate issued by the local Gaon Buras (GBs)
Certificate of area and crop being cultivated issued by Circle Officer
Other requirements by the bank against loan formalities

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme aims to provide permanent houses to registered construction workers in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh who are homeless or living in kutcha/semi-pucca houses. The scheme offers a financial assistance loan grant of up to ₹50,000 for constructing a house.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (e.g., Utility bill, Voter ID, etc.)
Bank Account Details (e.g., Copy of Bank Passbook)

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
department: Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Telangana
summary: The Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities provides financial assistance up to ₹20 Lakhs to minority students from Telangana for pursuing higher education (Postgraduate or Doctoral studies) in accredited foreign universities. The scholarship is awarded to 500 students per year based on academic and family income criteria.
required_documents: GRE/GMAT or equivalent qualifying exam/test scorecard
Admission offer letter from a Foreign University

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Self Employment Scheme
department: Department of Personnel, and Reforms, Training, Public Grievances, Government of Sikkim
summary: The Chief Minister's Self Employment Scheme provides loans up to ₹3,00,000 to unemployed youth in Sikkim to start self-employment ventures. The scheme offers interest-free loans for the first two years, followed by a 6% simple interest rate.
required_documents: Affidavit of unemployment and no outstanding dues

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
department: Labour Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh
summary: The Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme provides ₹1,00,000 in financial assistance to eligible urban construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. It also supports workers with Central and State Government grants and aligns with the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme For Award To Distinguished Artistes
summary: The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) scheme encourages and felicitates distinguished artists in the field of culture for achieving national and international awards. It provides financial assistance through various categories based on age and whether the applicant is an individual or a group.
required_documents: Residential/Domicile Certificate of the State of Manipur
Bio Data with Relevant Supporting Documents/Certificate
Proof of Age / Date of Birth
Proof of Winning a National Award viz Padma Awardee, Sangeet Natak Akademi Awardee, Sahitya Akademi Awardee, Lalit Kala Akademi Awardee, and Zonal Cultural Centre’s Award including Young Awar

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative
summary: The Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative aims to enhance farmers' income and boost private enterprise by making credit more inexpensive and accessible. The scheme provides subsidies or interest subventions for specified activities in agriculture and allied sectors, such as processing units, handicrafts, and small-scale manufacturing.

eligibility_rules.value: Individual Farmers, Self Help Groups, Farmer Producer Organizations

required_documents: Number of ponds with size in Meters or Feet

scheme_name: Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
summary: The Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1500 per month to differently-abled persons in Sikkim. Eligible beneficiaries are those with a disability of 40% or above and belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
required_documents: Attested photocopy of Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification
Attested photocopy of the first page of the Bank / Post Office Passbook

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Scheme Of Festival Assistance For Participating In International & National Festival
summary: The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) scheme provides financial assistance to artists and cultural groups from Manipur to cover travel and journey costs when invited to participate in recognized international and national festivals. The expenditure is reimbursed to beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) upon submission of original bills, vouchers, tickets, and boarding passes.
required_documents: Ticket Copies (both Bus / Train / Air) with the list of Artistes
Bank Account Detail (for Individual / Registered group)
Bio-Data of the individual artiste or activities report of the group with relevant supporting documents
Receipt of all bills / vouchers / tickets / Boarding Pass etc in original

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT): Support For Purchase Of Instruments / Equipment
summary: The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) scheme aims to support talented students and budding artistes by providing financial assistance for the purchase of musical instruments or equipment. It helps students groom towards professionalism by aiding their learning and performance.
required_documents: Proof of Age / Date of Birth
Certificate from the teacher on the requirement of instruments/equipment
Bill / Voucher for purchasing the equipment/instrument

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension
department: Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Manipur
summary: The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension scheme provides a monthly financial pension ranging from ₹ 2,500 to ₹ 4,000 to aged, reputed artists who have significantly contributed to the vibrant arts, culture, and traditions of Manipur. Eligible beneficiaries are divided into categories including National/State Awardees and recognized non-awardee artistes.
required_documents: Residential/Domicile Certificate of the State of Manipur
Bio Data with Relevant Supporting Documents/Certificates

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance To The Cultural Group For Training With New Production
department: Department of Art and Culture, Govt. of Manipur
summary: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered cultural groups in Manipur that are engaged in training the younger generation with new productions to enrich local traditions, art forms, and culture. It supports qualified groups across various categories of theatre, dance, music, visual arts, and literature.
required_documents: Detail proposal with an estimated cost
Bank Account Detail (for Individual / Registered group)
Last 3 years’ Audited Statement of Accounts (for the group)
Utilization Certificate of previous grants / financial assistance
Detailed Report of the Remarkable Productions with supporting doc

scheme_name: Chief Ministers House Rent
department: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare
summary: The Chief Minister's House Rent scheme provides a monthly house rent allowance to eligible students pursuing higher education who are not accommodated in government hostels. The financial assistance varies from ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 per month depending on the city category where the student's institution is located.

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang
summary: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang is a social welfare scheme by the Government of Manipur that provides free travel and travel concessions to persons with disabilities. Eligible beneficiaries receive a passbook issued by the Directorate of Social Welfare to avail benefits such as free travel with an escort for intellectual disabilities or 50% travel concessions for other specified disabilities.

scheme_name: Chief Ministers Special Rural Development Fund (CMSRDF)
summary: The Chief Minister's Special Rural Development Fund aims to generate wage employment and create socially and economically useful public assets through people's participation at the grassroots level. It supports various rural infrastructure projects such as roads, footpaths, community halls, school buildings, and procurement of vehicles like ambulances and school buses.
required_documents: Bank Account jointly operated by two members
Completion certificate accompanied by photographic evidence

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Agriculture Mechanisation Programme
summary: The Chief Minister’s Agriculture Mechanisation Programme provides financial assistance and subsidies to farmers and agricultural groups for purchasing farm machinery and equipment. The scheme aims to promote farm mechanization, improve farming operations, and enhance crop production and farm income security.

eligibility_rules.value: Farmer, SHG, Co-operative Society, FPO, Entrepreneur

scheme_name: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development & Fisheries Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from minimum Rs. 14,433 to maximum Rs. 75,000 to individual farmers in Maharashtra for digging farm ponds. It aims to provide protective irrigation to rainfed agricultural lands, reducing crop losses caused by uneven rainfall distribution.

scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
summary: The Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST) scholarship scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹ 3,000 to ₹ 8,000 per annum to students with disabilities who are domiciles of Manipur and studying in Class 1st and above. The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank account of the eligible beneficiary to support their education.
required_documents: Aadhar Card/ Enrollment Number/ ID Card
Passing Certificate / Marksheet of the Latest Education Qualification

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme provides free health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for eligible families in Tamil Nadu. It offers cashless hospitalization for specified ailments and procedures through empanelled government and private hospitals.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)
department: Directorate of University & Higher Education, Govt. of Manipur
summary: The Chief Minister’s College Students Rehabilitation Scheme aims to provide educational facilities, free admission, monetary grants, and free smartphones to undergraduate students displaced or affected by social unrest in Manipur. The scheme helps students transfer to new colleges and continues their education without interruption.
required_documents: Certificate Issued by Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) / Sub-Divisional Commissioner (SDC)

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme provides free commonly used medicines for the treatment of all types of cancer up to a ceiling of ₹10.00 lakh per person per year. It aims to reduce the financial burden of high treatment expenditures on cancer patients in the state.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.
Schedule Tribe Certificate for APST patients

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Free Diagnostic Services
summary: The Chief Minister's Free Diagnostics Services Programme ensures the availability of free CT Scan, X-Ray, and laboratory services at government health institutions in Assam. It aims to reduce high out-of-pocket expenditure for patients and provide evidence-based care irrespective of socio-economic status.
required_documents: Proof of residence in Assam (e.g., Aadhaar card, voter ID, or residence certificate)
Medical prescription or recommendation from a registered medical practitioner

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-I
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-I provides financial assistance to poor families with one girl child to promote education, encourage small family norms, and eradicate female infanticide. It offers a fixed deposit of ₹50,000/- in the name of the girl child along with annual incentives starting from the 6th year, payable when she turns 18.

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana, launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, sponsors Scheduled Tribe students of the state to pursue professional diploma, degree, and postgraduate diploma courses in tourism and hospitality. The initiative aims to develop skilled manpower to support the growing tourism industry in the region.
required_documents: Class X marks sheet or equivalent
Class XII marks sheet or equivalent
Any other documents as demanded by the District Tourism Officer

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Paryatan Vikas Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister’s Paryatan Vikas Yojna (CMPVY) aims to develop tourism facilities in Arunachal Pradesh to attract more tourists and create livelihoods for locals. It offers financial support and subsidies for establishing patisseries and food courts, upgrading homestays, and procuring adventure sports equipment.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.
Bank Account number/ front page of the passbook
Registration certificate with the Department of Tourism
Training certificates of Dept. of Tourism (if applicable)
Registration certificate as a tour operator with the dept. of Tourism

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-II
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-II aims to provide financial assistance to poor families with girl children to promote their education, encourage small family norms, and eradicate female infanticide. It offers a fixed deposit in the name of the girl children along with annual educational incentives, provided certain criteria regarding income, sterilization, and family structure are met.

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Krishi Samuh Yojana
summary: Chief Minister’s Krishi Samuh Yojana focuses on the formation and nurturing of Farmers' Producer's Organizations (FPOs) in Arunachal Pradesh. It empowers farmers through a cooperative approach, providing financial assistance and a revolving fund for better price realization and agricultural development.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card etc.
Registration certificate of FPO under Societies Act, Cooperative Society Act, or Company’s Act
One-year audited statement certified by a CA (for existing FPOs, FPCs, and registered farmer societies)

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Scheme For Wood Carving Artists
summary: The Chief Minister's Scheme for Wood Carving Artists aims to preserve and promote the traditional craft of wood carving by providing advanced training, improved tools, and market linkages. It seeks to empower wood carving artisans in Arunachal Pradesh, develop them into entrepreneurs, and enhance product quality to meet international standards.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Health Insurance Scheme - Nagaland
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: The Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS) in Nagaland provides cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹20 lakhs for government employees and pensioners, and up to ₹5 lakhs for the general category. It covers inpatient and specific daycare procedures in empanelled hospitals across India for permanent and indigenous residents of the state.
required_documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) or Permanent Residential Certificate (PRC)

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Shasakt Kisan Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister's Shasakt Kisan Yojana aims to increase fruit crop production, double farmers' income, and promote commercialization of horticulture activities in Arunachal Pradesh. It provides financial assistance, seedlings, fencing materials, and tools for tea, rubber, and double-cropping farming.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.)
Copy of the Arunachal Pradesh Schedule Tribe (APST) Certificate (If applicable)
LPC/Land Allotment Documents/Land Documents duly certified by GB/HGB/PRI and countersigned by the Local District Administration
Three copies of recent passport-sized photograph
Sketch map of the proposed land for Tea/Rubber duly certified by GB/HGB/PRI

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s White Revolutions Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister’s White Revolutions Scheme aims to create a cooperative model of dairy farmers to serve as milk production hubs and promote organic farming through vermicompost facilities. It provides capital subsidies for dairy units, minimum support price for milk procurement, and financial assistance to uplift rural livelihoods and alleviate poverty.

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme
summary: The Chief Minister’s Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme provides a capital subsidy of ₹ 20,000 per kilowatt for grid-connected domestic solar PV systems installed in individual homes and residential flats in Tamil Nadu. This is offered in addition to the Central Government's MNRE subsidy scheme to promote renewable energy adoption.
required_documents: Duly filled out online application form
Proof of possession of premises such as ownership document or lease agreement
Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, or Passport)
Proof of address such as electricity bill, telephone bill, or ration card
Site plan and building layout plan indicating the location of the solar rooftop system
Structural stability certificate from a structural engineer

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana
summary: The Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana provides high-end job-linked vocational training to youth either within or outside Arunachal Pradesh. It offers a stipend of ₹3000, covers the cost of uniforms and books, provides boarding and lodging during on-the-job training, and ensures a minimum 70% placement guarantee.

scheme_name: Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development
summary: Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana is a 100% state-sponsored health assistance scheme by the Government of Jharkhand. It provides financial assistance equivalent to minimum wages for up to 40 working days to registered construction workers who are hospitalized for five or more days.
required_documents: Proof of Registration as a Construction Worker
Proof of Admission into the Hospital

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Startup/innovation Projects/new Industries
