summary: The Chief Minister’s Startup/Innovation Projects/New Industries Scheme aims to transform educated youth from job seekers into job creators by supporting startups, innovative projects, and new industries. It provides financial sustenance allowances, skill development, incubation center support, and various incentives to promote entrepreneurship and generate self-employment.

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme
summary: This scheme provides quality coaching for economically disadvantaged Arunachal Pradesh Schedule Tribe (APST) candidates to enable them to compete in the UPSC Civil Services Examination. It covers training costs for General Studies and Optional Papers along with study materials to encourage more students from the state to succeed in national-level competitive examinations.

scheme_name: Child Benefit Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
department: Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB)
summary: The Child Benefit Scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers in Uttarakhand. The assistance covers students enrolled from Class I up to higher education, professional courses, and ITI or Polytechnic programs.
required_documents: Certificate of working as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the previous year
Affidavit of construction worker attested by notary
Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat officer, village head, or councilor
Nominee’s Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Children Education Allowance
department: Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
summary: The Children Education Allowance scheme provides financial assistance of ₹500/- per month for children of registered construction workers studying from Nursery to Class 10. The benefit is applicable for a maximum of two children per family to support their educational expenses.
required_documents: Study Certificate (issued by the Head of the school)
Sealed and Signed Copy of relevant pages of the child’s Cumulative Records

scheme_name: Chikitsa Pratipoorti Yojana
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development
summary: Chikitsa Pratipoorti Yojana is a 100% state-sponsored scheme by the Government of Jharkhand that provides financial assistance to registered construction workers for the treatment of serious illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, and kidney disease. The scheme aims to support eligible beneficiaries by covering medical expenditures for specified critical health conditions.
required_documents: Proof of Registration as a Construction Worker

scheme_name: Children Education Assistance Fund
summary: The Children Education Assistance Fund (CEAF) provides financial assistance to cover tuition fees, textbooks, uniforms, and other educational expenses for eligible children in Nagaland. It aims to promote education and support students from underprivileged backgrounds, including merit-based scholarships determined through exams at the elementary and secondary stages.
required_documents: Residence proof of the child in Nagaland
Aadhar card or any other government-approved identity proof of the child and the parent/guardian
School admission or enrollment certificate of the child in a government school
Bank account details of the parent/guardian

scheme_name: Child Adoption - Tamil Nadu
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide a loving family and proper upbringing for orphaned, abandoned, destitute, and neglected children through legal adoption. It offers accommodation, food, and healthcare to babies until they are adopted, alongside special adoption leave benefits for state government female employees.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (Aadhaar Card/Voter ID card/Passport /Driving License/ Electricity Card)
Proof of Income of Last Year (Pay Bill/ Income Tax Certificate)
Copy of Birth Certificate of the Prospective Adoptive Parents

scheme_name: Civil Services Incentive Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
department: Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department
summary: This scheme encourages candidates with disabilities in Madhya Pradesh who successfully pass various stages of the Civil Services Examination conducted by UPSC or MPPSC. It provides financial incentives of varying amounts for clearing the preliminary exam, main exam, and final selection.
required_documents: Disability certificate issued by a competent authority
Letter from the commission and copy of mark sheet upon clearing the preliminary examination
Letter from the commission and copy of mark sheet upon clearing the main examination
Copy of letter from the commission

scheme_name: Civil Service Incentive (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic communities)
department: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare
summary: The Civil Service Incentive scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 (and up to ₹60,000 for mains) to qualified candidates from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities in Madhya Pradesh. This is awarded for successfully passing various stages of civil service examinations conducted by the MPPSC and UPSC.
required_documents: Proof of Having Passed one of the following stages of the MPPSC or UPSC Examination: Preliminary Exam, Main Exam, or Interview

scheme_name: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana-II
summary: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana-II, launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, promotes cluster-based cultivation of selected fruits, flowers, and medicinal crops. The scheme provides financial assistance and subsidies to farmers to expand agricultural land areas and enhance their income.

scheme_name: Children With Special Needs Under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan
summary: The scheme provides comprehensive educational support and resources tailored to the needs of differently-abled children in Goa. It ensures every child receives necessary assistance through medical assessments, resource rooms, home-based education, teaching-learning materials, and specialized training.
required_documents: Other supporting documents as specified in the scheme guidelines

scheme_name: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana
summary: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, promotes cluster-based cultivation of selected fruits, flowers, and medicinal crops. The scheme provides financial subsidies to farmers, farmer groups, and FPOs to expand crop areas and enhance agricultural income.

scheme_name: Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
department: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
summary: The Civil Service Incentive Scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial incentives to SC/ST candidates who clear various stages of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) or Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPSC) civil services examinations. The scheme aims to encourage and support talented students from backward communities. Eligible applicants must be permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh with an annual parental income not exceeding ₹6,00,000.

scheme_name: Co-Working Space/ Incubators/ Accelerators Subsidy Scheme
department: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa reimburses certified startups a fixed amount for seats occupied in co-working spaces, incubators, or accelerators listed by the Startup Promotion Cell (SPC). Startups can receive 50% of the seat cost (up to ₹3000 per seat) for a maximum of 8 seats for up to two years.
required_documents: Original copy of bill issued by co-working/ incubator/ accelerator
The form and documents as mentioned in Annexure 1

scheme_name: Coaching Assistance Scheme For Scheduled Caste Students For Pre-Exam Preparation Like NEET, JEE, GUJCET
summary: The Government of Gujarat provides financial assistance up to ₹20,000 for Scheduled Caste students studying in the 12th science stream to prepare for competitive exams like NEET, JEE, and GUJCET. The assistance is directly credited to the student's bank account through DBT to support their coaching fees.
required_documents: 12th certificate about studying in the school
Cancel cheque/the first page of the bank passbook
Certificate from the institute in which students want to study

scheme_name: Coaching Assistance Scheme for Preparation of Recruitment Exams for Scheduled Caste Students
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 to Scheduled Caste students in Gujarat for preparing for central and state government recruitment examinations. The assistance is directly credited to the student's bank account through DBT to help cover coaching fees.
required_documents: Certificates including the last mark sheet of graduation passed
Proof of Residence (Electricity Bill, License, Lease Agreement, Electoral Card, or Ration Card)
Copy of first page of Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque
A photograph showing the board of the institution

scheme_name: Coaching Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Preparation of Examination Like IIM, NIFT, NLU, CEPT
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹20,000 or the actual coaching fee to Scheduled Caste students in Gujarat preparing for professional entrance exams like IIM, NIFT, NLU, and CEPT. It aims to support their preparation by reducing the financial burden of coaching fees.
required_documents: Certificate (Bonafide) regarding the school he/she is studying in
Copy of the first page of Bank Passbook / Cancelled Check
A photograph showing the board of the institution

scheme_name: Coaching Help Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Gujarat
summary: The Coaching Help Scheme offers an annual financial incentive of ₹15,000 to academically bright students for tuition classes outside their school or college. It aims to support eligible students in continuing their studies without financial constraints.
required_documents: Application form in the prescribed format
Letter of Admission to School/College (Bona Fide)

scheme_name: Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams
summary: The Coaching Help Scheme aims to support non-reserved category students in Gujarat pursuing professional medical and engineering courses by providing financial aid for coaching. Eligible students receive financial assistance up to ₹20,000 per year for entrance exam preparation like JEE, NEET, or GUJCET.
required_documents: Proof that the coaching class/institute has been operational for at least 3 years

scheme_name: Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination
department: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance, education, and training to Scheduled Tribe candidates from Madhya Pradesh preparing for the Civil Services Examination. It covers coaching fees up to ₹2,00,000, a one-time book allowance of ₹15,000, a monthly stipend of ₹12,500, and additional support for transport, housing, and food.

scheme_name: Coaching Schemes For Sc/st/obc (non-creamy Layer) & Minority Students For Universities
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible universities and colleges to offer remedial coaching, entry into services coaching, and NET coaching for SC, ST, OBC (non-creamy layer), and minority students. It aims to improve academic skills, linguistic proficiency, and comprehension levels to enhance their competitiveness in higher education.

eligibility_rules.value: SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), Minorities, BPL General
UGC Section 2(f) and 12(B) compliant universities and colleges

scheme_name: Coconut Development Scheme
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Coconut Development Scheme aims to encourage farmers in Gujarat by providing quality coconut saplings at reasonable prices and financial assistance for coconut cultivation. It also promotes sustainable agricultural practices through Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM).

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
summary: The Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee aims to increase the productivity of existing coffee holdings through gap filling, rejuvenation, and improved cultivation methods. It provides financial assistance and subsidies to tribal coffee growers for better crop management and consolidation.
required_documents: Application and Self Declaration in the prescribed format

scheme_name: Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS) provides insurance coverage to healthy nut-bearing coconut palms against natural calamities, pests, and diseases. It aims to assist coconut growers in mitigating income loss due to the sudden death of palms and encourages replanting and rejuvenation. The scheme subsidizes a major portion of the insurance premium through the Board and State Governments.
required_documents: Proposal forms along with premium amount
Proof of land record / Plantation or a certificate issued by revenue authorities
Declaration by a farmer that only healthy palms are insured

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
summary: The Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee aims to facilitate afforestation in Jhum lands and settle tribal farmers on a permanent footing through coffee cultivation. It provides a financial subsidy of 50% of the unit cost (up to ₹50,000 per hectare) to eligible tribal growers.
required_documents: Application and Self-Declaration duly filled in and signed by the Applicant/s
Proof of photo identity (Driving License, Ration Card, EPIC, Aadhaar Card, Passport, or PAN Card)

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Supply of Baby Pulpers
summary: This scheme aims to improve the quality of coffee produced by growers in the North Eastern Region by supplying baby pulpers. It helps growers establish quality enhancement infrastructure and earn better returns through financial subsidies.
required_documents: Land records/possession certificate duly certified by the Village Authority/State Government Authority/Competent Authority

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards
summary: The scheme aims to facilitate the improvement of the quality of coffee produced by growers by encouraging them to establish infrastructure for quality enhancement and obtain certification for their coffees. It provides financial assistance for constructing cement drying yards to enable growers to earn better returns.
required_documents: Application in the prescribed format (in duplicate)
Copy of photo identity cards like Aadhaar, Ration card, Passport, EPIC, or Driving license
Work completion report and expenditure statement by the applicant
Copy of the Bank Pass Book with account details
Land records in the name of the beneficiary

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Eco-Certification / Organic Certification
summary: This scheme encourages coffee growers in the North Eastern Region to improve quality and access high-value specialty markets by providing support for eco-certification and organic certification. It provides a subsidy of 75% of the certification cost to eligible grower collectives, SHGs, and cooperatives.
required_documents: Application in the prescribed format (in duplicate)
Memorandum of article of association/society as Grower Collective/SHG/Cooperative
Complete list/details of members of the organization
Copy of the certificate issued by the Accredited Certification Agency
Original invoice towards the cost of certification

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries
summary: The Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries aims to provide growers with high-quality coffee seedlings to ensure the proper establishment of plantations. It offers financial assistance of ₹5 per coffee seedling to eligible groups who procure seed material exclusively from the Coffee Board.
required_documents: Proposal containing details of the number of seedlings

scheme_name: Coir Udyami Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Coir Udyami Yojana is a credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at setting up coir units with project costs up to Rs. 10 lakhs. It provides financial assistance comprising a 40% subsidy, 55% bank credit, and a 5% beneficiary contribution to promote coir production and entrepreneurship.
required_documents: Prescribed Application Form for Scheme assistance
Copy of Title Deed of the property on which the unit is proposed to be set up/already located
Proof of training availed from Coir Board
Machineries proposed to be purchased along with Invoice
Industrial Establishment Certificate issued by District Industries Centre (DIC)
Plan & Estimate for construction of workshed
beneficiary_categories: Institutions registered under Societies Registration Act 1860

scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
summary: The scheme aims to improve the productivity and quality of coffee in the North Eastern Region by facilitating the creation of infrastructure for water augmentation, such as irrigation and wet processing facilities. It provides a subsidy of up to 75% for eligible water harvesting structures and sprinkler units.
required_documents: Application in the prescribed format (in duplicate)
Invoice / Bill (original) with TIN No. in case of Sprinkler/Drip Equipment
Work completion report and expenditure statement signed by the applicant
Land records in the beneficiary's name certified by the Village Authority/State Government/Competent Authority

scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme (CITUS) aims to provide modern infrastructure facilities, support the establishment of new state-of-the-art coir processing units, and modernize existing ones. It facilitates the adoption of eco-friendly production techniques and creates enhanced employment opportunities, especially for women in rural areas.
required_documents: Details of Registration under Coir Board Registration Rules 2008
PAN & Aadhaar Number of the Applicant
Registration Certificate from Registrar of Companies and Memorandum/Articles of Association (if Company)

scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Export Market Promotion Scheme
summary: The Export Market Promotion Scheme aims to improve the export performance of the Indian Coir Sector through export market promotion activities such as sponsoring delegations, international fair participation, generic publicity abroad, and financial assistance. It supports registered MSMEs and exporters of coir products by helping them showcase their offerings globally and recognize outstanding performance.
required_documents: Details of Registration under Coir Board
A copy of the Signed Purchase Order
A bank Certificate showing the financial status of your account
A copy of the SSI Certificate/ Coir Board Industrial Establishment Certificate
A copy of the Partnership deed

scheme_name: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS)
department: All India Council for Technical Education
summary: The Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS) provides financial support and research grants to young TEQIP faculties to foster research collaboration and build a research community. It offers funding up to ₹ 25,00,000/- for projects with a duration of one year.
required_documents: Mandate form in given format duly signed by Head of the Institution and bank authority
Certificate of collaboration signed by Principal Investigator, Co-Principal Investigators, and Head of the Institution
Bio-data of all PI and Co-PIs

scheme_name: Community Canning & Training On Fruit Preservation
summary: The Community Canning and Training scheme disseminates techniques for preparing preserved items like jams, jellies, and pickles from seasonal fruits and vegetables, particularly targeting women. It offers short and long-term training programs to promote home-scale preservation and small-scale cottage industries for self-employment.

scheme_name: Community Based Training Scheme
summary: The Community Based Training Scheme provides vocational training in areas such as driving, security services, office skills, and beauty care to unemployed youth belonging to minority communities. The initiative aims to equip participants with skills for self-employment or jobs in corporate sectors.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar as Residential Proof

scheme_name: Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme
summary: The Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme empowers marginal farmers and the general public in Arunachal Pradesh to cultivate vegetables and rear livestock at home. It aims to enhance self-sufficiency, improve household nutrition, and promote sustainable farming practices.
required_documents: Land Ownership Documents or Lease Agreement

scheme_name: Compensation Amount Towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals
summary: The scheme provides financial compensation and medical assistance to cattle owners in Madhya Pradesh whose cattle have been injured or permanently disabled due to attacks by wild animals. Eligible owners receive immediate assistance, funds for medical expenses, or compensation for permanent disability upon proper verification and reporting.
required_documents: Certificate or Panchnama issued by Doctor/Sarpanch/Panchayat Secretary/Local Body
Bills Related to Payment of Treatment Undergone
Certificate issued by a Competent Government Doctor in case of Permanent Disability

scheme_name: Compensation in Animal Death
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat
summary: The Compensation in Animal Death scheme supports livestock owners in Gujarat by providing financial assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) when their animals die due to natural disasters, specific diseases, or poisoning. Compensation limits vary based on whether the animals are large or small, milch or non-milch.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or other identity proof of the applicant
Any other documents as specified by the Veterinary Officer

scheme_name: Competitive Exam Coaching
summary: The Competitive Exam Coaching scheme launched in Rajasthan provides free coaching to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students for various competitive examinations. Eligible students can apply through the M.L. Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute or Project Officer offices.

scheme_name: Composite Loan Scheme
summary: The Composite Loan Scheme provides need-based financial support and loans to individuals from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Persons with Disabilities in Delhi. It aims to encourage self-employment and entrepreneurship, promoting economic independence and social inclusion.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, Minority, Persons with Disability

scheme_name: Comprehensive Handicrafts Cluster Development Programme
summary: The Comprehensive Handicrafts Cluster Development Programme aims to develop clusters with world-class infrastructure to boost production and exports in the handicrafts sector. It assists artisans and entrepreneurs by providing modern infrastructure, latest technology, training, market linkages, and production diversification through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs).
required_documents: Sale /lease deed of land/building in the name of SPV

scheme_name: Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme - Sikkim
department: Department of Personnel, and Reforms, Training, Public Grievances
summary: The Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme by the Government of Sikkim provides interest-free educational loans for the duration of a course plus a one-year moratorium period. It offers financial assistance to students for pursuing studies within Sikkim, across India, or abroad, with special consideration for below-poverty-line (BPL) families.
required_documents: Income Certificate (certified by the District Collector)
Admission proof from a recognized institution
Project viability and technical feasibility certification

scheme_name: Concession in Railway Travel
summary: This scheme provides railway travel concessions to individual artists and cultural troupes traveling for public performances. Beneficiaries receive a 75% concession on Second Class fares and a 50% concession on First Class fares for journeys exceeding 300 km.
required_documents: Confirmation letter obtained from the programme organizer or advertisement details

scheme_name: Concessional Bus Travel Facility to Women above 60 years of age- Punjab
department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development
summary: The Concessional Bus Travel Facility scheme offers a 50% concession in bus fare for women aged 60 and above traveling in Punjab Roadways and Pepsu Road Transport Corporation buses. Eligible senior citizen women residing in Punjab can obtain travel passes by submitting valid age and residence proofs.
required_documents: Residence Proof (Aadhar Card, Voter Card, Ration Card)

scheme_name: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
summary: The Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to SC students studying in government colleges across Haryana. An additional ₹500 per month is provided for those availing hostel facilities, subject to maintaining a minimum of 60% attendance.
required_documents: Last Exam Passed Certificate (Except for 1st Year Students)

scheme_name: Construction Workers Night Shelter Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
department: Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
summary: The Construction Workers Night Shelter Scheme provides night shelters in urban areas and large Gram Panchayats for registered construction workers and their dependent family members who have temporarily relocated for work. It aims to offer safe temporary housing to labourers working away from their permanent residences.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (e.g., Utility bill, Voter ID, etc.)
Bank Account Details (e.g., Copy of Bank Passbook)

scheme_name: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Caste areas of Gujarat that lack their own milk storage or cattle feed storage infrastructure. It offers a 50% subsidy up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000 for the construction of a Dudhghar or Godown on their own land.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook or cancelled cheque
Proof of own land for construction of Dudhghar/Godown
Certificate of not availing benefit earlier in same scheme/other scheme with similar purpose by Managing Director of Dairy Union

scheme_name: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Tribe Area)
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The scheme provides financial support up to 50% (maximum ₹5,00,000/-) to Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Tribe areas of Gujarat for the construction of Dudhghar or Godowns for milk and cattle feed storage. It aims to assist societies lacking their own infrastructure and promotes the installation of bulk milk coolers.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook or cancelled cheque
Proof of own land for construction of Dudhghar/Godown
Certificate of not availing benefit earlier in same scheme/other scheme with similar purpose by Managing Director of Dairy Union

scheme_name: Construction of Fish Markets
summary: The 'Construction of Fish Markets' scheme provides financial subsidies to local bodies like Municipalities and Village Panchayats in Goa for building fish markets. Depending on the local body's annual income, subsidies range from 75% to 100%, capped at ₹5,00,000.
required_documents: Land Documents Complete in All Respects
Estimates Duly Approved by Public Works Department (PWD)
Site Plan Duly Approved by Respective Authority
Annual Income Certificate of Municipality/Village Panchayat

scheme_name: Construction of Free Houses for Tribals
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
summary: The Construction of Free Houses for Tribals scheme provides free housing construction to eligible Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes communities in Tamil Nadu. The program aims to improve living conditions by building safe, permanent shelter for individuals who already possess a free house site patta.

scheme_name: Construction of Godown for Grain Storage
ministry: Ministry of Panchayat and Rural Development
summary: The scheme aims to provide modern and scientific food grain storage facilities under the Food Security Act to interested applicants in rural areas. It facilitates the construction of godowns by rural applicants who meet the land and occupation criteria upon application to the Gram Panchayat.

scheme_name: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
summary: This Centrally Sponsored Scheme aims to address the educational backwardness of OBC students by providing hostel facilities, particularly for those from rural and remote areas, to help them pursue secondary and higher education. It provides financial assistance to state governments, UT administrations, and central autonomous institutions for hostel construction and furniture.
required_documents: Preliminary cost estimate signed by an officer not below the rank of an Executive Engineer
Copy of the latest Annual Report
Statement of full receipts and expenditure

scheme_name: Continuation of Pension (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Continuation of Pension scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board of Karnataka provides a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to registered building and construction workers. To be eligible, workers must have paid subscription fees for a minimum of three continuous years, remain active in their profession until the age of 60, and not receive similar pensions from other government schemes.

scheme_name: Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme by the Labour Department of West Bengal provides reimbursement of up to ₹5000/- for purchasing a hearing aid to registered construction workers. Eligible applicants must be registered members of the board and meet specific age and work duration criteria.
required_documents: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Original bill/ voucher of the purchased Hearing Aid

scheme_name: Contributory Social Security Scheme
summary: The Contributory Social Security Scheme provides financial support and social security to marginal workers in Jammu and Kashmir on a contributory basis. Beneficiaries receive insurance coverage and periodic deposits into a bank account that can be withdrawn or reinvested into a pension scheme upon completion. The scheme is 100% sponsored by the UT of Jammu and Kashmir.
required_documents: Proof of Residence of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir

scheme_name: Craftsman Training Scheme - Maharashtra
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship
department: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department
summary: The Craftsman Training Scheme provides financial support through a monthly stipend to trainees pursuing vocational training in Maharashtra. The scheme aims to encourage students to complete their training and contribute to skilled manpower development in the state.

scheme_name: Cost of Spectacle for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The 'Cost of Spectacle for the Construction Workers' scheme by the Government of West Bengal provides financial reimbursement of up to ₹500 to registered construction workers for purchasing spectacles. The initiative aims to support the vision and eye health of registered beneficiaries under the board.
required_documents: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Original bill/ voucher of the purchased Spectacle

scheme_name: Creation of Modern Facilities in Market Committee
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The scheme aims to upgrade Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) in Gujarat with essential modern infrastructure. It provides financial assistance for setting up facilities like sales-cum-exhibition centres, farmer sheds, soil testing labs, and water systems to help farmers improve product quality and secure better prices.
required_documents: Development work maps and cost estimates
Engineer’s certification from the approved panel
Any other documents required by the authorities

scheme_name: Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana (Livelihood Microfinance Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana provides prompt and need-based microfinance to eligible Scheduled Caste persons at a reasonable interest rate to pursue small and micro-business activities. It offers financial assistance up to 90% of the project cost of Rs. 1,40,000 for income-generating activities.

scheme_name: Credit Based Schemes For SC - Term Loan (TL)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance through term loans to entrepreneurs belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category to help them start or expand their businesses. NSFDC offers term loans covering up to 95% of the project cost with preferential interest rates based on the loan amount and family income criteria.

scheme_name: Credit Card Scheme For Artisans And Weavers Of Handicrafts And Handloom Sector
summary: This loan scheme provides adequate and timely financial assistance to registered artisans and weavers in Jammu & Kashmir for investment and working capital needs. It offers a maximum credit limit of ₹2,00,000 with no collateral security and a 7% interest subvention over 5 years.
required_documents: Proof of Registration of the artisan/weaver with the Handicrafts and Handloom Department, J&K

scheme_name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme For The Scheduled Castes
summary: This scheme encourages entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes by providing a credit enhancement guarantee against loans granted by Member Lending Institutions. It aims to promote financial inclusion, economic development, and job creation for the SC population in primary, service, and manufacturing sectors.

scheme_name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: The Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group (CLSS for MIG) offers an interest subsidy on housing loans for the acquisition, construction, or repurchase of houses. It targets middle-income families who do not own a pucca house in India and have not availed of central housing assistance previously.

scheme_name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery
department: Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal
summary: This scheme provides credit-linked subsidies to rural entrepreneurs and farmer groups for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) of farm machinery. The initiative aims to enable farmers to hire high-end agricultural equipment at reasonable rates, thereby boosting rural employment, enhancing farm productivity, and mitigating climate risks.
required_documents: Self-authenticated photocopy of updated bank pass-book

scheme_name: Crop Cluster Development Programme
summary: The Crop Cluster Development Programme (CCDP) focuses on developing backward and forward integration in horticulture farming to enhance farmers' socio-economic security, achieve nutritional security, and generate rural employment. It promotes the collectivization of produce through farmer groups, establishes transparent institutional delivery mechanisms, and improves organized marketing of horticultural products.
required_documents: Registration certificate of the FPO under the Companies Act
List of Directors and applicants of the FPO
Business plan with backward and forward linkages of the produce
Financial statements and bank account details of the FPO
Any other documents specified in the application guidelines

scheme_name: Cultural Function And Production Grant Scheme
summary: The Cultural Function and Production Grant Scheme offers financial assistance to 'not-for-profit' organizations, NGOs, societies, trusts, and universities for organizing cultural events, seminars, workshops, festivals, and small research projects. The grant covers up to 75% of the project expenditure, generally capped at ₹5.00 lakhs per project, with provisions for higher amounts in exceptional cases.

eligibility_rules.value: NGO, Society, Trust, University, Not-for-profit Organization

required_documents: Constitution of the Board of Management or Governing Body or particulars of each member
Copy of the latest available Annual Report
Statement of income and expenditure for the previous three years
Copy of the balance sheet for the previous year certified by auditor

scheme_name: Cycle Anudaan Yojana
department: MP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Cycle Anudaan Yojana provides financial assistance of up to ₹4,000 to registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh for purchasing a bicycle. This initiative aims to ease transportation challenges and reduce the financial burden of traveling long distances to work sites.

scheme_name: Cycle Distribution Scheme
summary: The Cycle Distribution Scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides a cash amount equivalent to the cost of a bicycle to eligible tribal girl students. It aims to reduce the dropout rate and promote the continuation of education for Scheduled Tribe girls studying in Class 11 who travel more than 2 km to school.

scheme_name: Cycle Sahayata Yojana
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development
summary: Cycle Sahayata Yojana is a 100% state-sponsored scheme by the Government of Jharkhand that provides bicycles to registered women construction workers. The scheme aims to facilitate transportation and mobility for eligible female laborers in the state.
required_documents: Proof of Age / Date of Birth

scheme_name: D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme
summary: The D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme offers financial fellowships to encourage Goan scholars to undertake research in the fields of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies, and related areas. Fellowships are awarded at junior, senior, and post-doctoral levels for a maximum period of two years.
required_documents: Fifteen Years Certificate of Residence in Goa or Proof of Residence in Goa
Certificate of Passing of Maximum Qualification

scheme_name: Cycle Scheme for the Children of Construction Workers (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides free bicycles to the children of registered construction workers in Punjab who are studying in classes 9th to 12th. It aims to support the education and mobility of construction workers' children.
required_documents: Self declaration (if age proof not available)

scheme_name: DEVELOPMENT OF HANDICRAFTS
summary: The scheme aims to revive vanishing crafts, restore traditional handicrafts under the Viswakarma category, and develop skills to create better employment opportunities and boost the livelihood of rural poor in Puducherry. It provides a monthly stipend to trainees and financial assistance to trainers.

scheme_name: DPIIT Internship Scheme
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
summary: The DPIIT Internship Scheme provides students pursuing Under Graduate, Post Graduate, or Research Scholar programs with short-term exposure to the working culture of the Government of India and its schemes. Selected interns receive a monthly stipend of ₹10,000 for a duration ranging from one to three months.

scheme_name: Dai Didi Mobile Clinic Scheme
summary: The Dai Didi Mobile Clinic Scheme provides free medical check-ups, treatment, consultation, and medicine distribution to women and girls in rural areas of Chhattisgarh near their homes through female medical staff. It aims to overcome the hesitation and lack of time women face in visiting doctors.

scheme_name: Dairy Farming Scheme (HSFDC)
department: Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC)
summary: The Dairy Farming Scheme implemented by HSFDC provides financial assistance in the form of loans and a 50% subsidy (up to ₹10,000) to Scheduled Caste individuals from BPL families in Haryana. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and income-generation through dairy farming activities.
required_documents: Voter Card or any valid identity proof

scheme_name: Dalit Bandhu
summary: The Dalit Bandhu Scheme is an initiative by the government of Telangana to promote economic development among Scheduled Caste (SC) families. It provides a one-time financial grant of Rs. 10 lakhs to eligible households to start their own businesses or entrepreneurial ventures, aiming to foster self-reliance and reduce poverty.

scheme_name: Danveer Bhamashah Honors
summary: The Danveer Bhamashah Honors scheme by the Government of Chhattisgarh recognizes and rewards outstanding individuals and organizations for remarkable contributions to charity, hospitality, patriotism, and permanent social service works. Awardees receive an amount of ₹1,00,000 along with a certificate of appreciation.
required_documents: Detailed information about the work done in the field of charity and nationalism
Details of any other award received
Details and photocopy of any published report regarding excellent work
Photocopies/true copies of comments made by eminent persons, newspapers, and magazines regarding the work

scheme_name: Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to the families of registered workers in Uttar Pradesh who die while in service. The scheme aims to offer immediate financial relief to the deceased worker's spouse, dependents, or parents.
required_documents: Attested photocopy of the online filled application form
Photocopy of the beneficiary's bank passbook with IFS code
Photocopy of ration card, family register, or other government record confirming relationship
Death certificate issued by the Registrar (Birth/Death)

scheme_name: Day Care - cum - Recreation Centre and Physiotherapy Unit
summary: This scheme provides senior citizens in Puducherry with free physiotherapy and access to a day care cum recreation centre. Beneficiaries receive professional physiotherapy as advised by doctors.

scheme_name: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme For Higher Education For Orphans
summary: The Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme for Higher Education for Orphans is a fee waiver initiative by the Government of Goa. It supports orphans who have lost both parents by covering their education and living expenses from undergraduate to postgraduate levels in general and technical education.
required_documents: Death Certificate of Father and Mother
Proof of Enrolment into the First Year of Degree/PG Course
Fee Receipt of the Current Course Year

scheme_name: Death Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Death Assistance for Registered Worker scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 to the nominee, legal heir, or dependent family members of a registered construction worker in the event of their natural death. The deceased worker must have held an active regular membership with the HBOCWWB.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant (nominee/Legal heirs)
Regular registration certificate of the worker
An attested copy of the identity card of the registered worker in which payment of contribution up to the date of application is recorded

scheme_name: Computer Training Scheme
summary: The Uttar Pradesh government provides authorized computer training courses ('O' Level and 'CCC') to unemployed youth to enhance computer literacy and employment opportunities. Selected trainees also receive fee reimbursement up to specific limits based on their intermediate examination marks.

scheme_name: Death Assistance Scheme (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)
summary: The Death Assistance Scheme provides financial aid to the legal heir of a registered construction worker in the event of their natural or accidental death. The benefit amount varies based on the cause of death, such as ₹2,00,000 for natural death and ₹4,00,000 for accidental death.
required_documents: Identity Card of the Registered Worker
Proof of Age at the Time of Registration

scheme_name: Death Benefit
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Death Benefit scheme provides financial assistance to the nominee(s) of registered construction workers in West Bengal in the event of their natural or accidental death. The benefit amount is ₹50,000 for natural death and ₹1,50,000 for accidental death.
required_documents: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Death Certificate of the deceased member
Dependent/ Heirship Certificate of the applicant

scheme_name: Death Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB)
summary: The Death Assistance Scheme provides funeral assistance and ex-gratia payments to the legal heirs of registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh in the event of their death. It also offers financial compensation for permanent or partial temporary disabilities caused by accidents.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant (nominee/Legal heirs)
Regular registration certificate of the worker
An attested copy of the identity card of the registered worker

scheme_name: Death Benefit (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Death Benefit scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers in Assam in the event of normal death or accidental death during the course of employment. Financial aid ranges from ₹50,000 for normal death to ₹3,00,000 for accidental death.
required_documents: ABOCWWB ID Card of the deceased worker
Attested Copy of ID Card of the Deceased Worker
Death Certificate Issued by Government Doctor/Appropriate Authority
Certificate of Guardianship with consent from the other family members and minor nominee
Copy of Payslip of Account Paybook

scheme_name: Death Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
department: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Death Benefit scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of construction workers in the event of their natural or accidental death. Financial support ranges from ₹50,000 to ₹2,00,000 depending on the registration status of the worker and the cause of death.
required_documents: Copy of the nomination/legal heir certificate
Registration ID Card or Identity proof of deceased worker
A certificate from the Tehsildar stating that the deceased was a construction worker, in case of accidental death of a non-registered construction worker
Identity proof of nominee or dependent i.e. Aadhaar Card
beneficiary_categories: Nominees or Dependents of Deceased Workers

scheme_name: Death Benefit (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Death Benefit scheme provided by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers financial assistance to the nominee or dependant of a deceased registered worker. Assistance is granted for both natural deaths and accidental deaths occurring during the course of employment.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
A Certificate Citing the Cause of Death, issued by a Government Doctor, not below the Rank of an Assistant Surgeon
Document Establishing the Relationship between the Deceased Worker and the Applicant
Certificate from Builder or Inspector of the Area

scheme_name: Death Benefit (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Death Benefit scheme by the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance to the nominees of registered construction workers in the event of their natural or accidental death. Financial aid of ₹1,00,000 is provided for natural death and ₹2,00,000 for accidental death.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy

scheme_name: Death Benefit Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
summary: The Death Benefit Scheme provides financial assistance to the families of deceased registered construction workers in Arunachal Pradesh to mitigate economic losses resulting from normal or accidental death. Cash assistance is granted to the registered nominee of the worker.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.)
Registration card of the worker (Xerox and original copy)
Bank Account number / front page of the passbook

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
summary: The Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme provides financial assistance to voluntary organizations working for the education, training, and rehabilitation of persons with disabilities. It aims to create an enabling environment ensuring equal opportunities, equity, social justice, and empowerment for individuals with disabilities.
required_documents: Registration Certificate under Registration of Societies Act
Registration Certificate under PWD Act 1995/RPwD Act, 2016
Attested copy of Rent Agreement indicating validity period and details of accommodation available

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Divyangjan Pension Scheme - Assam
summary: The Deen Dayal Divyangjan Pension Scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to differently-abled persons in Assam to help them take care of their health. The scheme aims to empower Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) who possess a disability certificate of 40% or above issued by a competent authority.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar card, Voter ID Card, etc.)
Disability Certificate possessing 40% of disability and above issued by competent Govt. Authority
Bank account details (Passbook or IFSC Code)

scheme_name: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana
summary: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana is a scholarship scheme launched to award annual scholarships of ₹6,000 per annum to students in classes 6th to 9th who have good academic records and pursue Philately as a hobby. The objective is to promote philately among children at a young age to reinforce the academic curriculum and provide a relaxing hobby.
required_documents: Marksheets of the Previous Qualifying Examination
Philately Club's Membership or Account Details

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana
summary: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana is a state health insurance scheme by the Government of Goa that provides cashless medical care, treatment, hospitalization, and surgeries up to ₹4,00,000 annually through empaneled government and private hospitals.
required_documents: Aadhar Card/Enrolment Acknowledgement Slip of every family member above 5 years
Residence Proof (Passport, Residence Certificate, Election Card, or Driving License issued a minimum of 5 years ago in Goa)

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)- Mega Skill Centre
ministry: Ministry of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
summary: The Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)- Mega Skill Centre provides longer-duration residential skill training with on-job training (OJT) for the youth of Jharkhand. It integrates technical training with IT and soft skills to make candidates industry-ready across multiple sectors.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
summary: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana is a central skill training and placement program aimed at rural poor youth. It focuses on providing high-quality industry-relevant training and sustainable employment opportunities with regular monthly wages at or above the minimum wage.
required_documents: Disability Certificate, issued by competent authority (if applicable)
ST/SC Certificate, issued by competent authority (if applicable)
Self-Certification by the candidate for his/her status as Minority Community (if applicable)

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU)
summary: The DAYALU scheme provides socio-financial assistance in the event of natural or accidental death or permanent disability due to an accident for residents of Haryana. It targets families with an annual income of less than ₹1.80 lakh and offers varying compensation amounts based on the age of the individual at the time of the incident.
beneficiary_categories: Families facing death of a member

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II)
summary: The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II) provides financial assistance to residents of Haryana in the unfortunate event of accidental death or permanent disability caused by stray cattle or animals such as cows, bulls, dogs, and buffaloes. The financial assistance amount varies depending on the age of the beneficiary at the time of the incident.
required_documents: Permanent Disability Certificate from the Medical Authority

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Bunkar Yojana
summary: The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Bunkar Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to empower women weavers by facilitating access to affordable credit. It provides a 7% interest subvention on short-term credit, cash credit limits, and working capital loans obtained from commercial and regional rural banks.
required_documents: Proof of ownership or possession of working loom(s) certified by the Circle Officer

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
summary: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission is a flagship program aimed at reducing poverty by organizing rural poor into self-managed Self Help Groups, particularly empowering women. It enables these groups to access financial services, bank linkages, and various livelihood opportunities through a demand-driven approach.

scheme_name: Deepawali Cash Gift Scheme (PULWS)
summary: The Deepawali Cash Gift Scheme provides a financial assistance of ₹500/- as a cash gift to registered unorganized workers during the Diwali festival. The amount is credited directly into the worker's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
required_documents: Society ID Card/ Proof of Registration

scheme_name: Delhi Arogya Kosh
summary: Delhi Arogya Kosh provides financial assistance of up to Rs. 5 lacs to needy and eligible patients for diagnostic tests and treatment of various illnesses in designated government hospitals in Delhi. The scheme aims to support economically weaker sections by covering crucial medical expenses.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued from area SDM

scheme_name: Delhi Arogya Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: The Delhi Arogya Nidhi scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹1.5 lacs to needy patients holding National Food Security Cards for medical treatment in government hospitals within Delhi. Eligible beneficiaries must be continuous residents of Delhi for at least 3 years prior to application.
required_documents: Birth certificate (In case the patient is a minor)
Original Estimate Certificate duly signed by Consultant/ Medical Superintendent/ Chief Medical Officer of the Hospital

scheme_name: Delhi Family Benefit Scheme
summary: The Delhi Family Benefit Scheme provides one-time financial assistance of Rs 20,000 to families in Delhi who have lost their primary breadwinner. It aims to offer social security and assistance to needy households facing financial distress due to such a loss.
required_documents: Death certificate of the bread earner
One passport-size photo of the applicant

scheme_name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women & Children Development, Government of NCT of Delhi
summary: The Delhi Ladli Scheme provides financial assistance in the form of term deposits to empower girl children born in Delhi, promote their education, and reduce school drop-out rates. Financial aid is disbursed at various milestones from birth through institutional or home delivery up to higher education in Class 12th.
required_documents: Three years of residence proof in Delhi prior to registration
Income Certificate/Affidavit showing the annual income of the family
Birth certificate of the girl child issued by the Registrar of MCD/NDMC
Group photo of parents with the girl child
Caste certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC
Copy of the Aadhar Card of the parents and the child, if available

scheme_name: Delhi Pension Scheme To Women In Distress (Widow Pension)
summary: The Delhi Pension Scheme to Women in Distress provides financial assistance of ₹2,500 per month to vulnerable women such as widows, divorcees, and abandoned women residing in Delhi. It aims to offer social security to those lacking adequate means of subsistence and belonging to low-income households.
required_documents: Proof of Death of Husband/ Divorce decree/ Separation paper/ Divorce proceedings/ any other document which establishes abandoned/separation
Residence proof of last 5-year residence in Delhi
Bank account number (Single-operated) in Delhi linked with Aadhar

scheme_name: Dental Care Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Dental Care Scheme provides financial assistance to registered industrial and commercial workers in Haryana for dental treatments and full denture fixtures. Workers can receive up to ₹4,000 for general dental care and up to ₹10,000 for jaw implants or full dentures.
required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Denture Grant (Sainik Welfare)
summary: The Denture Grant scheme by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 for the purchase of dentures to eligible ex-servicemen and their widows. ECHS members are excluded from this benefit.
required_documents: Identity Card of the ESM/ Widow of ESM
Declaration by the ESM/ Widow of ESM

scheme_name: Denture, Spectacles & Hearing Aid Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Denture, Spectacles & Hearing Aid Scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Punjab, provides financial aid to registered construction workers and their family members for obtaining spectacles, dentures, and hearing aids. Financial assistance amounts up to ₹800 for spectacles, ₹5,000 for dentures, and ₹6,000 for hearing aids based on actual expenditure.
required_documents: Age proof (or self declaration if not available)

scheme_name: Dependent Children Pension Scheme - Punjab
ministry: Ministry of Social Welfare and Women & Child Development
department: Social Security and Women & Child Development Department
summary: The Dependent Children Pension Scheme provides financial security through a monthly pension to children whose parents have passed away, are regularly absent, or are incapacitated. Eligible children receive ₹1,500 per month directly into their bank accounts. The scheme is implemented by the Punjab government for permanent residents meeting specific income and age criteria.
required_documents: Beneficiary Photo ID cum Residence proof of the Parent/ Guardian (Driving License / Passport / Voter Card / Aadhaar Card)
Proof of disability (issued by competent authority)
Date of Birth Proof (Voter Card / Voter List / Matriculation certificate / Certificate from Registrar Birth & Death / Aadhaar Card)

scheme_name: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Design Scheme helps MSMEs avail expert advice for new product development and enhancement of existing product portfolios through design interventions. It operates through Design Projects and Design Awareness Programmes to integrate innovation and design strategies into businesses.
required_documents: Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration (UR) certificate

scheme_name: Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
summary: The Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme provides financial assistance and welfare benefits to elderly destitute agricultural labourers in Tamil Nadu. Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1,000, free clothing during festivals, and free rice provisions.

scheme_name: Destitute Differently Abled Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
summary: The Destitute Differently Abled Pension Scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- along with free clothing during festivals and nutritious meals to eligible differently-abled individuals. The scheme aims to support destitute persons with significant disabilities who lack independent sources of income.

scheme_name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Destitute Widow Pension Scheme provides financial assistance and welfare benefits to destitute widows in Tamil Nadu. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1,000, along with free sarees during festivals and free rice provisions.
required_documents: Smart Ration Card or Any Address Proof

scheme_name: Destitute/Deserted Wives Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Destitute/Deserted Wives Pension Scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to destitute or deserted wives. Additionally, beneficiaries receive free sarees during Pongal and Deepavali festivals and nutritious meals or rice through Anganwadi Centres.
required_documents: Smart Ration Card or Any Address Proof
Legal Separation Certificate (Issued by Court of law)
Any Identity Proof (Voter ID Card, Passport, PAN Card, Driving License)

scheme_name: Development Of Playfield Under CMSGUY
summary: The 'Development of Playfield' scheme is a component of the Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojna (CMSGUY) in Assam, aimed at developing infrastructure for sports. It provides funding and resources to upgrade playgrounds with facilities like earth-filling, turfing, dressing rooms, and boundary walls for schools, colleges, clubs, and sports organizations.

eligibility_rules.value: Schools, Colleges, Clubs, Sports Organizations, Gaon Panchayat

required_documents: Self-Attested documents in support of the mandatory fields of the Application Form
Bank Details of the School/College/Club/SportsAssociation/Panchayat/Institution (Account Number, Name of Bank, Name of Branch, IFS Code, Bank Balance as on date with Bank certificate)

scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Eco-certification of Coffee
summary: This scheme encourages coffee growers to access high-value specialty markets through the production of eco-certified coffees. It provides financial support of 50% of the certification cost (up to ₹50,000) to help growers adhere to recognized sustainability and quality standards, enabling higher returns.
required_documents: Application in the prescribed format (in duplicate)
Proof of identity of the grower or registration certificate in the case of growers' group
Copy of the certificate issued by the accredited Certification Agency
Copy of Patta/Khatha Extract or Land Ownership Documents

scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Replantation
summary: The scheme aims to improve the production and productivity of coffee plantations by encouraging the replantation of old, senile, and unproductive plantations with high-yielding, disease-tolerant coffee varieties. It provides financial subsidies to eligible small coffee growers for clean replanting or interlining of Arabica and Robusta coffee.
required_documents: Technical Feasibility Report (TFR) Application and Self Declaration

scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Support to Small Growers' Collectives/ SHGs/ Cooperatives for Coffee Marketing
summary: This scheme provides financial incentives to small growers' collectives, SHGs, and cooperatives to market coffee on a community-based approach. The objective is to improve coffee quality and enable better price realization through collective bargaining and recognized marketing platforms.

eligibility_rules.value: Small Growers' Collectives, Self Help Groups, Co-operatives

required_documents: Memorandum of the article of association/society as Growers' Collective/SHG/Cooperative
Complete list/details of members of the organization as per Annexure 1
Details of member-wise coffee along with each subsidy claim

scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation
summary: The scheme aims to improve the production and productivity of coffee plantations in traditional areas by encouraging water augmentation through subsidies for water harvesting structures and irrigation equipment. It provides financial assistance covering a percentage of the unit cost with specified ceilings per beneficiary, with additional support for SC/ST growers.
required_documents: Application and Self Declaration Duly Filled and Signed by the Applicant/s
Proof of Land Ownership (Copy of Patta / Khatha Extract along with Record of Rights)

scheme_name: Development and Maintenance of Orchard Cum Horti Nurseries
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
summary: The scheme aims to produce and multiply good, high-yielding, and disease-free planting materials in government farms for distribution to farmers. It provides farmers with training, awareness programs, extension services, and technology support to introduce new high-yielding varieties of mother plants.
required_documents: Documents proof of possessing own or leased land

scheme_name: Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture scheme aims to enhance the income of brackish water fishermen by promoting modern shrimp farming techniques, improving disease control, and boosting shrimp exports. It provides financial assistance and subsidies for shrimp farm development, equipment purchases, and related activities.
required_documents: Shrimp farm registration certificate or application receipt

scheme_name: Development of Choir Industries
summary: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Scheme Development Of Choir Industries to promote and develop coir and coir-based industries. It aims to train rural poor in producing coir products like coir rope and coir-mat to generate employment, offering a monthly stipend to trainees and honorarium to trainers.

scheme_name: Development of Strawberry Cultivation
summary: The Development of Strawberry Cultivation scheme provides farmers with quality planting materials and financial assistance for area expansion and commercial production of strawberries. Selected beneficiaries receive subsidies and support for purchasing strawberry runners and mulching materials.
required_documents: Documents proof of possessing own or leased land

scheme_name: Development of Industries-Training Scheme
summary: The Scheme Development Of Industries-Training Scheme provides skill development training and a monthly stipend to educated unemployed youths in Puducherry to help them start their own ventures or secure suitable employment. Selected candidates are sponsored for short-term trades in training institutions in neighboring states for a period of one year.

scheme_name: Devnarayan Chhatra Cycle Scheme
summary: The Devnarayan Chhatra Cycle Scheme aims to promote education and mobility among girl students by providing free bicycles. It is designed for girls belonging to Special Backward Classes (SBC) studying in the 9th grade in government schools across Rajasthan.

scheme_name: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
summary: The Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana provides free residential education, accommodation, meals, uniforms, and study materials to meritorious students from Special Backward Classes (SBC) in Rajasthan. Selected students are admitted to Class 6 in government-approved schools based on their Class 5 academic performance and a pre-admission examination.

scheme_name: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
summary: The Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance through maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement to students belonging to very backward classes in Rajasthan. It covers education from class 11 up to the PhD level for eligible candidates with a family income limit.

eligibility_rules.value: Banjara, Baladiya, Labana, Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raika, Raibari (Debasi), Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari

scheme_name: Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana
summary: The Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana provides an annual financial incentive of ₹3,500 to encourage academic excellence among students from Special Backward Classes (SBC) in Rajasthan. It supports students studying from Class 10th to the postgraduate level in government schools or colleges who meet specific academic and income criteria.

scheme_name: Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
summary: The Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance, free education, accommodation, meals, dress, and books to eligible students belonging to Extremely Backward Classes studying in classes 6th to 10th. It aims to support educational retention and reduce dropout rates among specific backward communities in Rajasthan.

eligibility_rules.value: Banjara, Baladiya, Labana, Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raika, Raibari (Debasi), Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari

scheme_name: Dhanvantari Arogya Rath Yojana (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker's Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Dhanvantari Arogya Rath Yojana provides primary medical treatment, diagnostic tests, and free medicines at the doorstep for registered construction workers and their families at construction sites and labour colonies. Implemented by the Gujarat government, it aims to prevent serious diseases and maintain the health of workers and their dependents.

scheme_name: Dhobhi Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Dhobhi Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana provides financial support to registered washermen in Chhattisgarh. Eligible beneficiaries receive essential work-related materials worth Rs. 1,500, such as irons, clothespins, and washing paddles.

scheme_name: Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen by the Government of Gujarat aims to reduce operational costs by subsidizing VAT on diesel for mechanized fishing boats. It provides financial assistance per litre of diesel up to ₹15/- based on a fixed quota throughout the year.
required_documents: Valid Diesel Card issued by the government
Identification proof (Aadhaar Card, Fishermen ID, etc.)

scheme_name: Differently Abled Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Differently Abled Pension Scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to eligible persons with disabilities of 40% and above. Additionally, beneficiaries receive free clothing during festivals and nutritious meals or rice through Anganwadi Centres.
required_documents: Smart Ration Card or Any Address Proof
Any Identity Proof (Voter ID Card, Passport, PAN Card, Driving License (Optional))

scheme_name: Diggy Scheme
summary: The Diggy Scheme by the Rajasthan Government provides financial subsidies to farmers for constructing water storage digs for irrigation purposes. It aims to encourage efficient water usage through sprinklers and drip systems to help farmers grow better crops without financial pressure.

scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana-Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: The Coir Vikas Yojana - Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana provides training and skill development programs to create skilled manpower and entrepreneurs in the coir industry. It offers programs such as Entrepreneurship Development Programmes and specialized training in coir spinning, weaving, and value-added product manufacturing. The initiative aims to transfer technology and upgrade skills for coir workers and artisans, with specific provisions to support women.
required_documents: Proof of NGOs registered in the Darpan Portal of NITI Aayog
Details of the source of raw material for training
Details of availability of machinery for training
Details of the mode of acquiring the basic Infrastructure

scheme_name: Digital India Internship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The Digital India Internship Scheme offers students pursuing graduate or postgraduate degrees in technology, engineering, law, or economics practical exposure to e-Governance and live projects under the Digital India initiative. Selected interns receive a token monthly stipend of ₹10,000 for a duration of two to three months upon satisfactory performance.
required_documents: Recommendation Letter from the Sponsoring Institute

scheme_name: Digital J&K Internship Scheme
summary: The Digital J&K Internship Scheme provides students with first-hand practical work experience and active learning opportunities in Jammu and Kashmir. Selected interns receive a monthly token stipend of ₹10,000 and an internship certificate upon successful completion.

scheme_name: Dilli Swarojgar Yojna
department: Delhi Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and Minorities Financial and Development Corporation (DSFDC)
summary: The Dilli Swarojgar Yojna provides need-based loans up to ₹5,00,000 at an interest rate of 6% per annum for income-generating activities. It targets individuals from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and Minority communities to help them start or expand small businesses.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, Minority

required_documents: Duly filled loan application form of Dilli Swarojgar Yojna
Caste Certificate issued by the Government of Delhi

scheme_name: Direct Lending Scheme
department: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC)
summary: The Direct Lending Scheme provides direct loans for the economic upliftment of Scheduled Castes and Handicapped People in Punjab. It offers financial assistance through loans along with a subsidy up to 50% or ₹ 10,000, whichever is less, to help beneficiaries start businesses or purchase land.
required_documents: Application form duly attested by competent Authority
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Punjab
Valuation Certificate of property to be mortgaged

scheme_name: Direct Loan Scheme Karnataka
ministry: Ministry of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka
summary: The Direct Loan Scheme provides financial assistance with a 50% subsidy and 50% loan to unemployed Scheduled Caste individuals from the leather artisan community in Karnataka. It aims to help them start or expand small-scale enterprises to improve their livelihoods.

eligibility_rules.value: Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, Chambar, Chamagar, Madar, Madig, Madiga, Mini Madig, Jambavalu, Haralayya, Machigar, Mochigar, Mochi, muchi, Telugu Mochi, kamaati mocha, Rohidas, Dhor, kakkayya, Kankayya, Samagara, Samagar, Aadhi Anddra, Aadhi Dravida, Aadhi Karnataka

required_documents: Passport-size Photograph of the applicant and his/her spouse

scheme_name: Direct Loans For Business Enterprise
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of business loans up to Rs 20 lakhs to persons belonging to the state's religious minority communities for starting or expanding their businesses. Loans are granted against the mortgage of property, with interest rates varying based on the annual family income.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar as residential proof
Caste Certificate Issued by the competent authority
Income Certificate Issued by the competent authority
Lease deed/Partition deed/Release deed/Gift deed/Rental agreement/Sale deed of the property
Project report/Profile of activities from CA(Chartered Accountant)

scheme_name: Disability (Due to Accident or Other Reason) Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Disability (Due to Accident or Other Reason) Scheme provides financial assistance to registered workers in industrial and commercial establishments in Haryana who suffer from a disability due to an accident or other reasons. Financial assistance ranges from ₹1,00,000 to ₹1,50,000 depending on the percentage of the disability.

eligibility_rules.value: worker in industrial or commercial establishment
registered with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: Smart Card/Office ID Proof of the worker

scheme_name: Disability Aids and Appliances - Telangana
ministry: Labour, Employment, Training and Factories Department
department: Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Disability Aids and Appliances scheme by the Telangana government provides free artificial limbs, wheelchairs, tricycles, and other fabricated appliances to registered construction workers who have sustained disabilities due to accidents. It aims to support differently-abled workers with necessary mobility and support aids.
required_documents: Registration Card under the BOCW Act (Attested copy)
Doctor Certificate (issued by the Medical Board)
Medical Reports (issued by the Medical Board)

scheme_name: Disability Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
