summary: The Disability Assistance scheme provides financial aid to registered construction workers in Andaman & Nicobar Islands who suffer a disability due to an accident during employment. It offers up to 25% of the total compensation due as calculated under the Employees Compensation Act 1923.
required_documents: Medical certificate regarding percentage of disability

scheme_name: Disability Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Disability Assistance for Registered Worker scheme provides lump sum financial assistance ranging from ₹1.50 lakh to ₹3.00 lakh to registered construction workers based on their percentage of disability. The disability must be a result of an accident at the workplace during the course of employment.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Disability Certificate issued by the Medical Board

scheme_name: Disability Benefit Who Met With an Accident at Worksite
department: Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers in Tripura who suffer temporary or permanent disability due to an accident at their worksite. Temporary disablement offers a percentage of the minimum wage for up to three months, while permanent disablement provides a monthly pension for severe disabilities exceeding 90%.
required_documents: Proof for Intimation of Notice of Accident

scheme_name: Disability Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Disability Pension scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers in Assam who suffer from permanent disabilities due to conditions like paralysis, leprosy, TB, or accidents. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension along with an additional amount based on years of service and a one-time ex-gratia payment.
required_documents: Experience Certificate/Employers Certificate (90 days working record to check eligibility)

scheme_name: Disability Pension (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Disability Pension scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers in Bihar who suffer from permanent or partial disabilities. Eligible workers receive a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- for permanent disabilities, alongside one-time lump sum amounts for total or partial permanent disabilities.
required_documents: Bank account details/copy of bank passbook
Disability Certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon-cum- Chief Medical Officer

scheme_name: Death Benefit (MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
summary: The Death Benefit scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers in Meghalaya in the event of their natural or accidental death during employment. Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 is provided for natural death and ₹3,00,000 for accidental death during the course of employment.
required_documents: Challan/Receipt of the Monthly Subscription paid
Nominee's ID Proof (Voter ID, Licence or others)
Guardian Certificate (in case Applicant is Minor)

scheme_name: Disability Pension (GBOCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Goa
summary: The Disability Pension scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹300 per month and an ex-gratia payment up to ₹10,000 to construction workers who are permanently disabled due to specific illnesses or accidents. It aims to support registered and eligible workers facing severe health challenges and permanent disabilities.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
Medical Certificate, stating the cause of the Disability
Certificate from the Builder or Inspector of the Area

scheme_name: Disability Pension (HPBOCWWB)
department: Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB)
summary: The Disability Pension scheme by HPBOCWWB provides registered construction workers with a monthly pension of ₹500/- for disabilities caused by accidents or diseases. Additionally, lump sum grants of ₹50,000/- for disabilities above 50% and ₹25,000/- for other qualifying disabilities are provided.
required_documents: Identity Proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Bank Account Details/ Copy of Bank Passbook
Medical Bill, countersigned by the Doctor (if applicable)

scheme_name: Disability Pension (MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
summary: The Disability Pension scheme provides financial assistance of ₹150 per month to registered construction workers in Meghalaya who have become permanently disabled due to conditions like paralysis, leprosy, TB, or accidents. Additionally, beneficiaries are eligible for an ex-gratia payment of up to ₹5,000 depending on the percentage of disability.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered under MBOCWWB with active membership

required_documents: ID Proof of worker (Electoral Card, Ration Card, Driver's License, Aadhaar Card, Passport)
Age proof of concerned building worker

scheme_name: Disability Pension - West Bengal
department: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare
summary: The West Bengal Disability Pension Scheme 2010 provides financial assistance to persons with disabilities who are unable to work and earn a living. It aims to support eligible individuals with specified disabilities and low family income residing in the state of West Bengal.

scheme_name: Disability Pension For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Disability Pension scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹3000/- to registered construction workers in Haryana who suffer from permanent disability between 70% to 100% due to an infectious disease or workplace accident. Applicants must have a minimum of three years of regular membership and not receive disability pensions from other government sources.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

scheme_name: Disability Pension and Ex-Gratia (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance through a monthly disability pension and ex-gratia payments to registered construction workers in Karnataka who suffer partial disability due to worksite accidents or diseases. The pension is provided until the beneficiary reaches the age of sixty.
required_documents: Beneficiary/original Identity card issued by the board

scheme_name: Disability Pension for the Construction Workers
summary: The scheme provides a monthly disability pension of ₹3,000 to registered construction workers in Delhi who suffer from permanent disabilities due to conditions like paralysis, leprosy, T.B., or accidents. Applicants must be registered with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and meet specific age and residency criteria.
required_documents: Permanent Disability certificate issued by Govt. Doctor (medical Certificate by committee)

scheme_name: Disability Relief Allowance Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Disability Relief Allowance Scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to eligible persons with disabilities in Himachal Pradesh. It helps beneficiaries manage their day-to-day living expenses and medical costs based on the severity of their disability and income criteria.
required_documents: Recommendation from the concerned Gram Panchayat

scheme_name: Disable Marriage Scheme (Divyang Lagna Sahay)
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
summary: The Disable Marriage Scheme provides financial assistance to couples where at least one person has a disability. The scheme offers ₹1,00,000 to couples where both individuals have disabilities and ₹50,000 when a non-disabled person marries a person with a disability.
required_documents: Attested copy of Disability Certificate from Civil Surgeon of girl/boy
Proof of Residence (any one of Ration Card/Electricity Bill/Driving License/Aadhaar Card/Election Card)
Copy of first page of bank passbook/cancelled cheque

scheme_name: Disabled Marriage Incentive Scheme
summary: The Disabled Wedding Incentive Scheme by the Government of Chhattisgarh provides financial assistance to newly married couples where one or both partners are persons with disabilities. The scheme aims to socially rehabilitate individuals with disabilities by offering a lump sum incentive ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000, provided they meet specific age, residency, and income criteria.
required_documents: Latest photograph of the married couple

scheme_name: Disabled Person Pension Scheme - Punjab
department: Social Security and Women & Child Development Department
summary: The Disabled Person Pension Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month to persons with disabilities in Punjab. The scheme aims to help differently abled individuals who lack a permanent source of income to meet their daily expenses.
required_documents: ID cum Residence proof of the Parent/ Guardian (Driving License / Passport / Voter Card / Aadhaar Card)
Proof of disability (issued by competent authority)
Date of Birth Proof of Person with Disability (Voter Card / Voter List / Matriculation certificate / Certificate from Registrar Birth & Death / Aadhaar Card )

scheme_name: Disabled State Level Award Scheme
summary: The Disabled State Level Award Scheme by the Government of Chhattisgarh aims to encourage persons with disabilities, employers, organizations, and districts working for their welfare and rehabilitation. It provides annual awards, cash prizes, and appreciation certificates on International Day with Disabilities to integrate PwDs into society.
required_documents: Details of the achievement along with supporting documents/papers
Adequate documentary evidence in support of the claim for the award

scheme_name: Disablement Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
department: Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Disablement Benefit Scheme offers financial assistance of ₹75,000/- to registered construction workers in Puducherry who have sustained a disability. The assistance is provided via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) based on a valid Disablement Certificate issued by the competent authority.

scheme_name: Disha - Early Intervention and School Readiness Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: The Disha scheme sets up centres to provide early intervention, therapies, training, and support for children with disabilities aged 0-10 years. It also offers day-care facilities and counselling for parents or guardians to improve daily living activities.

eligibility_rules.value: Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, Multiple Disabilities

required_documents: Birth Certificate or Date of Birth proof of the PwD
BPL certificate or Income certificate of Parent or Guardian
ID proof of parent or guardian

scheme_name: Distance Education Scheme for Girls
summary: The Distance Education Scheme for Girls, launched by the Government of Rajasthan, aims to support the higher education of girls and women by reimbursing their fees for undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and certificate courses pursued through distance learning. The scheme seeks to improve the Gross Enrollment Ratio and Gender Parity Index for females in higher education.
required_documents: Domicile Certificate/Proof of residence in Rajasthan
Non-judicial stamp of 100 Rupees (Not receiving any other scholarship from another department)

scheme_name: Distance Education Scholarship–Scholarship For Disabled Students Pursuing Degree, PG Courses
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to differently abled students in Kerala pursuing degree and postgraduate courses through open universities, distance education, or private registration. The scholarship covers expenses such as registration, course, tuition, and exam fees, as well as the purchase of books and study materials.
required_documents: Disability certificate from Medical board or Disability Identity card

scheme_name: Distress Relief Scheme
ministry: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
summary: The Distress Relief Scheme, launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu, provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households upon the death of their primary breadwinner. Eligible families must either be solely dependent on agriculture or have an annual income not exceeding ₹24,000.
required_documents: Breadwinner Death Certificate (attested by the Panchayat President)

scheme_name: Distress Relief Fund For The Differently Abled (Medical Treatment)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹5,000 per year to differently abled persons or those handicapped due to accidents for medical treatment and surgeries. It aims to support low-income individuals with specified disabilities or those in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card
Doctor's certificate that treatment is necessary
Bank account details- Copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Distribution Of Tractor Unit Under CMSGUY
summary: The Distribution of Tractor Unit scheme is a component of the Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojna (CMSGUY) in Assam, aimed at reviving the agricultural sector and doubling farmers' income. It provides a 70% subsidy to eligible groups of farmers for purchasing a tractor and necessary accessories in each revenue village.
required_documents: Aadhar Card of all members of the Group
Residential Certificate of all members of the Group
Identity Card of all members of the Group
PAN Card of all members of the Group
Voter ID Cards of all members of the Group
Group’s Bank Account Passbook and Bank Statement
Power of Attorney for Authorized Signatory in the form of an Affidavit
Proof of Land Holding of all members of the group

scheme_name: Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize scheme offers a subsidy on the cost of certified maize seeds to eligible farmers in selected districts of Tamil Nadu. It provides financial assistance covering 50% of the seed cost up to ₹1,200 per quintal, with special provisions for SC/ST and women farmers.

eligibility_rules.value: Coimbatore, Dindigul, Erode, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri, Namakkal, Perambalur, Virudhunagar, Theni, Villupuram, Vellore, Salem, Pudukkottai, Madurai, Sivagangai, Trichy, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi

required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, etc.)
Proof of land ownership or tenancy
Documents proving membership in women’s groups (if applicable)

scheme_name: Distribution of Certified Seeds-Oil Seeds
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Certified Seeds-Oil Seeds scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Tamil Nadu by subsidizing the cost of certified oil seeds. It aims to encourage the use of high-quality seeds to improve agricultural productivity and seed production.
required_documents: Proof of land ownership or cultivation
Certificate of seed production and supply to the Department

scheme_name: Distribution of Female Menstrual Hygiene Kit for the Construction Workers
summary: This welfare scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides female menstrual hygiene kits to registered female construction workers. The objective is to increase hygiene levels during their menstrual period.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Distribution of Free Books and Stationery to SC/ST Students
summary: This scheme provides free books worth ₹1,500/- and stationery worth ₹500/- per year to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in government colleges. The initiative aims to support the educational needs of underprivileged students in Madhya Pradesh.

scheme_name: Distribution of Gypsum
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Gypsum scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Tamil Nadu by subsidizing 50% of the cost of gypsum material and transportation costs. It is targeted at pulse crop growers to improve soil fertility and increase yield, with special provisions for SC/ST farmers and farm women.
required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar, Voter ID, etc.)

scheme_name: Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds scheme in Tamil Nadu provides financial assistance by subsidizing 50% of the cost of gypsum material and transportation to farmers. The subsidy is specifically for farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department of Agriculture.
required_documents: Certificate of seed production and supply to the Department (Foundation/Certified Class)

scheme_name: Distribution of Horticulture Kit to Urban and Rural Areas
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: The scheme provides horticulture growers in urban and rural areas with a horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 at a 75% subsidy. The kits are distributed during Aadipattam and Thaipattam seasons for homestead and backyard cultivation.
required_documents: Farmer identity card containing survey numbers and extent of land holding
Land document (sale deed, partition deed, gift deed, or will) if no identity card is issued

scheme_name: Distribution of Iron Boxes at Free of Cost
ministry: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide complimentary iron boxes to support individuals from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities who are engaged in washing work. It helps enhance their livelihood opportunities by supplying necessary working tools free of cost.

eligibility_rules.value: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, Denotified Communities

scheme_name: Devnarayan Scooty Distribution And Incentive Scheme
summary: The scheme aims to encourage girl students from extremely backward classes in Rajasthan to pursue higher education by providing free scooties based on merit and financial assistance. It seeks to promote academic excellence, foster a spirit of competition, and support higher studies through vehicle and monetary provisions.

scheme_name: Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme
department: Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs
summary: The Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme by the Government of Jharkhand aims to support eligible families under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013, Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme, and White Card holders. Beneficiaries receive 1 liter of kerosene oil monthly at subsidized rates through designated Public Distribution System (PDS) dealers.

eligibility_rules.value: NFSA beneficiary, Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiary, White Card holder

required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment Identification Slip
Bank or Post Office Passbook with Photo
Driving License issued under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
Certificate of Identity with Photo issued by a Gazetted Officer or Tehsildar
beneficiary_categories: Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries

scheme_name: Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment
summary: The Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Tamil Nadu. Eligible farmers who raise seed farms with pulse crops receive a subsidy of 50% on the cost of the equipment or up to ₹800, whichever is less.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Proof of Seed Farm with Pulses Crop
Bill or receipt of purchased equipment(s)
Proof of being a Farm Woman (if applicable)

scheme_name: Distribution of Minikits At Free of Cost
summary: The Distribution of Minikits at Free of Cost scheme provides free agricultural minikits and subsidies to eligible maize-growing farmers in specific districts of Tamil Nadu. It aims to support agricultural productivity and assist farmers engaged in maize cultivation.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Proof of being a Farm Woman (if applicable)

scheme_name: Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus scheme by the Tamil Nadu government provides financial subsidies to farmers cultivating pulses on seed farms. Beneficiaries receive 50% of the input cost, capped at ₹250 per hectare, to promote pest management.

scheme_name: Distribution of Pulses
department: Department of Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs
summary: The Distribution of Pulses scheme aims to provide essential pulses at affordable, subsidized rates to eligible low-income households in Jharkhand. It ensures nutritional support and food security by delivering benefits monthly through designated ration shops to cardholders under NFSA and JSFSS.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment Identification Slip
Bank or Post Office Passbook with Photo
Driving License issued under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
Certificate of Identity with a photo issued by a Gazetted Officer or Tehsildar on official letterhead

scheme_name: Distribution of Rhizobium
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Rhizobium scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides a subsidy to farmers for purchasing Rhizobium to improve soil fertility and crop yield in pulse farming. Beneficiaries receive 50% on the cost of Rhizobium or ₹100 per hectare, whichever is less.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

scheme_name: Distribution of Rhizobium Packets-Oilseeds
summary: The Distribution of Rhizobium Packets-Oilseeds scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides a subsidy to farmers producing and supplying Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department. Beneficiaries receive financial assistance of 50% on the cost of Rhizobium or ₹100/- per hectare, whichever is less.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Certificate of seed production and supply to the Department

scheme_name: Distribution of Soil Health Card
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Distribution of Soil Health Card scheme provides soil health cards to farmers in Tamil Nadu who submit soil samples for testing and pay a prescribed fee of ₹5/- each for macro and micronutrient testing. The initiative helps farmers understand the nutrient status of their soil to improve agricultural productivity.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Proof of soil sample submission and payment

scheme_name: Distribution of Sewing Machines at Free of Cost
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: This Tamil Nadu government scheme provides free sewing machines to eligible individuals from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities. It aims to empower beneficiaries socially and economically by supporting self-employment in tailoring.

scheme_name: Distribution of Vegetable Seeds Minikit & Fruits Minikit at Free of Cost
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare
summary: This scheme provides vegetable and fruit seed minikits worth ₹250 completely free of cost to horticulture growers in rural and urban areas. The objective is to support the establishment of nutritional gardens.
required_documents: Farmer identity card containing survey numbers and land holding details
Land document (sale deed, partition deed, gift deed, or will) if no identity card is issued

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Consumer Durables T.V., Fridge and Two Wheelers Loan
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Tamil Nadu
summary: This scheme offers loans covering up to 75% of the product cost for purchasing consumer durables such as televisions, refrigerators, and two-wheelers. It features an interest rate of 14% and is aimed at residents of Tamil Nadu through District Central Cooperative Banks.

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Housing, House Construction, Repair Extension Loan
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- to citizens of Tamil Nadu for housing construction, repair, and extension purposes. Loans are disbursed through District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches at an applicable interest rate of 12%.
required_documents: Property Documents (Proof of ownership/ Property Deed, etc.)

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Jewel Loan
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: This scheme launched by the Tamil Nadu government allows citizens to obtain loans up to ₹1,00,000/- by pledging their gold and jewelry at District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches. The loan carries an interest rate of 12% subject to bank policy changes.
required_documents: Valuation certificate for the pledged jewelry

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Maternity Loan through Self Help Groups
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: The scheme offers financial support of up to ₹2,000/- through Self Help Groups to pregnant women for maternity-related expenses at an interest rate of 11%. It aims to assist women in managing health and wellness costs during pregnancy.

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Professional Loan to Doctors, Engineers and Self Employed Professional
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000 to doctors, engineers, and self-employed professionals in Tamil Nadu at a competitive interest rate. It aims to help professionals expand or enhance their professional activities for business purposes.

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Revamped Micro Credit Loan for Women Vendors of Flower, Vegetable, Fruit etc.
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: This scheme provides revamped micro-credit loans ranging from ₹100 to ₹5,000 to women vendors selling items like flowers, vegetables, and fruits in Tamil Nadu. It aims to support their small businesses and enhance income generation opportunities with an applicable interest rate of 11%.

eligibility_rules.value: Flower Vendor, Vegetable Vendor, Fruit Vendor

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For SSI Unit Loan and Other NFS Activities
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance through District Central Cooperative Banks in Tamil Nadu by offering loans up to ₹1,00,000 for small-scale industries (SSI) and other non-farm sector (NFS) activities. It aims to support rural and industrial development with a standard interest rate of 13%.

eligibility_rules.value: Small Scale Industry or Non-Farm Sector Activity

required_documents: Business Plan or Project Report (if applicable)

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Women Entrepreneurs
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: This scheme provides financial support to women entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu by offering loans up to ₹5,00,000/- through District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches. The loans are extended at an interest rate of 12% to help women start or grow their businesses.

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Working Women
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support through a loan of up to ₹20,000/- at a nominal interest rate of 12% to working women. The loans are facilitated by District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches to support professional and personal growth.
required_documents: Proof of employment or work-related documents

scheme_name: District Innovation And Challenge Fund
summary: The District Innovation and Challenge Fund (DICF) is an innovation scheme by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh designed to instill competitiveness among Deputy Commissioners and bring innovation in the design, planning, and implementation of critical infrastructure. It aims to introduce cutting-edge technology, foster community participation, and deliver effective developmental outcomes.
required_documents: A project plan with land availability and non-duplicity certificate where applicable

scheme_name: Divyang Boys/ Girls Marriage Incentive Grant
summary: The Divyang Youth / Girl Marriage Incentive Grant scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 to couples where either the bride or the groom is a Person with Disability (PwD). The scheme aims to support the marriage of individuals with disabilities in the state of Uttarakhand.
required_documents: Photocopy of Unique Disability ID Card
Certificate of Permanent Residence/ Proof of Residence in the State for 5 years
Self-declaration of not being an income tax payer
Self-declaration of not being involved in criminal cases

scheme_name: Divyang Pension Scheme
summary: The Divyang Pension Scheme by the Government of Uttarakhand aims to provide financial assistance to specially abled individuals who lack independent means of livelihood. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- to support their sustenance.
required_documents: BPL certificate or income certificate issued by the Tahsildar
Proposal for open meeting of Gram Sabha
Disability Certificate or Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card

scheme_name: Divyang Pension Yojana
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: The Divyang Pension Yojana is a state-level social welfare scheme providing monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,000 to eligible persons with disabilities in Uttar Pradesh. The scheme aims to support their livelihood and improve their standard of living.

scheme_name: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial support of ₹600 per month to disabled children. The scheme aims to promote inclusive education and ensure equal access to educational opportunities for persons with disabilities.

scheme_name: Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme
summary: The Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme by the Government of Chhattisgarh provides monthly financial assistance for the education and training of differently-abled regular students studying in schools or colleges. Financial aid varies by standard, ranging from ₹150 to ₹190 per month.

scheme_name: Diwali Gift Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
summary: The Diwali Gift Benefit Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 2,000/- annually to registered construction workers to celebrate the Diwali festival. The amount is directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

scheme_name: Domestic Funding Of Foreign Training
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
summary: The Domestic Funding of Foreign Training (DFFT) scheme upgrades the knowledge and skills of Government officers by providing exposure to international best practices through long and short-term foreign training programmes. It aims to leverage officers' capabilities in policy and governance by nominating them to universities and institutes abroad.
required_documents: Valid Email ID, preferably NIC Email ID
A signed copy of the undertaking
Any other documents as required for the programme

scheme_name: Doodh Sanjivani Scheme
summary: The Doodh Sanjivani Scheme by the Government of Gujarat aims to improve the nutritional status of children and women in tribal and underdeveloped areas. It provides fortified flavored milk to children aged 6 months to 6 years and to pregnant and lactating mothers registered at Anganwadi centers.
required_documents: Identity proof (e.g., Aadhaar card, ration card)
Pregnancy proof for pregnant mothers (e.g., medical certificate)

scheme_name: Distribution of Free House Sites to Scheduled Caste/Other Economically Backward Classes
summary: Launched in 1981 by the Government of Puducherry, this scheme provides free house sites to homeless poor Scheduled Caste and Economically Backward Class individuals. The initiative aims to enable eligible beneficiaries to construct their own houses.
required_documents: Certification from the Revenue Department stating the applicant's non-ownership of a house

scheme_name: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides interest subsidy to meritorious students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs) on education loans taken for pursuing approved Master's, M.Phil., and PhD courses abroad. The government bears the interest payable during the moratorium period to help enhance their employability through higher education.

scheme_name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
summary: The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme provides a cash award of ₹5,000 to economically disadvantaged students who secure the highest marks in their Class 12 board examinations from government schools within their district in Madhya Pradesh. The financial assistance is directly credited to the student's bank account to support their education.

scheme_name: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana
summary: The Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahayata Yojana provides financial assistance to the children of registered workers in Uttar Pradesh for pursuing technical education. It covers degree, diploma, and certificate courses to help promote higher education among workers' families.
required_documents: Verified copy of the online filled application form related to the scheme
Photocopy of the passbook of the son/daughter or the worker (with the IFSC code of the bank)
Photocopy of the certificate of admission or studying in technical education (fee receipt or other)

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for the Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scholarship scheme provides financial assistance to Economically Backward Class (EBC) students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in India. It aims to help them complete their education by covering maintenance allowances and non-refundable fees.
required_documents: Attested copies of certificates, diplomas, or degrees for all examinations

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- to economically weaker Scheduled Caste individuals in Gujarat who do not own a residential home or have a rough house, enabling them to construct a proper house. The assistance is distributed in three installments and targets Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in both urban and rural areas.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority
Proof of land ownership/document/title deed/certificate deed
Copy of first page of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Check

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation Essay Competition Scheme for Class 10th-12th & Colleges/Universities/Institutions Students in 22 Indian Languages and English
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme awards cash prizes and recognition to students from schools, colleges, and universities who write insightful essays on Babasaheb Ambedkar's thoughts on social justice, empowerment, and national integration. It aims to encourage youth to engage with the values of equality and social harmony through 22 Indian languages and English.
required_documents: Signature of the Head of the Institution

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chattar Sansodhit Yojna
summary: The Haryana government provides annual financial incentives ranging from Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 12,000 to meritorious students from Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, and other specified communities. The scheme covers students from class 11th up to the postgraduate level to foster academic competition and excellence.
required_documents: Academic Marksheet of the qualifying exam

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students
summary: This scheme provides a scholarship of ₹18,000 per year for two successive years to the top 1000 meritorious OBC students based on their Matric examination results in Himachal Pradesh. It supports students pursuing recognized academic, professional, or technical courses within or outside the state.
required_documents: Copy of Marks Certificate for Previous Years
Copy of the first page of the Bank Passbook
Copy of Student School Bonafide Certificate signed by Principal

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students
summary: This scheme provides a scholarship of ₹18,000 per year for two successive years to the top 1250 meritorious Scheduled Caste students after matriculation. It is applicable for students pursuing professional or technical courses in recognized institutions within or outside Himachal Pradesh.
required_documents: Copy of Marks Certificate for Previous Years
Copy of the first page of the Bank Passbook
Copy of Student School Bonafide Certificate signed by Principal

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme
department: Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana
summary: The Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme provides financial assistance for medical treatment and surgeries for serious ailments such as kidney, heart, liver, cancer, and brain diseases, as well as knee and spinal surgeries. It is designed for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe individuals belonging to low-income families. The scheme covers treatments at designated empanelled hospitals across India.
required_documents: Original Estimated Cost certificate signed by the Medical Superintendent of the concerned hospital
Original or attested photocopies of the income certificate
Application recommended and forwarded by a local sitting Member of Parliament or District Magistrate/Collector/Deputy Commissioner

scheme_name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar State Award To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
department: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Government of NCT of Delhi
summary: This scheme provides a financial award of INR 25,000 to eligible meritorious students belonging to SC/ST/OBC and Minority communities who secure the top position in professional or technical degree courses at the graduation level in Delhi.

scheme_name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Awas Navinikarn Yojna
summary: The Haryana government launched the BR Ambedkar Awas Navinikaran Yojana to assist backward and scheduled classes by providing financial assistance ranging from Rs 50,000 to Rs 80,000 for home repairs. Eligible beneficiaries include permanent residents of Haryana who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families and specific scheduled or backward castes.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Castes, De-notified Tribes, Tapriwas Caste

required_documents: Caste Certificate if belong to SC & BC
Aadhaar linked bank passbook with photo
BPL Ration card of both side

scheme_name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students
summary: The Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award provides a cash award of ₹15,000 to top-ranking Scheduled Caste boy and girl students in each region who secure at least 55% marks in the Higher Secondary Examination. It aims to encourage academic excellence among SC students in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment ID

scheme_name: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
summary: The scheme provides a financial loan of up to ₹15 lakhs at an interest rate of 4% to eligible Scheduled Caste students of Gujarat for pursuing higher studies, graduate, and postgraduate courses abroad. It aims to support bright students who face financial constraints in accessing international education.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (Ration Card/Electricity Bill/License/ Rent Agreement)
First page copy of bank passbook/cancelled cheque

scheme_name: Dr. Babu Jagjivan Ram Living cum work shed Construction Scheme
summary: The Dr. Babu Jagjivan Ram Living cum work shed Construction Scheme provides financial assistance to houseless leather artisans belonging to specific Scheduled Caste sub-castes for constructing living cum work sheds. Eligible beneficiaries receive a government subsidy of up to ₹2,20,000 for construction, alongside a beneficiary contribution.
required_documents: Passport-size Photograph of the applicant and spouse
Skill test certificate issued by the Technical Section Committee of the Corporation

scheme_name: Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Meritorious Student Award Scheme
summary: The Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Meritorious Student Award Scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh encourages Scheduled Caste students to achieve high academic scores by awarding special cash prizes. It recognizes students who secure the highest marks in Class 10th and 12th board examinations from recognized boards within the state.
required_documents: Passing marksheet with the highest marks in the state

scheme_name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department
summary: The Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Aarthik Kalyan Yojana provides a 7% annual interest subsidy on loans for up to 5 years to support new self-employment ventures for Scheduled Caste beneficiaries in Madhya Pradesh. The project limit ranges from ₹10,000 to ₹1 lakh across industry, service, and business sectors.

scheme_name: Disability Relief - Telangana
ministry: Labour, Employment, Training and Factories Department, Telangana
department: Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Disability Relief - TBOCWWB scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers in Telangana who suffer from total or partial permanent disabilities due to workplace accidents. It offers enhanced relief amounts to help these workers cope with the resulting financial burdens.
required_documents: Registration Card under the BOCW Act (Attested copy)

scheme_name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant For Newly Recruited Faculty Members
summary: The scheme provides financial support of up to ₹10,00,000 for a tenure of 2 years to newly appointed permanent Assistant Professors in eligible universities and institutes to pursue research in their respective fields. It aims to encourage research by enabling faculty members to purchase minor equipment, consumables, and cover fieldwork or travel costs.
required_documents: Scanned copy of passport-size photograph and signature
Complete Research proposal and an abstract
Signed auto-generated application form by HoD/Registrar

scheme_name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships In Sciences
summary: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences offers financial assistance and fellowships to young unemployed researchers who have been awarded a Ph.D. degree under the science faculty. The scheme supports full-time research work for a multi-year tenure with contingency and HRA provisions.

scheme_name: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme-I
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme encourages widow remarriage and rehabilitates widows in Tamil Nadu by providing financial assistance along with a gold coin. Eligible beneficiaries receive ₹25,000/- through ECS and National Savings Certificates, plus one sovereign of 22-carat gold.
required_documents: Death Certificate of the First Husband
Certificate to Prove First Marriage of the Bridegroom From Tahsildar or MLA

scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-I
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme aims to abolish caste and community discrimination by encouraging inter-caste marriages. It provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 and a 1 sovereign gold coin for Thirumangalyam to newly married couples where one spouse belongs to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe and the other from a different community.

scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-II
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: This scheme aims to abolish caste and community discrimination in Tamil Nadu by providing financial assistance and a gold coin to newly married inter-caste couples where one spouse is from a forward community and the other is from a Backward Class or Most Backward Class community. Eligible couples receive financial aid totaling ₹50,000 along with a 1-sovereign 22-carat gold coin for Thirumangalyam.

eligibility_rules.value: Backward Class / Most Backward Class Community

required_documents: Marriage Invitation or Marriage Registration Certificate

scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Law Graduates of Scheduled Caste
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹12,000 (comprising a 4% interest loan of ₹7,000 and a subsidy of ₹5,000) to Scheduled Caste law graduates in Gujarat to help them purchase business premises or shops for starting independent legal practice.
required_documents: Proof of annual income of the family
Receipt of registration copy/fee payment from Bar Council
Rent slip of office premises for one year
Certificate of class and marks obtained in the examination

scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and loans up to ₹2,50,000 at a 4% interest rate, along with a ₹25,000 subsidy, to unemployed Scheduled Caste medical graduates in Gujarat to help them establish their independent medical practice.
required_documents: Proof of annual income of the family
Proof of Residence (Electricity Bill/Licence/Rent Agreement/Electoral Card/Ration Card)
Copy of registration Certificate of Medical Graduate Degree
Proof of the age of the applicant/School leaving certificate
Copy of first page of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Check

scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Post Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and loans to Scheduled Caste Medical Post Graduate (M.D/M.S) doctors in Gujarat to help them start their independent profession, clinic, or consultation room. It offers a subsidy of ₹50,000 and loans up to ₹3,00,000 at a 4% interest rate.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (Any one of Electricity Bill/License/Rent Agreement/Electoral Card/Ration Card)
Copy of registration Certificate of Medical Post Graduate Degree
Proof of age of applicant/School leaving certificate (if any)
Copy of first page of bank passbook/cancelled cheque

scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Stipend to Scheduled Caste Lawyers
summary: The Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme provides a monthly stipend for three years to law graduates belonging to the Scheduled Caste category in Gujarat to help them overcome poor financial conditions and prevent mid-practice dropout. A parallel stipend is also provided to the senior lawyer who trains them.
required_documents: School Leaving Certificate of Junior Advocate
Junior Lawyer Charter or Enrolment Number-date
Junior Lawyer Bar Council Identity Card

scheme_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance
summary: The Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance is a Maharashtra government scheme that provides financial assistance for hostel maintenance to students from economically weaker sections pursuing higher education in professional and technical courses. It aims to support deserving students and ensure equal access to higher education.
required_documents: Proof letter approved from tahsildar / Income certificate of Parents (for registered labourers/aplabhudarak shetkari)

scheme_name: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship
summary: The Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship provides an opportunity for unemployed young researchers to carry out advanced studies and research in Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Humanities, and Social Sciences. It offers a 3-year fellowship tenure to groom scholars for academic and research careers in Indian universities and institutions.
required_documents: Signed auto-generated application form by HoD/Registrar

scheme_name: Dr. Savitaben Ambedkar Inter Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,50,000 to couples to encourage inter-caste marriages between individuals belonging to Scheduled Castes and other Hindu castes. The assistance is distributed as ₹1,00,000 for domestic expenses and ₹1,50,000 in National Savings Certificates in the joint name of the couple.
required_documents: Proof of death of previous spouse (if widower/widow)

scheme_name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Insurance Scheme
summary: The Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Insurance Scheme provides end-to-end cashless medical services for secondary and tertiary care to low-income families in Andhra Pradesh. It aims to offer financial security against catastrophic health expenditures and ensure free quality hospital care for BPL and eligible households.

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Manufacturing Sector)
summary: The Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana provides financial relief through interest subsidies on term loans for manufacturing enterprises run by SC/ST entrepreneurs in Gujarat. It aims to empower the MSME sector, enhance global competitiveness, and offers additional benefits for women, differently-abled, startups, and young entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Printed copy of the application along with declaration and undertaking signed by an authorized person
Copy of acknowledgment of Udyog Aadhaar / Udyam Registration
Copy of term loan sanction letter
Copy of term loan account statement / bank certification of first disbursement certificate

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)
summary: The Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana provides interest subsidy on term loans to support micro-enterprises in the service sector run by SC/ST entrepreneurs in Gujarat. It aims to empower SC/ST entrepreneurs, strengthen the MSME sector, and make them globally competitive.
required_documents: Printed copy of the application along with declaration and undertaking
Copy of acknowledgment of Udyog Aadhaar / Udyam Registration
Copy of term loan sanction letter
Copy of term loan account statement / bank certification of first disbursement certificate

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Power Connection Charges
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST entrepreneurs running Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) located outside GIDC or approved industrial parks in Gujarat. It reimburses 50% of charges paid for new power connections, additional load, or service line expansion up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000.
required_documents: Copy of the Constitution of the enterprise
CA Certified Balance sheet /Annual Audit Report
Land Document such as NA Permission/ copy of Index/sale Deed
PAN card of Enterprise, Promoters/partners/directors and Authorized Signatory
Estimates of Power Distribution company (DISCOM) and Receipt

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Quality Certification
summary: This scheme supports SC/ST entrepreneurs in Gujarat's manufacturing MSME sector to obtain national/international quality certifications and implement ERP systems. It provides financial assistance covering 75% of ERP costs up to ₹1,00,000 and a portion of quality certification expenses to enhance global competitiveness.
required_documents: Copy of the Constitution of the enterprise
CA certified Detailed expenditure statement for obtaining the Quality Certification
Copy of proof of Recognized/ Approved Certification body
Undertaking for any assistance from GoG and Gol

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Raising Capital through SME Exchange
summary: This scheme aims to support SC/ST entrepreneurs in Gujarat's MSME sector by providing financial assistance to help them raise equity capital through listing on SME Exchanges. Eligible enterprises can receive up to 30% of the total expenditure incurred for raising capital, capped at ₹5,00,000.
required_documents: Constitution of Enterprise (Memorandum & Articles of Association)
Copy of SME Exchange Registration Listing related letter by BSE/NSE/SME Exchange
CA Certificate regarding MSME status as per MSMED

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Technology Acquisition
summary: This scheme supports SC/ST entrepreneurs in the MSME sector by providing financial assistance for acquiring appropriate technology for products or processes. It covers up to 70% of the technology acquisition cost, including royalty payments for the first two years, up to ₹50,00,000/-.
required_documents: Constitution of Enterprise (Memorandum of association, partnership deed, etc)
Power of attorney / Board Resolution of Authorized Signatory/consent letter
Copy of signed & stamped MOU/Agreement/Contract regarding technology acquisition
CA certificate regarding fixed capital investment

scheme_name: Double Bedroom Housing Scheme (2BHK Scheme)
summary: The Government of Telangana provides 100% subsidized double bedroom houses to poor families with zero beneficiary contribution. The scheme offers a 560 sqft plinth area unit containing two bedrooms, a hall, a kitchen, and two toilets, along with free land.
required_documents: Aadhar Card of Applicant and Family Members
Voter ID card of the Applicant

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Implementation of Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) run by SC/ST entrepreneurs for implementing Information and Communication Technology (ICT) solutions. It covers up to 75% of the capital expenditure for ICT facilities, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000/-. The initiative aims to empower SC/ST entrepreneurs and make MSMEs globally competitive.
required_documents: Copy of the Constitution of the enterprise
CA certificate for fixed capital investment
CA certified Detailed expenditure statement for obtaining the ICT System
Undertaking for any assistance from GoG and Gol
Copy of the bill of expenditure occurred
Copy of GPCB approved NOC/Consent & other departments approval

scheme_name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: Small Road Transport Operators Loan (SRTO Loan)
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: The Small Road Transport Operators Loan (SRTO Loan) scheme provided by District Central Cooperative Banks in Tamil Nadu offers loans up to ₹10,00,000/- for small road transport operations. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for transport infrastructure with an applicable interest rate of 13%.
required_documents: Proof of being a Small Road Transport Operator

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance of Capital Investment Subsidy
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance through a capital investment subsidy to micro and small manufacturing enterprises run by SC/ST entrepreneurs in Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's MSME sector and make SC/ST entrepreneurs globally competitive by offering incentives on term loans.
required_documents: Printed copy of the application along with declaration and undertaking in the application form signed by an authorized person, including their designation and name with the enterprise's stamp
Copy of acknowledgment of Udyog Aadhaar / Udyam Registration
Copy of term loan sanction letter
Copy of term loan account statement / bank certification of first disbursement certificate

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to GIDC for Developing Multi-Storied Shed in Estates
summary: The Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana supports SC/ST entrepreneurs by providing financial assistance to GIDC for developing multi-storied industrial sheds. Eligible MSMEs run by SC/ST entrepreneurs receive up to 70% subsidy on the allotment price, requiring them to pay only 30% to take possession.
required_documents: Proof of payment (30% of allotment price)
Business plan and proposed activities in the shed

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of rent reimbursement to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in Gujarat run by SC/ST entrepreneurs. Eligible manufacturing units operating from rented or leased sheds can receive up to 70% of their rent reimbursed, subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,000 per annum.
required_documents: Copy of the Constitution of the enterprise
CA certificate for fixed capital investment
Copy of Self Certified Share Holding Pattern
Copy of Property Document/ Copy of Index/Copy of sale deed

scheme_name: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme-II
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme aims to encourage widow remarriage and rehabilitate widows by providing financial assistance and a gold coin. Eligible applicants receive ₹25,000/- along with a 1 sovereign 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.
required_documents: Death Certificate of the First Husband
Certificate to Prove First Marriage of the Bridegroom From Tahsildar or MLA

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to MSEs for Shed Developed by Private Developer
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST entrepreneurs for acquiring industrial sheds in mini estates developed by private developers in Gujarat. It aims to empower the MSME sector by supporting SC/ST-run enterprises with subsidized infrastructure costs.
required_documents: Proof of payment (30% of allotment price)
Business plan and proposed activities in the shed

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) run by SC/ST entrepreneurs in the manufacturing sector of Gujarat for participating in state, national, and international exhibitions. The assistance covers costs like stall rent, product literature, and display materials to enhance market exposure and business growth.
required_documents: Proof of Participation in the exhibition

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE) of SC/ST for Plot Developed by GIDC
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to 70% of the plot allotment price to SC/ST entrepreneurs for developing micro and small enterprises in GIDC-approved estates in Gujarat. It aims to support industrial infrastructure development, improve last-mile connectivity, and empower SC/ST-owned MSMEs.
required_documents: Payment receipt of 30% of the allotment price

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to Special Entrepreneurship Degree Approach Training with 360 Promoters/ with Mentoring Support and Sustenance Allowance for Entrepreneurs
summary: This scheme aims to empower SC/ST entrepreneurs by providing special entrepreneurship training with 100% coverage of training fees, expert mentorship support, and sustenance allowance. Implemented by the Center for Entrepreneurship Development (CED), it helps first-generation entrepreneurs establish and sustain their businesses.
required_documents: Details of Govt. Dues and Outstanding
Details of Legal Constitution of the Organization

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to basic industrial infrastructure (Water, Gas and Approach Road)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST entrepreneurs for developing basic industrial infrastructure such as water supply, gas connections, and approach roads for MSMEs located outside GIDC areas. It aims to improve last-mile connectivity and foster a conducive business environment in Gujarat by covering up to 75% of the capital investment costs, capped at ₹15,00,000.
required_documents: Project Proposal detailing the infrastructure requirements
Cost Estimates for the approach road, water, or gas connection
Proof of Investment in infrastructure development
Quality Certification from a government-approved third party (for approach roads)
Company Registration Certificate or proof of industrial establishment

scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Financial Support to MSMEs in ZED Certification
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 to SC/ST-owned MSMEs in Gujarat to obtain Zero Defect and Zero Effect (ZED) certification. It aims to promote quality improvement, energy efficiency, and advanced manufacturing standards.
required_documents: Copy of the Constitution of the Enterprise
CA Certificate for Fixed Capital Investment
CA-Certified Detailed Expenditure Statement for Obtaining ZED Certification
Undertaking for Any Assistance from GoG and GoI
Copy of the Bill of Expenditure Incurred

scheme_name: Drip Sanyantr
summary: The Drip Sanyantr scheme provides financial subsidies to farmers in Rajasthan for installing drip irrigation systems. It promotes efficient water utilization, saves 75-80 percent of water, and enhances quality agricultural production.

scheme_name: Dulari Kanya
summary: Dulari Kanya is an Arunachal Pradesh state scheme aimed at ending gender preference, encouraging institutional delivery and child immunization, preventing child marriage, and empowering the girl child. Under this scheme, ₹20,000 is deposited into a minor fixed deposit bank account for eligible girl children born in government or recognized private hospitals, which can be withdrawn upon turning 18.

eligibility_rules.value: Government Hospital or Government recognized private hospital in Arunachal Pradesh
Schedule Tribe of Arunachal Pradesh or Domicile Resident of Arunachal Pradesh

required_documents: Copy of Delivery / Discharge Certificate by the MO of the Hospital
Copy of Birth Certificate Issued by the Registrar of Birth & Death
Copy of Schedule Tribe Certificate of Father / Guardians or Domicile Certificate

scheme_name: Dulari Scheme
summary: The Dulari Scheme provides financial incentives to newborn baby girls and educational incentives to girl children upon passing standard VIII, X, and XII in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. It aims to support the health and education of girl children and prevent early child marriage.
required_documents: Identity proof of parent(s) i.e. Aadhaar Card
Mark sheet of Class VIII/X/XII, if applicable
Bonafide certificate from the school or school leaving certificate, if applicable

scheme_name: Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
summary: The Chhattisgarh Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana provides medical financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 or the actual treatment expenditure, whichever is less, to registered construction workers in case of accidents. The scheme is managed by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh for the welfare of registered laborers.

scheme_name: E-Medhabruti
summary: The e-Medhabruti scheme by the Government of Odisha provides financial assistance of up to ₹ 20,000 to meritorious students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, and technical or professional courses. The scholarship is awarded to eligible students in their first year of joining whose annual parental income does not exceed ₹ 6,00,000.

scheme_name: Dwarf Pension Scheme
summary: The Dwarf Pension Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,200 per month to individuals suffering from dwarfism in Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to offer social security, improve livelihoods, and integrate people with dwarfism into mainstream society.
required_documents: Height certificate issued by Social Welfare Department Officer

scheme_name: E-Thela Sahaayata Yojana
summary: The E-Thela Sahaayata Yojana by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh provides financial assistance and grants to empower unorganized workers for purchasing e-thela. Eligible registered workers receive a grant of ₹ 30,000/- along with a bank loan option to cover the remaining expenses.

scheme_name: E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana
department: Chhattisgarh Unorganized Worker State Social Security Board
summary: The E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana by the Chhattisgarh State Government provides financial assistance and grants to empower unorganized workers, specifically auto and cycle rickshaw drivers. Eligible registered workers receive a grant of ₹30,000/- towards purchasing an e-rickshaw, with the remaining amount extended as a bank loan.

eligibility_rules.value: registered with Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers' State Social Security Board

scheme_name: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
summary: The E-YUVA scheme by BIRAC promotes applied research and entrepreneurial innovation among young students by providing funding support through quarterly stipends and annual research grants. Specifically for undergraduate students applying as teams, the program offers technical and business mentoring, as well as access to specialized incubation facilities.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, PAN Card etc.

scheme_name: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
summary: The E-YUVA scheme by BIRAC promotes applied research and entrepreneurial innovation among young researchers by providing fellowship grants, research grants, and mentoring. Specifically, the Innovation Fellows category supports post-graduates and post-doctoral candidates working full-time at EYCs to commercialize biotech innovations and initiate startups.

eligibility_rules.value: Master's degree in any field of science, Ph.D. in any field of science

required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, PAN Card etc.

scheme_name: E-YUVA Scheme: E-YUVA Centers
summary: The E-YUVA scheme promotes applied research and entrepreneurial innovation among young students and researchers by establishing E-YUVA Centers (EYCs) in universities and institutions. It provides financial support, technical and business mentoring, and pre-incubation infrastructure to foster biotech innovation.

scheme_name: Early Intervention Center for the Children with Intellectually Disabled
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The scheme establishes early intervention centers across districts in Tamil Nadu through NGOs to identify children with intellectual and allied disabilities at birth and provide early intervention. Each center is designed to benefit up to 50 children aged 6 years or below per district.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-II
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹50,000/- along with a one sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam to help poor widowed mothers conduct the marriage of their daughters. The scheme is aimed at educational degree or diploma holders and alleviates the financial hardships faced by poor widows.
required_documents: Bills towards purchase of marriage articles for less than ₹10,000/-

scheme_name: Early Intervention Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy in SRTC, Chennai and Tiruchirapalli Districts
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme provides early intervention and stimulation training to children affected with cerebral palsy in the age group of below 6 years. The centres are established in SRTC, Chennai, and Tiruchirapalli districts to support infants and young children.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-I
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 and a 1 Sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin to poor widow mothers to help meet the expenses of their daughter's marriage. In case of the death of the widowed mother, the benefit can be given directly to the bride.
required_documents: Bills towards purchase of marriage articles for less than ₹10,000/-

scheme_name: Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism scheme provides early intervention programs to address social stimuli, imitation skills, language comprehension, and play skills in autistic children. Centers have been established across multiple locations in Tamil Nadu to effectively combat the incidence of autism.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired, launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu, identifies, assesses, and prepares visually impaired children aged 6 years or below to join mainstream education. Centers have been established in 6 districts including Chennai, Coimbatore, Cuddalore, Thiruchirapalli, Thiruvannamalai, and Vellore.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
summary: This scheme encourages higher education among tribal girl students in Rajasthan by providing annual financial assistance. Eligible students receive Rs. 5,000 per year to support their college-level studies.
required_documents: Bank Details Linked with Janaadhaar Card

scheme_name: Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme establishes early intervention centres to provide training for developing speech and language skills in infants and young children with hearing impairment. The ultimate goal is to integrate these children into regular schools by the time they reach 5 years of age.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
department: Social Welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child Department
summary: The Rajasthan state government provides one-time financial assistance of Rs. 3,500/- to tribal girls studying in classes 11 and 12 in government schools. The scheme aims to encourage higher education among Scheduled Tribe girl students who are non-tax payers and native residents of Rajasthan.
required_documents: Annual Income Of The Parent / Guardian - Non-Tax Payee Certificate
Janaadhaar Card Details Of Family And Student
Bank Details Linked With the Janaadhaar Card Of Either The Family Head Or Student

scheme_name: Education Assistance/Ph.D Scheme (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Education Assistance/Ph.D Scheme provides annual financial assistance to up to two children of registered construction workers in Gujarat pursuing education from Class 1 to higher education courses including Ph.D. The initiative aims to support the career development of bright and needy students from construction worker families.

scheme_name: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
summary: This scheme aims to promote higher secondary education among Sahariya tribal girl students in the Baran district of Rajasthan by providing financial assistance. Eligible regular students in government schools receive a monthly stipend for 10 months, provided they do not reside in government hostels.

scheme_name: Education Assistance for the Construction Workers
department: Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of monthly scholarships to the children of registered construction workers in Delhi. It helps students studying from Class 1 up to professional and technical courses like Engineering, Medical, MBA, and Graduation to bear their educational expenses.
required_documents: Institutional Identity Card of the Student
Bank Passbook Copy/ Copy of Cancelled Cheque

scheme_name: Education Assistance - Folk Artist
summary: The Education Assistance - Folk Artist scheme provides financial support for the education of children of registered folk artists in Tamil Nadu. It covers students from school level up to higher education, including vocational and professional courses, to encourage their academic pursuits.
required_documents: Registration Card of the Folk Artist
Certificate from the Educational Institution Head or Officer

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme (NSFDC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
summary: The Education Loan Scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to the Scheduled Caste community for pursuing regular full-time professional and technical courses in recognized institutions in India or abroad. The scheme covers various academic expenses including admission fees, tuition, hostel charges, and travel expenses up to specified limits with subsidized interest rates.
required_documents: Valid Visa/Permit (If any for study abroad)
Copy of admission confirmation from an educational institute with fee and other charges payment schedule yearly
Copy of Identity card issued by the Institute if admission has already taken

scheme_name: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
summary: The Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child scheme aims to ensure the continuity of education for single girl children in Madhya Pradesh. Eligible students who have passed class 10 with at least 60% marks and are studying in class 11 or 12 receive an annual scholarship of ₹5,000.

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation
summary: The Education Loan Scheme by NSFDC provides financial assistance to students belonging to the Scheduled Caste community for pursuing full-time professional or technical courses at graduate and higher levels, as well as vocational courses, in India or abroad. Loans up to ₹30 lakhs for studies in India and up to ₹40 lakhs for studies abroad are offered at subsidized interest rates.
required_documents: Proof of Educational Qualification (Passing Certificate / Marksheet)

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme - Delhi
department: Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities and Handicapped Financial Development Corporation Ltd.
summary: The Education Loan Scheme by the Government of Delhi provides financial assistance to students from SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and PwD communities for pursuing professional and technical courses. It offers need-based loans up to ₹7,50,000 for studies in India and up to ₹15,00,000 for studies abroad. Eligible applicants must be permanent residents of Delhi with a family income below ₹5,00,000 per annum.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, Minority, Persons with Disability

required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of Borrower (Applicant), Co-Borrower (Parents/Guardian), and Guarantor
Copy of Income Certificate issued by the Office of the SDM Concerned or Copy of Form No. 16 of Co-Borrower
Copy of Mark Sheet of the Last Examination on the Basis of Which the Applicant Has Obtained Admission in the Present/Particular Course

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
department: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam
summary: This scheme provides education loans up to ₹20,00,000 for studies in India and up to ₹30,00,000 for studies abroad at an interest rate of 3% for students belonging to notified minority communities. It is aimed at supporting graduate and higher-level general, professional, or technical courses.
