eligibility_rules.value: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains

required_documents: Resident Proof/Address Proof/Ownership Proof i.e. Haryana Domicile Certificate

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC- Haryana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC)
summary: The Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC provides financial assistance to eligible Scheduled Caste students of Haryana for pursuing regular full-time professional or technical courses. The scheme offers loans up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹30 lakhs for studies abroad to cover admission, tuition, boarding, and other education-related expenses.
required_documents: A certificate from the Indian embassy Consulate on confirmation of admission given to the applicant
Resident Proof/Address Proof i.e. Ration Card
Accreditation status of the Course for which loan is to be availed in case of abroad study
Accreditation status of the Educational institution for which the loan is to be availed

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
department: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam
summary: This scheme provides education loans of up to ₹20,00,000/- for domestic professional courses and up to ₹30,00,000/- for studies abroad to students from minority communities in Haryana. It aims to support graduate and higher-level general, professional, or technical education with concessional interest rates.

eligibility_rules.value: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains

required_documents: Resident Proof/Address Proof/Ownership Proof i.e. Haryana Domicile Certificate

scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
department: Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC)
summary: The Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC, implemented by HSFDC in Haryana, provides financial assistance to eligible Safai Karamcharis and their dependents. It offers loans up to ₹10 lakhs for professional and technical courses within India and up to ₹20 lakhs for studies abroad to cover tuition, boarding, books, and other educational expenses.

eligibility_rules.value: Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari

required_documents: A certificate from the Indian embassy Consulate on confirmation of admission given to the applicant
Accreditation status of the Course for which loan is to be availed in case of abroad study
Accreditation status of the Educational institution for which the loan is to be availed
Approval or Clearance Certificate from Competent Authority
Certificate of Safai karamchari or dependent of Safai karamchari from the head of the Government Departments

scheme_name: Educational Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
summary: The Educational Assistance scheme by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial education allowances to the children of registered construction workers. The assistance covers students enrolled in classes from Class I up to Post Graduate Level and Professional Courses.

scheme_name: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows
summary: Launched in 2010 by the Government of Pondicherry, this scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25 to ₹125 annually for the education of poor widows' children up to higher secondary level. The aid helps cover the cost of textbooks, notebooks, and other educational materials for students who meet academic and income criteria.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department

scheme_name: Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities- Haryana
department: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam
summary: The Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities scheme provides loans of up to ₹50 lakhs to eligible permanent residents of Haryana with more than 40% disability. The financial assistance supports them in pursuing professional and technical education courses both within India and abroad.

scheme_name: Educational Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Educational Assistance scheme provides financial grants and scholarships to the children of registered construction workers in Assam studying from Class I to Post Graduate levels. For higher studies in government institutions like IIT, Engineering, or Medical, the entire expenses are borne by the Board upon submission of proper documents.
required_documents: Letter from the institute signed by the head of the Institute
Attested copy of the pass certificate from the head of the Institution
Attested copy of the marksheet of the exam
Copy of Payslip of Account Paybook

scheme_name: Educational Assistance For Children Of Victims Of Crime
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: The Educational Assistance for Children of Victims of Crime scheme, launched by the Government of Kerala, provides financial support for the education of children who are dependents of crime survivors. It aims to help these families overcome financial constraints caused by victimization and medical expenses so that children can continue their studies from class 1 up to PG/M.Phil levels.
required_documents: Certificate from the school attended by the student
Certificate from Ward Councillor/Member or Panchayat/Nagar Sabha Chairperson/Chairman or Local Station House Officer

scheme_name: Educational Assistance (Scheme for the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to Children of Construction Workers Registered with the MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of pre-matric and post-matric scholarships to the children of construction workers registered with the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. The objective is to help construction workers support their children's education from Class I to Degree courses within India.
required_documents: ID Proof of worker (Electoral Card, Ration Card, Driver's License, Aadhaar Card, Passport)
Age proof of concerned building worker

scheme_name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance and scholarships to children of prisoners in Kerala to support their education and prevent dropouts due to financial distress. It covers expenses like school fees, food, and clothing for students from Class 1 up to Degree/Professional courses.
required_documents: Certificate from the school attended by the student

scheme_name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: This scheme provides educational assistance of up to ₹100,000 per student to children of prisoners serving life imprisonment or death sentences for pursuing degree-level professional courses in Government or Aided colleges in Kerala. It aims to prevent educational deprivation and financial crisis for these children by covering annual and hostel fees.

eligibility_rules.value: prisoner sentenced to life imprisonment or death sentence

required_documents: Certificate from the college with annual fee, hostel fee, bank account number of the college, IFSC number, and proof of merit seat admission
Copy of the previous year's certificate

scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Degree Course
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: The Educational Assistance for Degree Course scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 per year to children and wives of registered construction workers in Maharashtra who are pursuing undergraduate degrees. The benefit is applicable to a maximum of two children per family alongside the registered worker's wife.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Marksheet/School Certificate of passing in the previous academic level
Acknowledgment/Bonafide of Admission in the current academic year
Proof of Residence (One of Aadhaar Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Ration Sheet/Last Month's Electricity Bill/Gram Panchayat Cert)

scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 for medical degrees and ₹60,000 for engineering degrees to the children and spouses of registered construction workers in Maharashtra. A maximum of two children or the wife of the registered worker can benefit from this initiative.

eligibility_rules.value: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Marksheet/School Certificate of passing in the previous academic level
Acknowledgment/Bonafide for admission in the current academic year

scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 per year for government-recognized diploma courses and ₹25,000 per year for postgraduate diploma courses to the children or spouse of registered construction workers in Maharashtra. The benefit is applicable to a maximum of two children and the wife of registered male workers.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Marksheet/School Certificate of passing in the previous academic level
Acknowledgment/Bonafide for admission in the current academic year

scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: The Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students scheme provides financial aid of ₹10,000/- to the children of registered construction workers. To qualify, the student must score 50% or more marks in their 10th or 12th standard examinations.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Marksheet for at least 50% or more secured marks

scheme_name: Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children belonging to women-headed families in Kerala who are living in deplorable conditions. It supports children studying from pre-primary up to degree levels and above with monthly stipends.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar card etc.
Educational details of the child (previous exam mark sheet and bonafide certificate)
A certificate from the head of the educational institution where the child studies that the child is not availing of any other scholarship

scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the Children Studying in 1st to 7th and 8th to 10th Class
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children and wives of registered construction workers in Maharashtra. Students studying in classes 1st to 7th receive ₹2,500, while those in 8th to 10th standard receive ₹5,000.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Educational Award Scheme by the Government of Gujarat encourages the children of registered laborers to pursue higher education by providing financial awards. Students who score 70% or above in their 10th or 12th standard examinations are eligible to receive monetary rewards ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹5,000.
required_documents: Identity proof of Child i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year to the children and wife of registered construction workers in Maharashtra who are studying in the 11th or 12th standard. The benefit is applicable to a maximum of two children per worker.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Educational Study Scheme
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat
summary: The Educational Study Scheme offers affordable education loans at a simple interest rate of 4% for students from the unreserved category in Gujarat pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate professional courses. It covers tuition fees up to ₹10,00,000/- or the total fee of the course, whichever is less.
required_documents: Class 10th & Class 12th Marksheet Copy (or Diploma Certificate)
Proof of the period between graduation & application date (if applicable)

scheme_name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana
ministry: Department of Higher and Technical Education
summary: The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana provides free coaching and a monthly stipend of ₹2,500 to eligible students in Jharkhand preparing for competitive exams like UPSC, JPSC, SSC, and banking. The scheme aims to support students from lower-income families to successfully crack national and state-level competitive examinations.
required_documents: Self-attested Copy of ration card for National/State Food Security Scheme covered student
Caste Certificate (issued by Sub-Divisional Officer/Circle Officer)

scheme_name: Emeritus Fellowship
summary: The Emeritus Fellowship provides superannuated teachers an opportunity to pursue active research in their specialization at recognized Indian universities and institutions. Selected fellows receive a monthly honorarium and an annual contingency grant for a non-extendable period of up to two years or until the age of 70.
required_documents: Joining Report with photograph, address and contact number
Form for submitting accounts of contingency grants and the Utilization certificate

scheme_name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching To Scheduled Tribe Student Studying In Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
summary: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is a scholarship scheme by the Government of Goa that provides coaching fee reimbursement to Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes X, XI, and XII. The scheme aims to prepare students for professional courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Law, and Chartered Accountancy by reimbursing up to 75% of their coaching fees.
required_documents: Bank Mandate form along with account details of the student
Identity Card issued by the educational institute to the student
Fee receipt along with the fee structure of the courses offered by the coaching institute group-wise
Certificate of Registration issued to the Coaching Institute by competent authority

scheme_name: Employability Excellence with College Education & Learning (EXCEL)
ministry: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
summary: The EXCEL scheme integrates skill training with traditional education in colleges across Jharkhand to improve student employability. It offers free-of-cost training in life skills, spoken English, computer skills, and domain-specific capabilities using existing college infrastructure.

scheme_name: Employees Cooperative Societies Surety Loan
department: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
summary: The Employees Cooperative Societies Surety Loan scheme provides financial support by offering surety loans up to ₹1,50,000/- at an interest rate of 14% to eligible members. It is implemented through Employees Cooperative Societies in Tamil Nadu to assist citizens with credit needs.

eligibility_rules.value: Member of an Employees Cooperative Society

required_documents: Proof of employment or Income Certificate (if applicable)

scheme_name: Employee Health Scheme
department: Dr YSR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust
summary: The Employee Health Scheme provides quality healthcare and cashless treatment to all regular State Government employees, pensioners, and their dependent family members in Andhra Pradesh. It replaces the old medical reimbursement process with comprehensive coverage including post-hospitalization care, chronic disease treatment, and free out-patient services.

scheme_name: Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)
department: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication
summary: This scheme aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Scheduled Caste (SC) communities in Goa by providing basic computer skills and job-oriented IT training courses through IT Knowledge Centres. It seeks to create computer-literate manpower, enhance job opportunities in IT/ITeS, and ensure at least one IT-literate person in each family.

scheme_name: Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects
department: Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
summary: This scheme provides financial scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Madhya Pradesh to encourage them to pursue higher education in science and contemporary subjects. It specifically targets students who have completed Class 10 and enrolled in Class 11 Science stream, as well as those who have completed Class 12 and enrolled in a B.Sc. course in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology.

scheme_name: Employees' Pension Scheme
summary: Launched in 1995, the Employees' Pension Scheme provides social security and financial stability to organized sector employees post-retirement, in case of disability, or to their families upon death. It offers superannuation pension, early pension, and family pension benefits to eligible members of the Employees' Provident Fund.
required_documents: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth certificate/School leaving certificate)
Disability Certificate, from EPFO-approved doctors (for disablement pension)

scheme_name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) nurtures the talent of youth by enlightening them on various aspects of industrial and business activity required for setting up MSMEs. It aims to instill an entrepreneurial culture, motivate youth to pursue self-employment, and impart technical and business skills.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, etc.

scheme_name: Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme aims to create self-employment opportunities for differently abled persons by establishing Aavin parlours to sell Aavin brand products such as milk, butter, and curd. It is implemented by the Government of Tamil Nadu.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm scheme provides financial assistance through an interest subsidy to livestock farmers for dairy farming. It aims to reduce their financial burden, promote large-scale dairy farming, and encourage animal husbandry as a sustainable business.
required_documents: Proof of land or house ownership

scheme_name: Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The 'Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm' scheme aims to promote animal husbandry as an independent business, encourage dairy farming among livestock owners, and enhance rural employment opportunities in Gujarat. It provides financial assistance including interest subsidies on bank loans, shed construction assistance, and animal insurance premium coverage.
required_documents: Copy of residence proof (barcoded ration card/ Electricity bill/bank passbook with address)
Copy of government-issued photo identification (Aadhar card/Voter ID/Driving License/Kisan Credit Card)
Copy of bank passbook or cancelled cheque
Land-related documents: Land ownership proof, 7/12 extract, 8A extract, or lease agreement

scheme_name: Entrepreneur Support Scheme
summary: The Entrepreneur Support Scheme provides financial assistance and subsidies ranging from 15% to 45% of fixed capital investment for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) engaged in manufacturing activities in Kerala. It aims to offer extensive support to enterprises and one-time support to entrepreneurs, with special incentives for categories like youth, women, SC/ST, and NRKs.
required_documents: Acknowledgement receipt during filing the application online
Self-attested copy of Challan/receipt towards payment of fees
Copy of Voters ID/Passport/Ration Card/Driving license

scheme_name: Entrepreneurship Development by SC & ST Women in Science Technology Engineering Mathematics
summary: This scheme aims to explore entrepreneurship potential and improve livelihood options for unemployed SC and ST women in STEM areas in Kerala using science and technology. It provides financial support of up to ₹20 Lakhs for one year to help them become techno-entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Endorsement Letter from Head of Institution
Consent Letter from Mentor and Co-Mentor if any
Age proof Certificate (Class X mark sheet or birth certificate)
Letter from the Head of Institution

scheme_name: Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to livestock owners in Gujarat for setting up dairy farms with 50 milch animals. It offers subsidies on loan interest, shed construction, animal insurance, and essential equipment.
required_documents: Copy of residence proof (barcoded ration card/ Electricity bill/bank passbook with address)
Copy of government-issued photo identification (Aadhar card/Voter ID/Driving License/Kisan Credit Card)
Copy of bank passbook or cancelled cheque
Land-related documents: Land ownership proof, 7/12 extract, 8A extract, or lease agreement

scheme_name: Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development
summary: This scheme sponsors market-driven skill development training for the youth of Jammu & Kashmir to enhance their employability and marketability in high potential job markets. It aims to establish independent livelihood avenues and develop a resource pool of skilled youth for positive economic transformation.

scheme_name: Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The 'Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1)' scheme by the Government of Gujarat aims to promote social and economic upliftment of goat breeders through goat breeding and genetic improvement. It provides financial assistance and subsidies to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe women, and General category individuals, prioritizing widowed and abandoned women.
required_documents: Copy of bank passbook or canceled cheque
Election card or copy of Government approved photo identity card
Certificate of competent authority regarding widow/ desertion/ disability

scheme_name: Establishment of Poultry Valley
summary: The Establishment of Poultry Valley scheme by the Government of Uttarakhand promotes poultry farming for self-reliance and income generation among farmers. It provides 500 one-day-old chicks annually through MPACS, along with interest-free loans for constructing poultry sheds and rearing chicks.
required_documents: Affidavit/certificate of not being a defaulter from any bank

scheme_name: Establishment of Integrated Educational Complexes
summary: The scheme aims to address inadequate infrastructure and congested conditions in government-aided and government educational institutions in urban areas of Goa. It establishes comprehensive educational complexes with facilities like playgrounds and auditoriums, allotting land on a 33-year lease for shifting schools to better environments.
required_documents: Certificate of registration of the society and renewal certificate for educational purposes
Copy of permission and recognition granted by the Department
Status note of the institution since its inception highlighting its achievements
A copy of the recent Managing Committee approved by the Department
Undertaking that the institution will utilize the land for the specified purpose

scheme_name: Establishment of Entrepreneur for Breed Development in Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
summary: This scheme aims to develop entrepreneurs in the small ruminant sector for sheep and goat farming to generate employment and create a sustainable business model. It provides capital subsidies to incentivize individuals, FPOs, FCOs, SHGs, JLGs, and Section 8 companies for developing integrated rural sheep-goat production systems.
required_documents: Detailed project report (DPR) including cost of project, means of finance, recurring cost, net income etc.
Land document (Ownership / Lease deed/ Rent Agreement etc.)
Documentary proof of applicant’s share in the project
List of farmers linked/attached with applicant comprising Name, Aadhar Number, Mobile No. and Address

scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to CAPF Personnel
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides financial ex-gratia grants to CAPF personnel hailing from Haryana who have been permanently disabled and boarded out of service due to war, operations, terrorist activities, or natural calamities. The grant amount varies based on the percentage of the disability suffered.
required_documents: Copy of detailed Battle Casualty report and Part-II order from Service Headquarters
Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number
Disability Certificate/Casualty Certificate indicating the % age or disability issued by the Competent Authority

scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to Defence Forces Personnel
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: The Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to Defence Forces Personnel provides financial assistance to permanent residents of Haryana who served in the Defence Forces and were permanently disabled and boarded out of service due to war, operations, terrorist activities, or natural calamities. The grant amount varies from ₹15,00,000 to ₹35,00,000 depending on the severity and percentage of the disability.
required_documents: Copy of detailed Battle casualty report and Part-II order from Service Headquarters
Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Card
Disability Certificate/Casualty Certificate indicating the % age of disability issued by the competent authority
Self-Photo ID Card (Ration Card /Driving License/ Voter ID Card/ PAN Card etc.)

scheme_name: Ex-gratia Payment for the Construction Workers
summary: The Ex-gratia Payment for the Construction Workers scheme by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to registered construction workers in the event of permanent disability. The scheme aims to offer social security and welfare support to workers who suffer permanent incapacitation.
required_documents: Permanent Disability certificate issued by Govt. Doctor (medical Certificate by committee)

scheme_name: Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers for permanent disability, treatment of chronic diseases for themselves or dependents, and surgical operations. Registered beneficiaries can receive up to ₹1,00,000 for permanent disability and chronic disease treatment, and ₹40,000 for surgeries.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
summary: This scheme aims at the genetic improvement and upgradation of sheep and goat breeds through selective breeding and cross-breeding with high genetic merit rams or bucks. It provides financial assistance for the establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratories and Semen Banks to enhance productivity and support entrepreneurship.
required_documents: Detailed project report including cost of project, means of finance, recurring cost, net income
Land document (Ownership / Lease deed / Rent Agreement)
Documentary proof of applicant's share in the project
List of farmers linked/attached with applicant comprising Name, Aadhar Number, Mobile No. and Address

scheme_name: Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Ex-gratia Scheme by the Punjab BOCW Welfare Board provides financial compensation to registered building and construction workers in the event of a complete or partial disability. The scheme applies to workers who do not hold Health Cards under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.
required_documents: Self declaration (if age proof is unavailable)

scheme_name: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing the annual membership subscription fee or one-time subscription charges of Export Promotion Councils (EPC) for eligible Micro and Small Enterprises owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs. Beneficiaries receive a reimbursement of 80% or up to ₹20,000 per financial year, whichever is less, excluding taxes.
required_documents: Self-certified copy PAN card in case of proprietorship, PAN card of SC/ST proprietor
Self-certified copy of Caste certificate of proprietor/ all partners/ directors
Details of shareholding in case of partnership / Pvt. Ltd / LLP firm

scheme_name: Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Worker of De-Notified Communities
department: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare
summary: The Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Workers of De-notified Communities recognizes and rewards outstanding contributions made by social workers from these communities. It provides a cash award of ₹1,00,000/- to individuals who have significantly contributed to the social, economic, and educational upliftment of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities.

scheme_name: Exposure Visits of Government of Odisha Delegates/Representatives to Singapore and Dubai
department: Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha
summary: This scheme organizes exposure trips to Singapore and Dubai for delegates nominated by various departments of the Government of Odisha. The objective is to build capacity and provide global learning experiences through visits to international institutes and infrastructure projects.
beneficiary_categories: Delegates and Representatives of Government of Odisha

scheme_name: Ex-gratia for Death for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Ex-gratia for Death for the Construction Workers scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers in case of their death. The assistance is provided whether the death occurs during the course of employment or due to any other reason.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
Death Certificate issued by a Government Doctor
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)
summary: The F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme aims to provide safe play areas for healthy recreation and sports to urban communities in Goa. It provides financial assistance of up to ₹3,00,00,00 to eligible entities for developing sports facilities, walking tracks, and associated amenities on land measuring at least 2,000 square meters.
beneficiary_categories: Registered bodies espousing the cause of Physical fitness and Sport

scheme_name: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
summary: This scheme arranges educational exposure visits for students from high school up to college level to the Assam Legislative Assembly during sessions. It provides students with practical experience in governance, direct interaction with dignitaries, and a better understanding of legislative procedures.
required_documents: List of participating students provided to the Assembly Secretariat for the issuance of passes
Brief write-up summarizing their experience and feedback

scheme_name: Family Pension (DBOCWWB)
summary: The Family Pension scheme launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance to the surviving spouse upon the death of a pensioner. The beneficiary receives 50% of the pension amount or ₹1,500/-, whichever is higher.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of Spouse
Copy of First Page of Bank Passbook/ Cancelled Cheque of the Spouse
Original Death Certificate of the Pensioner

scheme_name: Fal Podharopan Yojana
summary: The Fal Podharopan Yojana by the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides farmers with a subsidy of 40% to 50% of the unit cost, disbursed over three years, for fruit cultivation on land ranging from 0.25 to 4 hectares. The scheme supports sustainable fruit farming across various fruit crops, accommodating both standard and high-density plantations.

scheme_name: Family Pension (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)
summary: The Family Pension scheme by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance to the dependents of a deceased pensioner registered with the Board. Eligible beneficiaries receive 50% of the pension amount or ₹100/-, whichever is higher.
required_documents: Identity Proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Proof of age at the time of Registration
Identity Card of the Registered Worker

scheme_name: Family Pension (GBOCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Goa
summary: Family Pension (GBOCWWB) is a welfare scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board that provides financial assistance to the surviving spouse of a deceased board pensioner. The pension amount is 50% of the deceased pensioner's pension or ₹200/-, whichever is higher.

eligibility_rules.value: Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
Village Officer's Certificate showing the relationship between the applicant and the Worker
Village Officer's Certificate stating that the applicant is not receiving any pension from a Government/Semi-Government/Private Institution

scheme_name: Family Pension (MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
summary: The Family Pension scheme provides financial support to the surviving spouse of a deceased pensioner who was receiving a pension from the MBOCWWB. The pension amount is 50% of the pension received by the deceased or ₹100, whichever is higher.
required_documents: MBOCWWB ID Card of the pensioner/worker
Medical Death Certificate of the Beneficiary by Chief Medical Officer
Officer's Certificate showing the relationship between the applicant and the worker
Officer's Certificate stating that the applicant is not receiving any pension from the Government/Semi-Government/Private Organization

scheme_name: Fare for Visiting Home Town (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The scheme provides free travel facilities or reimbursement of travel expenses to registered construction workers and up to five family members for visiting their hometown once a year. Eligible workers receive payments based on Haryana Roadways ordinary fares or actual 2nd class railway fare.

scheme_name: Family Pension (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Family Pension scheme provides financial support to the spouse of a deceased construction worker who was receiving a pension from the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Upon the worker's death, half of the original pension amount is disbursed monthly to the dependent spouse.

eligibility_rules.value: Receiving pension from the Board prior to death

required_documents: Identity card of the registered deceased worker

scheme_name: Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)
summary: The Farm Machinery Bank/Farm Machinery Hub scheme provides financial assistance to rural youth entrepreneurs and farmer groups to set up farm machinery hubs. It aims to create self-employment, increase farm power availability, and make farm machinery accessible and affordable for small and marginal farmers.

eligibility_rules.value: Rural Youth Entrepreneur, SKUS, PACS, FPO, FPC, FIG, SHG, LAMPS

required_documents: Proof of financial solvency (self authenticated bank statement of last six months etc)
Title Deed/ROR (Records of Right) /Lease Certificate/Rent Receipt of land
Detailed project report for AIF (if applicable)

scheme_name: Family Pension- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: The Family Pension scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,500 per month to the eligible spouse or living parents of a worker who died due to Silicosis. The assistance is given to the spouse for life or to the living parents in case the deceased worker was unmarried.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Proof of relation with the deceased worker

scheme_name: Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram
summary: The Farm Pond Construction Program provides financial assistance and subsidies to farmers in Rajasthan for building farm ponds to harvest rainwater for irrigation. It aims to address water scarcity and improve agricultural productivity by enabling effective water management.

scheme_name: Family/ Widow Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Family/ Widow Pension Scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board of Punjab provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the spouse of a deceased registered construction worker. The eligible surviving spouse receives ₹1,000/- per month until remarriage, provided certain membership and eligibility conditions are met.
required_documents: Self declaration (if age proof is not available)

scheme_name: Farm Storage Structure Scheme
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Farm Storage Structure Scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for constructing crop storage structures on their farms. It protects agricultural produce from adverse weather conditions and allows farmers to hold their harvest until market prices are favorable.

scheme_name: Farmers Accidental Insurance Scheme
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Farmers Accidental Insurance Scheme by the government of Gujarat provides financial aid of up to ₹2,00,000 to the successors of registered farmers in the case of accidental death or permanent disability. It aims to support the families of farmers who face sudden tragedies due to accidents.
required_documents: I.R & spot Panchami Police Inquest Report or Court Order
Proof of death (Death Certificate) & age from competent authority
Sub Divisional Magistrate report and Police tapas

scheme_name: Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia
summary: Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia is a financial assistance scheme by the Government of Andhra Pradesh that provides ₹7,00,000 to the families of farmers and tenant farmers who commit suicide due to agrarian reasons. The scheme serves as a rehabilitation package to support the affected families.
required_documents: Ex-gratia proposals with the recommendations of the District Collector
Mandal Level and Divisional Level three-member committee report
Xerox Copies of the Promissory Note

scheme_name: Farmers Training
summary: The Farmers Training scheme offers skill development training sessions to farmers and agricultural laborers in Tamil Nadu. A grant of ₹5,000/- is provided per training session supporting up to 50 participants to enhance their agricultural knowledge.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Proof of farming or agricultural labor status

scheme_name: Farmers Interest Group (FIG)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: The Farmers Interest Group (FIG) scheme supports groups of 15 farmers in Tamil Nadu with grants for agricultural development. It provides financial assistance for office equipment, training, ID cards, and district-level meetings.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

scheme_name: Farmers Training Institute Scheme
summary: The Farmers Training Institute Scheme provides village-level training to farmers on updated and innovative agricultural technologies. It also facilitates exposure visits and field tours for farmers both within and outside the state of Meghalaya.
required_documents: Proof of having sufficient available cultivable land

scheme_name: Fasal Pradarshan
summary: The Fasal Pradarshan scheme provides financial grants to farmers for organizing crop and field demonstrations on their land to promote advanced agricultural technologies, modern crop production methods, and precision farming. Selected farmers receive financial assistance for inputs such as seeds and fertilizers based on soil testing and departmental guidelines.

scheme_name: Fatal Accident Relief - Telangana
ministry: Labour, Employment, Training and Factories Department
department: Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (TB&OCWWB)
summary: The Fatal Accident Relief scheme provides financial assistance of ₹6,00,000 to the nominees or legal heirs of registered construction workers in Telangana who suffer an accidental death. The scheme aims to support grieving families following the sudden loss of their breadwinner due to workplace or other accidents.
required_documents: FIR issued by Police Station (Attested copy)
1st page of Bank pass book (Attested copy)
beneficiary_categories: Nominees or Legal Heirs of Deceased Workers

scheme_name: Fawara Sanyantra
summary: The Fawara Sanyantra scheme provides a 70% to 75% subsidy to farmers in Rajasthan for installing sprinkler irrigation plants. It aims to save water, improve irrigation efficiency, and increase farmers' incomes through direct benefit transfer (DBT).
required_documents: Jamabandi copy (not more than 6 months old)

scheme_name: Fee Reimbursement Scheme
summary: The Fee Reimbursement Scheme provides annual financial assistance and scholarship for fee reimbursement to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) pursuing higher education in government, aided, and recognized institutes. The initiative aims to uplift the educational status and overall development of backward classes in the state.

scheme_name: Fee Waiver Scheme For SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education
summary: This scheme provides a full waiver of tuition, library, laboratory, and development fees to eligible SC/ST students in Goa pursuing higher education at the degree and postgraduate levels. It ensures that students from these communities are not deprived of higher education due to a lack of financial resources.
required_documents: Proof of Enrolment into the First Year of Degree/PG Course
Fee Receipt of the Current Course Year

scheme_name: Feed Based Fisheries Scheme
summary: The Feed Based Fisheries Scheme aims to enhance fish production by providing financial grants for floating fish feed to active fish farmers. It supports intensive fish farming methods such as cage culture, Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS), and Biofloc systems.

eligibility_rules.value: cage fish farming, RAS, or Biofloc systems

scheme_name: Feed The Seed
summary: The 'Feed for Seed' program by the Government of Telangana provides farmers with free, high-quality seeds and kits to encourage self-sufficiency in seed production. It promotes sustainable agricultural practices, helps improve crop yields, and enhances farmers' income through the 'Seed Village' concept.

scheme_name: Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students (Maharaja Sayajirao Gayakvad Scholarship)
summary: This scheme provides a monthly fellowship to Scheduled Caste students of Gujarat pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. programs at recognized universities. M.Phil students receive ₹2,500 per month and Ph.D. students receive ₹10,000 per month for 10 months upon submission of their thesis.
required_documents: Caste Certificate from the Competent Authorities
First Page Of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Cheque

scheme_name: Female Child Birth Gift Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
department: Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Female Child Birth Gift Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹51,000 in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) for the birth of up to two daughters of registered construction workers in Himachal Pradesh. The amount can be withdrawn once the daughter attains 18 years of age, ensuring long-term financial security.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Fellowship For Superannuated Faculty Members
summary: The Fellowship for Superannuated Faculty Members scheme provides financial assistance and research opportunities to retired or retiring faculty members from eligible institutions. It offers a monthly fellowship of Rs. 50,000 and an annual contingency grant for a tenure of 3 years to pursue research in their respective fields.
required_documents: Signed application form (duly signed by HoD/Registrar)

scheme_name: Film Finance Scheme
summary: The Film Finance Scheme of Assam provides financial support to local filmmakers to promote the creation of high-quality regional films. It offers assistance across all stages of production, including script development, pre-production, shooting, post-production, marketing, and distribution.

eligibility_rules.value: Assamese or recognized regional language of Assam

required_documents: Certificates of registration with film associations

scheme_name: Financial Assistance (Kanyadaan) on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹51,000 for the marriage of up to three daughters of workers suffering from silicosis in Haryana. The applicant must be employed in a factory or construction site, registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board, and have their condition confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.

scheme_name: Financial Aid For Providing Hostel Facility To Transgender Students
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: The Financial Aid For Providing Hostel Facility To Transgender Students scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹4,000 to transgender students in Kerala as rent for hostel facilities or accommodation. Launched by the Government of Kerala, the scheme aims to prevent dropouts and help transgender individuals continue their education by addressing housing discrimination and lack of accommodation.
required_documents: Self-declaration with attestation of parent/head of the institution (for students under 18 years)
Self-declaration Affidavit stating that the applicant is Transgender

scheme_name: Feed And Fodder Entrepreneurship Scheme
summary: The Feed And Fodder Entrepreneurship Scheme aims to establish an effective seed production chain and build capacity in forage production, conservation, and utilization. It offers a 50% direct capital subsidy to beneficiaries and assistance for procuring machinery such as balers, block making machines, and forage harvesters.
required_documents: Proof of land holding (ownership or lease)
Bank statement for the last six months

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Aids And Appliances For Disabled Persons
department: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance
summary: The Financial Assistance for Aids and Appliances for Disabled Persons scheme by the Govt. of Maharashtra provides financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) for purchasing necessary aids and appliances based on their age and type of disability. The scheme offers either 100% or 50% financial assistance towards the cost of equipment depending on the applicant's monthly income.
required_documents: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Marksheet of Class 10th/12th, etc)
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Maharashtra
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Allied Cultural Activities
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible not-for-profit organizations for procuring audio-visual equipment to enhance live cultural performances and spectacles. It aims to improve visitor experiences in open or closed spaces during regular days and major festivals.
required_documents: Organization's profile with year-wise details of activities over the last 3 years
Description of the project/proposal with rationale and justification

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Development Of Buddhist/Tibetan Arts And Culture
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹30.00 lakhs per year to voluntary Buddhist and Tibetan organizations, including monasteries, for the propagation, research, and scientific development of Buddhist/Tibetan culture and traditions. Grants support maintenance, research projects, purchase of books, and infrastructure development like hostels and classrooms.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered under the Societies Registration Act or similar Acts

required_documents: Copy of the valid Registration Certificate duly certified by a Gazetted Officer
Copies of Audited Accounts for the last three years
Copies of the Annual Report for the last three years
Item-wise write-up on each activity to be undertaken

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Cultural Activities In Performing Arts For Building Grants Including Studio Theatres
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to voluntary and government-aided cultural organizations to build appropriately equipped training, rehearsal, and performance spaces for artists. Grants are allocated for creating conventional cultural spaces like auditoria and open-air theatres, as well as flexible spaces such as studio theatres.

eligibility_rules.value: voluntary cultural organizations, government-aided cultural organizations

required_documents: Organization's profile with description, strengths, achievements, and year-wise details of activities over the last 3 years
Description of the project/proposal including rationale and justification

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Persons With Special Needs
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial allowance of Rs 2500/- to eligible persons with special needs (disabilities) residing in Delhi. It is designed to offer financial subsistence to individuals with specified disabilities up to the age of 60 years who meet the income and residency criteria.
required_documents: Bank account number (Single account or relaxed for minors/guardianship)
Disability Certificate issued by a Government Hospital

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Marriage (APB&OCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh
summary: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme provides cash assistance of ₹10,000 to registered construction workers in Arunachal Pradesh for the marriage of up to two of their children. The scheme is implemented by the Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB) to support registered workers.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card etc.
Xerox copy of the registration card of the worker
Bank Account number/ front page of the passbook
Birth certificate as age proof of children

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The scheme provides annual financial assistance ranging from ₹8,000 to ₹20,000 to the children of registered construction workers studying from Class I to Post-Graduation. Additionally, it offers a one-time incentive ranging from ₹21,000 to ₹51,000 for outstanding academic performance in Class 10th examinations.
required_documents: Certificate issued by the head of the school/institution for regular studies

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 from the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund (AFFDF) for procuring modified scooters and other mobility equipment to Ex-Servicemen who became disabled with 50% or more disability after retirement. It aims to help handicapped Ex-Servicemen maintain mobility and carry on with their daily lives. Beneficiaries can re-apply for new equipment after 10 years.
required_documents: Documentary evidence showing the nature of activity in which disabled
Disability Certificate issued by Armed Forces Medical Authority
Financial estimate for a modified scooter

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Promotion Of Guru-Shishya Parampara (Repertory Grant)
summary: The Ministry of Culture offers financial assistance to dramatic groups, theatre groups, music ensembles, and children's theatre organizations to promote the Guru-Shishya Parampara. The scheme provides monthly honorariums to Gurus/Directors and Shisyas/Artists based on their category and age to support performing arts activities.
required_documents: Brief introduction of applicant organization along with press reviews, press advertisements, souvenir copies of tickets, etc.
Photocopy of the Registration Certificate and Memorandum of Association/Deed, Bye-laws
A copy of the Unique ID number of the organization from the NGO-PS (NGO-DARPAN) Portal

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
summary: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance for purchasing stationery to poor students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and Minority communities. It reduces the financial burden on parents, encouraging them to send their children to school regularly.
required_documents: One passport size photo of applicant

scheme_name: Festival Gift Coupons (Sainik Welfare)
summary: The Festival Gift Coupons scheme provides festival gift coupons worth ₹4,000 per annum to eligible non-pensioner ex-servicemen aged 60 years or older and widows of ex-servicemen. The coupons are distributed by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry, typically between November and January.
required_documents: Identity Card of the ESM / Widow of the ESM

scheme_name: Financial Assistance On Marriage Of Children (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹21,000/- for a son's marriage and ₹50,000/- for a daughter's marriage to registered construction workers in Haryana. The assistance is provided for up to two children, with an extension up to three daughters.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card

scheme_name: Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000 to Scheduled Caste agricultural labourers in Gujarat for purchasing up to 2 acres of agricultural land for self-cultivation. The initiative aims to enhance their income and uplift their economic status by enabling land ownership.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority
Proof of being a farmer/agricultural worker
Valid copy Revenue Department's permission to sell land
True copy of revenue account permission for sale of land
Copy of first page of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Cheque

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For The Marriage Of Daughters Of Poor Widows And Orphan Girls
ministry: Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi
summary: This scheme provides one-time financial assistance of ₹ 30,000 to poor widows for the marriage of up to two of their daughters, and to guardians or institutions for the marriage of orphan girls. Applicants must be residents of Delhi with an annual income below ₹ 1,00,000. The bride must be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
required_documents: Death certificate of husband (for widow applicants)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
department: Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and free coaching for IAS and other higher competitive or entrance examinations to eligible Scheduled Caste and Backward Classes students in Haryana who face financial constraints. It aims to support candidates in availing postal or classroom coaching for civil services and allied examinations.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card etc.
An affidavit from the student that he/she has not taken benefit for more than two chances under the scheme

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Destitute Children Scheme
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Financial Assistance to Destitute Children Scheme (FADCS) provides monthly financial support to parents or guardians of children up to 21 years old who are deprived of parental support due to death, continued absence, imprisonment, or physical/mental incapacity of a parent. The scheme offers assistance for a maximum of two children per family for eligible residents of Haryana.
required_documents: Age Proof (Certificate from Educational/Technical Institution, Gazetted Officer, or First Class Magistrate affidavit)
Residential Proof (Self-attested document such as Ration Card issued prior to 5 years)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women
ministry: Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development
department: Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 1000/- per month per child (for up to two children in a family) to dependent children of widows and destitute women, or orphans under 18 years of age. It aims to help meet the maintenance and educational costs of children who are deprived of parental support. Applicants must be residents of the UT of Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
required_documents: Birth Certificate of the Child (issued by the Registrar of Births & Deaths)
Residence Proof of last three years (Voter Card, Ration Card, Electricity Bill etc.) of the Mother or the Legal Guardian
Identity Proof (Voter Card/ Ration Card/Aadhar Card) of Widow Mother or Legal Guardian

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Cultural Organizations With National Presence
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to cultural organizations with a national presence to help cover expenditures for conducting cultural programs and festivals. Grants typically range from ₹1.00 crore up to ₹2.00 crores, and may be enhanced up to ₹5.00 crores in exceptional cases.
required_documents: Constitution of the Board of Management of Governing Body and particulars of each member
Copy of the latest available Annual Report
A statement of income and expenditure of the applicant organization for the previous three years and a copy of the balance sheet for the previous
An Indemnity Bond in the prescribed Performa on a stamp paper of appropriate denomination

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to school dropouts with disabilities to pursue SSLC, +1, and +2 equivalent courses implemented by the State Literacy Mission. It covers course fees, exam fees, registration fees, and admission fees to help differently-abled students overcome educational hurdles.
required_documents: Income Certificate/Copy of Ration card (If applicable)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Ex-Convicts
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: The Financial Assistance to Ex-Convicts scheme provides one-time financial support up to ₹15,000 to economically disadvantaged individuals released from jail. It aims to rehabilitate them by enabling them to start small industries, trades, or self-employment ventures for livelihood generation.
required_documents: Project proposal of the proposed work/business

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Financial Assistance to Disabled Children scheme provides ₹2000 per month to the dependent children of registered construction workers in Haryana who have a 50% or more physical or mental disability. The worker must have at least one year of regular membership with the board to avail of the benefits.

eligibility_rules.value: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Disability certificate issued by Govt. Medical Board

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
department: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance
summary: The Financial Assistance to Disabled for Self Employment scheme by the Government of Maharashtra provides financial assistance to unemployed persons with disabilities. It aims to facilitate self-employment, small-scale businesses, and agro-based projects by offering a combination of bank loans and government subsidies.
required_documents: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Maharashtra

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: This scheme provides a 50% subsidy to the traditional fishermen of Goa for the purchase of fisheries requisites such as gill nets with accessories. The financial assistance is limited to ₹30,000/- for the General Category and ₹40,000/- for SC/ST Category beneficiaries.
required_documents: Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Gad-Hanjis
summary: The Financial Assistance to Gad-Hanjis scheme provides financial aid to licensed fishermen for purchasing Nylon Twine. It is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme exclusively for permanent residents of Jammu & Kashmir who meet specific income and licensing criteria.
required_documents: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State/UT of Jammu & Kashmir
Fisherman License by the Fisheries Department, Govt. of Jammu & Kashmir
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Institutions/Societies Belonging To Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes
department: Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered institutions and societies belonging to Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes in Haryana. The funds are intended to help them construct, complete, repair, or renovate buildings used for community, social, or educational purposes, as well as provide basic facilities and equipment.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered under Societies Registration Act 1860 or Indian Trust Act

required_documents: Attested copies of the registration certificate of the institution
Certificate of registration of land in the name of the concerned institution/society or any other revenue record
Activities of the society/institution with annual accounts/balance sheet
Site plan architect drawing the map of the building proposed to be constructed and tentative expenditure

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,250/- per month per family member (up to a maximum of ₹6,250/- per family per month) for five years to Kashmiri families who have migrated from Jammu & Kashmir and are currently residing in Haryana. The scheme aims to support their resettlement.
required_documents: Certificate of the Migrated State, issued by the Sub Divisional Official (Civil)
Ration Card, issued by the Food & Supplies Department, Haryana
Voter ID Card, issued by Election Department, Haryana
Details of the Saving Bank Account

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
summary: This scheme provides social security through financial assistance of ₹ 2,000 per annum to poor and needy widows aged 18-40 years in Manipur who are not covered under the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme. It aims to help widows cope with daily survival hardships caused by situations like armed conflict and HIV/AIDS.
required_documents: Residential / Domicile Certificate of the state of Manipur
Proof of Age / Date of Birth

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Haryana
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹2150 to mentally retarded, severely disabled, and multiple disabled children aged 0-18 years who are unable to attend formal education. The scheme aims to support families who provide constant supervision and care for these dependent children.
required_documents: Affidavit attested from first class Magistrate

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹30,000/- to legally married inter-caste couples (excluding SC/ST category) in Kerala facing financial difficulties. The assistance is intended for purposes such as starting a business, purchasing land, or constructing a house.
required_documents: Identity proof (Election ID Card or Aadhaar card)
Income Certificate (Original) from the concerned Village Officer
Certificate proving that Inter-caste marriage is registered

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Self-Employment For Trained Disabled Persons
department: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 to trained disabled persons who have completed vocational training from government or recognized institutions to purchase equipment and start their own businesses. It aims to promote self-employment and economic independence among persons with disabilities in Maharashtra.
required_documents: A proposal along with the proposed project cost
Proof regarding the completion of Vocational Training in a Government or Government Recognized Institution
Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Marksheet of Class 10th/12th, etc)
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Maharashtra

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Pre-primary School In Remote Areas
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa provides financial assistance to establish and run pre-primary schools in remote tribal areas lacking such facilities. It covers rent, remuneration for teachers and helpers, teaching aids, toys, and mid-day meals to support early childhood education.
required_documents: NOC / Lease agreement of the owner of the premises
Experience certificate of the applicant/ agency
List of the Scheduled Tribe Students
Name and other details of the Teacher/Helper

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹ 50,000/- to traditional fishermen for purchasing Singel Net or Small Rampon Net and its accessories. The benefit is available once every five years to eligible traditional fishermen belonging to the OBC (Kharvi) community who are residents of Goa and do not possess registered fishing canoes or trawlers.
required_documents: Certificate of Vessel Registration issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa
Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Women And Girl Acid Attack Victims
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial pension to women and girls in Haryana who have suffered disfigurement or disability due to acid attacks or similar corrosive substances. It aims to help victims live with dignity and provides tiered financial assistance based on the percentage of disability.
required_documents: Medical certificate issued by the Medical Board at the District level
Copy of application made to or benefit received from Women & Child Development Department

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under The National Foundation For Communal Harmony
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for the physical and psychological rehabilitation of child victims of communal, caste, ethnic, or terrorist violence. The assistance specifically supports their care, general education, and vocational training.
required_documents: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir
Death Certificate of both the Parents (in case of Orphan Child)
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)
Any other document required by the District Social Welfare Office

scheme_name: Financial Assistance Under The National Fund For Persons With Disabilities
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DoEPwD)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to support various livelihood activities and core areas for the empowerment of persons with disabilities. It assists PwDs with benchmark disabilities who have excelled in sports, arts, or literature to participate in national and international events, and aids organizations in conducting exhibitions and workshops.
required_documents: Supporting Document showing Experience of the Organization
Memorandum of Association of the Organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹21,000/- as Shagun for the marriage of workers' sons and for the self-marriage of unmarried male workers in Haryana. It aims to reduce the financial pressure on workers during these occasions. Eligible workers must be registered with the Board with a monthly salary not exceeding ₹25,000/- and a minimum of three years of regular membership.
required_documents: Employee Certificate/ID proof of the worker

scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Visually Impaired Advocates
department: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to visually impaired advocates practicing in courts in Kerala. Beneficiaries receive a non-recurring grant for books and suits, as well as a monthly reader's allowance for 10 years.
required_documents: Medical Certificate from an eye specialist
Certificate in the Prescribed Form from the Presiding Officer of the Court

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes scheme provides monetary support to the children of registered construction workers in Haryana. It offers ₹20,000 for coaching toward professional and technical courses, and ₹1,00,000 for preparing for the UPSC or HPSSC Main Examination after passing the preliminaries.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to traditional fishermen in Goa by covering 50% of the actual cost for purchasing or constructing a Wooden or FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe). Beneficiaries can avail of this subsidy once every four years per family household, with specific financial limits for General and SC/ST categories.
required_documents: Original GST Bill from the Authorized Dealer towards the Construction of the Wooden / FRP Craft

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education (GBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme is offered by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to provide financial assistance for the education of registered workers' children. Registered workers aged 18 to 60 who have completed 90 days of service in a year are eligible to apply offline.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
Educational Certificates/Marksheets of the Latest Qualifying Examination
Proof of Admission/Enrolment into the Institute
Proof of Identity of the Student
Affidavit of the Parent of the Student, signed before MLA/MP/Panchayat President/Gazetted Officer

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Cremation (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Cremation scheme provides ₹5,000 to the dependents of a deceased registered construction worker in Bihar for performing cremation. To be eligible, the deceased worker must have been registered and maintained regular membership with the Board during their lifetime.
required_documents: Identity Card of the Registered Worker
Proof Establishing Relationship between the Deceased and the Applicant

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for purchasing artificial limbs to workers employed in industrial and commercial units in Haryana, as well as their dependents, who become disabled due to the loss of vital organs in an accident. The assistance is provided up to the rates fixed by Saket Hospital, Chandimandir (Panchkula).

eligibility_rules.value: employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: Ration Card / ESI Card / Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Coaching- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Coaching scheme provides monetary support to the children of registered workers in Haryana for coaching towards professional course entrance exams or UPSC/HPSC main exams. It aims to help children of poor workers access quality coaching centres to secure admissions and bright futures.
required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial reimbursement for tuition and education expenses to registered construction workers for up to two of their children. The assistance covers students studying from Class 1 up to graduation, technical degrees like MBA, Engineering, and Medicine, as well as those preparing for competitive exams.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary
department: Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary scheme provides financial aid ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹37,500 per annum for the education of children of registered construction workers in Manipur who are staying in relief camps following the 2023 ethnic violence. The initiative aims to support the educational pursuits of displaced families.

eligibility_rules.value: residing in a relief camp due to violence

required_documents: Payment Receipt of the Last Contribution
Admission Certificate and Class Reading Certificate of the Child

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker
department: Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers in Tripura. It covers recognized Pre-Matric and Post-Matric courses to support the educational expenses of eligible students.
required_documents: Copy of BOC Worker Registration Card
Certificate of the Head of Institute of School, College & University

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Sports Activities
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered workers in Haryana who participate in sports competitions at various levels. It aims to encourage workers' children to become skilled sportspersons by supporting their participation in group or individual sports events.
required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Education scheme provides annual financial aid ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹12,000 to the children of workers suffering from silicosis in Haryana. The assistance supports children studying from Class I up to Master's Degree levels, covering up to two boys and three girls per affected worker.
required_documents: Medical Report (X-Ray, CT Scan, Medical Prescription, Any Other)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers and their children in West Bengal for pursuing education at the Higher Secondary level and above. Registered workers who have been active for at least 6 months can avail of the benefit up to twice.
required_documents: Passport size photographs of the worker
Attested copy of Proof of Age
