scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Cultural Activities
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered industrial and commercial workers in Haryana for participating in cultural competitions at various levels. It aims to encourage workers' children to showcase their talents and become good artists.

eligibility_rules.value: employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses (JKBOCWWB)
summary: The Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses scheme provides ₹5,000/- as monetary assistance to the nominee or legal heir upon the death of a registered construction worker. The deceased worker must have been an active member of the Jammu and Kashmir Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board at the time of death.
required_documents: Identity Card of the Deceased Worker
Identity Proof of the Nominee/Legal Heir
Certificate of Being a Nominee/legal Heir

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a fixed deposit of ₹1,00,000/- for one female child of a registered construction worker or their spouse. The benefit is applicable if the worker or spouse has undergone a family planning operation after the birth of one female child, and the fixed deposit remains in the bank until the girl turns 18.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Certificate of Family Planning Strategy (issued by Competent Medical Officers)
Affidavit Proof of applicant not having more than one daughter

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the children of registered construction workers for hostel facilities while pursuing regular technical or professional courses in recognized institutes. The assistance is disbursed directly to the educational institute.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme by the Government of Bihar provides ₹50,000 to registered construction workers with at least three years of continuous membership. The grant is offered for the marriage of up to two adult daughters or for the female worker's own marriage.
required_documents: Identity proof worker i.e. Aadhaar Card
Photo of the daughter along with the applicant or passport-size photo of the applicant herself
Proof of age, in case marriage of the daughter
Proof of marriage (photo, invitation card, certificate issued by the registrar etc.)
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Goa
summary: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial aid of ₹4,000 for the marriage of registered construction workers' children or for a female worker's own marriage. Applicants must have a continuous membership with the Board for at least 3 years.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
Proof of Age of the Bride
Proof of Age of the Groom

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage (HPBOCWWB)
ministry: Department of Labour and Employment, Himachal Pradesh
department: Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB)
summary: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme provides financial support of ₹51,000 for the marriage of a registered unmarried construction worker or for up to two children of a registered married construction worker. It aims to assist construction workers in Himachal Pradesh with the financial burdens associated with marriages.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter Card
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers
department: Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of registered construction workers themselves or for up to two of their children. Applicants must have continuous membership with the board for at least 3 years and meet specific residency and work-duration criteria.
required_documents: Marriage Photograph of Applicant with Spouse/Bride and Groom

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹15,000 to poor parents from Scheduled Castes for the marriage of up to two of their daughters. The objective is to support families in performing the marriages of their daughters in accordance with the law.
required_documents: Birth Certificate or TC of the Bride
Birth Certificate or TC of the Bridegroom
Recent passport-size photograph of the Bride
Recent passport-size photograph of the Bridegroom
First-time Marriage Certificate obtained from MP/MLA/Commissioner

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists
department: Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 to eligible full-time working and retired journalists for medical treatments and surgeries. Retired journalists receiving a government pension are eligible for 50% of the financial assistance.
required_documents: Copy of government order issued for receiving pension
Residential Certificate - Copy of family card / Voter ID card

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Miscarriage for the Construction Workers
summary: The Financial Assistance for Miscarriage for the Construction Workers scheme provides ₹3,000/- as financial assistance to registered female construction workers or the wives of registered male construction workers in the event of a miscarriage. The benefit is administered by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
required_documents: Proof of visiting a Hospital/ Nursing Home in connection with the pregnancy in the pregnancy period

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Natural Death
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the legal heir of a registered construction worker who passes away due to natural causes. The scheme aims to support the bereaved families of registered workers.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Medical (JKBOCWWB)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Medical scheme by JKBOCWWB provides financial aid to registered construction workers and their families for various medical needs. It covers treatment for injuries, temporary and permanent disabilities, and chronic diseases, with assistance amounts ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹1,00,000.
required_documents: Certificate of Medical Officer of Government or Private Empanelled hospital

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Normal Delivery and Surgical Delivery
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹15,000 for normal delivery and ₹20,000 for surgical delivery to registered female construction workers or the wives of registered male construction workers for up to their first two deliveries. It aims to support construction workers during maternity by alleviating medical financial burdens.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Natural/Surgical Maternity Certificate (issued by competent medical authorities)
Proof of Residence (One of Aadhaar Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Ration Sheet/Last Month's Electricity Bill/Gram Panchayat Certificate)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions
ministry: Higher, Technical Education & Skill Development Department
department: Higher, Technical Education & Skill Development Department
summary: The Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions scheme aims to enhance technical education by supporting private engineering and polytechnic institutions in Jharkhand. It provides grants for infrastructure development, modernization, and accreditation.

eligibility_rules.value: Private Self-Financed Engineering or Polytechnic Institute

required_documents: Registered Deed & Mutation Certificate for land ownership
Registration Certificate of the Trust/Society/Company managing the institution
AICTE Approval Letter and Affiliation Documents

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: The Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories scheme provides financial subsidies to traditional fishermen in Goa for purchasing barrier nets and accessories used in traditional fishing. General category applicants receive up to 50% subsidy (limited to ₹30,000), while SC, ST, and women applicants receive up to 60% subsidy (limited to ₹36,000).
required_documents: Original Invoice from authorized dealers for the purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
Barrier Net Registration Certificate and License Certificate issued by the Department of Fisheries
Mandate Form along with Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: This scheme provides a financial subsidy on petrol to traditional fishermen in Goa for the operation of their motorized fishing canoes. Eligible fishermen receive a subsidy of ₹30 per litre for a specified maximum annual consumption limit of petrol.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles, Denture, Hearing Aid (CBOCWWB)
department: Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers for purchasing spectacles, dentures, and hearing aids. Eligible beneficiaries can receive financial aid once in a lifetime upon the prescription of a Government Medical Officer.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of nominee
Prescription of Government Medical Officer/Chief Medical Officer/Principal Medical Officer

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides full reimbursement of educational expenses for the children of registered construction workers pursuing regular professional or technical courses. The Board bears all expenses for students in government institutions and covers expenses up to the highest state government institution fee structure for those in private institutions, for up to three children per worker.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy to traditional fishermen for purchasing stake nets and their accessories. A 50% subsidy is provided for the general category and 60% for SC/ST/Women categories, up to specified limits.
required_documents: Stake Allotment Permission issued by the Department of Fisheries
Stake Net Registration Certificate and License Certificate issued by the Department of Fisheries
Original Invoice from Authorized Dealers for the Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories
Mandate Form along with Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Registered Fishermen Society
summary: The Financial Assistance for Registered Fishermen Society scheme by the Government of Goa provides a grant-in-aid of up to ₹50,000 to eligible registered fisheries co-operative societies and associations. To qualify, societies must have more than 25 members, maintain proper records, and submit audited statements of accounts.
required_documents: Audit statement of the last year

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Self-Marriage of Registered Women Workers (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹50,000 to registered women construction workers in Haryana for arranging their own marriage. Eligible applicants must be registered members for at least one year and not have received similar assistance from other government entities.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Studies (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for Studies scheme provides educational financial support to the children of registered construction workers in Bihar. It covers full tuition fees for elite institutes like IIT, IIM, and AIIMS, alongside one-time financial assistance for B.Tech, Polytechnic, Nursing, and ITI courses in government institutions.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of tuition fee by the educational institution

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Setting up Crab Culture Unit
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible fishermen and farmers in Goa for setting up crab culture units and purchasing seed and feed. Beneficiaries receive a subsidy covering a percentage of the actual costs up to specified limits for up to 2 hectares of land.
required_documents: Survey Plan Showing Neighboring Area in Original
Form 1 & Form 14 of the Proposed Land
Proof of Existence of the Farm in Case the Farm is an Existing Traditional Farm
Residence Certificate of 15 Years in Goa

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers
summary: This scheme provides one-time financial assistance to the registered workers of industrial and commercial establishments in Haryana for their children studying from class 1st to 12th. The assistance is meant for purchasing school uniforms, books, stationery, and other educational materials to support their continued education.

eligibility_rules.value: registered worker in industrial or commercial establishment

required_documents: ID Proof of worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹7,000 for purchasing a tricycle to workers and their dependents in Haryana who have lost their legs due to an accident or other reasons. Registered workers with a monthly salary up to ₹25,000 and at least one year of service are eligible to receive this benefit once every five years.

eligibility_rules.value: Registered with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organisation

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 to registered construction workers for the indoor treatment of chronic diseases such as cancer, tuberculosis, and AIDS. It aims to support eligible beneficiaries by easing the medical expenses incurred during prolonged treatments.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients
summary: The Government of Haryana provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 to Stage III and IV cancer patients across the state. The scheme is applicable to all age groups and the benefit is in addition to any other social security pension received by the applicant.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible fish farmers, individuals, Self Help Groups, and societies in Goa for setting up ornamental fish breeding and rearing units. Beneficiaries receive a subsidy covering 50% of the actual cost, up to specified limits, to promote aquaculture and livelihood opportunities.
required_documents: Proof of Availability of Land (Land Deed / Form 1, Form 14 or NOC and Registered Lease Agreement)
Estimate for the Proposed Ornamental Unit/Expenditure Details

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary scheme provides annual financial aid to the children of registered construction workers in Odisha for their education. The assistance is available for up to two children studying in class 6th and above, including technical and professional education.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
department: Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development
summary: This program provides financial assistance to widows and destitute women belonging to the Scheduled Caste community in Chandigarh for the marriage of their daughters. The initiative aims to alleviate financial burdens and enable mothers or legal guardians to fulfill parental duties for a respectable marriage.
required_documents: Death certificate of father of girl (Bride)
Residence proof of three years (Voter Card, Ration Card, Electricity Bill, Water Bill, etc)
Legal Guardian certificate in case both the parents had died

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Widow or Widower of Registered Construction Worker
department: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹24,000 per annum for up to 5 years to the widow or widower of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker's death during employment. It aims to offer social security and financial support to the bereaved family members.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: This scheme provides 50% financial assistance to eligible traditional fishermen in Goa for purchasing essential safety gear including lifejackets and lifebuoys. The support is extended up to ₹1,000 per lifejacket and ₹1,500 per lifebuoy based on the type of fishing vessel owned.
required_documents: Updated Fishing License Certificate/Fishing Net License Receipts

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine (CBOCWWB)
department: Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)
summary: The Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine scheme provides a one-time financial aid of ₹3500/- to registered construction workers or their spouses for purchasing a sewing machine. Applicants must be registered members of the Board for at least six months and submit their application within one year of the purchase. The initiative aims to support the livelihood and empowerment of construction workers' families.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Copy of Aadhaar Card of nominee
Original bills of purchase verified by the employer

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents
summary: The scheme provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 for the treatment of ex-servicemen of the rank of Havildar or below and their dependents (wife and children) who have a disability of 40% or more or are suffering from serious illnesses. The financial aid is disbursed for a period of three years, after which a renewal application must be submitted.
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by a competent medical authority
Ex-Serviceman/Widow/Dependent ID Card issued by the District Sainik Welfare Office
Death Certificate (in case of deceased ex-serviceman or widow)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Haryana Labour Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹10,000/- for maternity to female workers and wives of male workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments in Haryana. The benefit is applicable for the delivery of up to two children, or up to three girls.

eligibility_rules.value: Employed in industrial or commercial establishment
Registered with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organisation

scheme_name: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers
summary: The Haryana Labour Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹51,000/- to eligible registered workers for the marriage of up to three daughters or for their own marriage. The scheme aims to reduce gender discrimination and support workers in industrial and commercial establishments across Haryana.

eligibility_rules.value: registered with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the establishment

scheme_name: Financial Assistance on Death/Disablement of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who suffer full or 50% disability due to an accident. It also provides financial assistance to the widowed dependents of registered male construction workers in the event of death from any reason.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Copy of Aadhaar Card of nominee
A copy of Aadhaar card of the app

scheme_name: Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: The Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons scheme provides ₹11,000 to workers suffering from silicosis for the marriage of up to two of their sons. The worker must be diagnosed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana, and registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board.
required_documents: Medical Report (X-Ray, CT Scan, Medical Prescription, Any Other)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance of Hearing Machine/Hearing Aid to Workers and their Dependents
summary: The Haryana Labour Welfare Board provides financial assistance of up to ₹5,000/- or the actual cost for purchasing a hearing aid to eligible workers and their dependents. The assistance is available to workers who have lost their hearing power due to an accident or other reasons, and can be availed once every five years.

eligibility_rules.value: employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board

scheme_name: Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person scheme provides financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to the legal heir in the event of the natural death of a registered differently-abled person. The assistance aims to support the family during bereavement.
required_documents: Differently Abled Person Original National Identity Card

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to 75% or Permanent Disability
department: Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 to registered construction workers in Maharashtra who suffer from 75% or more permanent disability. The benefit is aimed at supporting workers facing severe physical impairment due to accidents or medical conditions.
required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa provides financial assistance to eligible fishermen and farmers for brackish water aquaculture. It offers subsidies for farm construction and renovation, purchase of farming equipment, and purchase of feed. Farmers with a water spread area of 2 hectares or less and licensed by the Coastal Aquaculture Authority are eligible to apply.
required_documents: Joint Photograph of Applicant With Spouse
Work Completion Certificate of the Farm

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Disabled Ex-Servicemen
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 to disabled ex-servicemen who are bonafide residents of Haryana and were discharged from the Armed Forces on medical grounds with a disability not attributable to service. The assistance is provided regardless of age, provided the applicant does not receive any other financial assistance or pension.
required_documents: Original Discharge Book showing reasons for discharge on medical grounds
Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Blind Ex-Servicemen
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 to permanent blind ex-servicemen who are bona fide residents of Haryana. Beneficiaries must not be receiving any other pension or financial assistance from the state or central government.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number
Blind Certificate indicating the percentage of disability from competent Medical Authority

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Ex-Servicemen of and above the Age of 60 Years and their Widows
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month to bonafide resident ex-servicemen of other ranks (Havildar and below) and their widows who are aged 60 years and above. Applicants must be in penury with an annual income below ₹2,00,000 and not receiving any other pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from government or controlled bodies.
required_documents: Copy of Identity Card of Ex-serviceman/Widow of Ex-Serviceman
A copy of the Bank passbook linked with the Aadhaar number
Death Certificate of ex-serviceman (in case of widow)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Former Sports Person of UP
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to old, weak, or economically distressed former sports persons of Uttar Pradesh who brought glory to the state in their youth. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly stipend ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹3,000 based on their level of sports representation.
required_documents: Proof of age i.e. Birth certificate
Details of Sports competition/Championships of State, National & International importance covered by the applicant including profiles of Sports persons
Any other relevant documents, as required

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms
summary: The Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms scheme by the Government of Goa provides subsidies to eligible fish farmers, Self Help Groups, societies, and associations. It offers financial support for the construction and renovation of freshwater fish or prawn farms, as well as for purchasing necessary farming equipment and feed.
required_documents: Joint Photograph of Applicant with Spouse
Work Completion Certificate of the Farm

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Assistance on Fixed Capital Investment
summary: This scheme encourages the development of Industrial Parks in Gujarat by reimbursing a portion of eligible fixed capital investments. It aims to boost industrial growth, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities through financial assistance.
required_documents: Copy of Registration for Constitution of Developer Company/Firm
Copy of PAN Card of Developer Company/Firm
7/12 of Survey No. for Land in which Industrial Park to be developed
Village Map of Land in which Industrial Park to be developed

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Indigent Artistes
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month to indigent artists who are aged 50 years and above and have contributed to fields like music, dance, drama, folk, painting, and sculpture. It aims to support economically vulnerable artists residing in the Union Territory of Puducherry.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Stamp Duty
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance through stamp duty reimbursement to developers of industrial parks and individual units located within them. It aims to boost industrial growth and enhance facilities across industrial parks in Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy.

eligibility_rules.value: Industries Association, Societies Act registered enterprise, Partnership Act registered enterprise, Trust Act registered enterprise, Companies Act registered enterprise, SPV

required_documents: Copy of Registration for Constitution of Developer Company/Firm
Copy of PAN Card of Developer Company/Firm
7/12 of Survey No. for Land in which Industrial Park to be developed
Village Map of Land in which Industrial Park to be developed with Highlighted Survey

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Indigent Tamil Scholars
summary: The Financial Assistance to Indigent Tamil Scholars scheme provides a monthly financial aid of ₹1,500/- to indigent artists aged 58 and above who have made a significant contribution to Tamil language and literature. It aims to support elderly scholars facing financial hardship in Puducherry.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a 50% subsidy to eligible fishermen, farmers, and groups in Goa for setting up mussel culture and oyster farming units in estuarine waters and the open sea. It aims to promote aquaculture and support local livelihoods in the fisheries sector.
required_documents: Documents for the Proof of Availability of Land

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Infrastructure Facilities
summary: The scheme aims to boost industrial growth by providing financial assistance and reimbursing a portion of eligible fixed capital investments for developing infrastructure facilities in industrial parks. It also offers support for constructing residential facilities like hostels or dormitories for domiciled workers.
required_documents: Copy of Registration for Constitution of Developer Company/Firm
Copy of PAN Card of Developer Company/Firm
7/12 of Survey No. for Land in which Industrial Park to be developed
Village Map of Land in which Industrial Park to be developed

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)
department: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance
summary: This Maharashtra government scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to newlyweds from backward classes who participate in mass marriage ceremonies. It aims to reduce economic, social, and educational backwardness and helps integrate these communities into the mainstream of society.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Castes, Vimukta Castes, Nomadic Tribes, Special Backward Classes

required_documents: Written affidavit stating no violation of Prevention of Child Marriage Act and Prevention of Dowry Act

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Old Age Pensioner Suffering From TB/ Cancer
summary: The scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹500 to old age or destitute pensioners in Puducherry who are suffering from TB or Cancer to help cover their medical expenses. It is granted in addition to the regular old age pension amount.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department
Medical Certificate From the Medical Authority of the Government Hospital or Institution
Photocopy of the Old Age Pension Book

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of Ex-Servicemen
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month to orphan children of Ex-Servicemen in Haryana. Eligible beneficiaries must be bonafide residents of Haryana, below 21 years of age, unmarried, and unemployed.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number
Death Certificate of the father and mother of the Orphan signed by the competent authority

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Para/Tetra/Hemi Plegic Ex-Servicemen
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month to eligible Paraplegic, Tetraplegic, and Hemiplegic Ex-Servicemen who are bonafide residents of Haryana. The assistance is granted to those who are 100% disabled, penury, and not receiving any other financial assistance from the Haryana Government.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar
Disability/Medical Certificate indicating the %age of disability
Self-Photo ID card (Ration Card/Driving License/ Voter ID Card/PAN card etc.)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Non Governmental Organisations
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Non-Governmental Organisations running schools for children with intellectual disabilities in Tamil Nadu. Funds are sanctioned for feeding charges, rent, and building construction or extension to support the education and welfare of these children.

eligibility_rules.value: school for children with intellectual disability

required_documents: Registration Certificate (under Section 51 of the Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2016)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Meet the Funeral Expenses of Differently Abled Person
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- to the legal heir of a deceased differently abled person to help meet funeral expenses. The deceased person must have been a registered member of the Welfare Board for the Differently Abled.
required_documents: Original National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person, issued by the Welfare Board for the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Persons Suffering from Rare Diseases
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Haryana
summary: The Financial Assistance to Persons Suffering from Rare Diseases scheme provides ₹3,000 per month to eligible residents of Haryana who are diagnosed with specified rare diseases. The scheme aims to support patients from lower-income families with an annual family income of less than ₹3,00,000. This assistance is provided in addition to any benefits received under other social security pension schemes.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Pensioners Suffering From HIV and AIDS
department: Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security
summary: This scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer to individuals suffering from HIV/AIDS in Jharkhand to help cover medical expenses. It ensures social security support for patients undergoing Antiretroviral Therapy who do not receive other government pensions or pay income tax.
required_documents: Medical Proof of receiving Antiretroviral Therapy (ART)/Antiretroviral Drugs (ARD) from District AIDS Control Society
Copy of Aadhar Card or Self-declaration

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy to traditional fishermen for purchasing an outboard motor of 2HP to 5HP. The subsidy ranges from 50% to 60% of the unit cost depending on the beneficiary category for operating fishing canoes below 26 feet.
required_documents: Vessel Registration Certificate (VRC) issued by the Captain of Ports or the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa
River Gill Net Registration Certificate (RGNC) and License Certificate (LC) issued by the Department of Fisheries

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Physically/Mentally Disabled Children of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
summary: The Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹1000 per month to registered construction workers having a child with 40% or more physical or mental disability. The benefit is applicable for a maximum of two children of eligible registered workers.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Copy of Aadhaar Card of nominee

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹500 per month to poor patients from Scheduled Caste communities in Puducherry who are suffering from prolonged illnesses and cannot earn a livelihood. It aims to support their medical and daily needs.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to SC Students Studying in Medical, Engineering and Diploma Course for Purchasing Educational Instrument
department: Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare, Government of Gujarat
summary: This scheme provides one-time financial assistance in the first year to Scheduled Caste students in Gujarat pursuing Medical, Engineering, or Diploma courses to help them purchase educational instruments and equipment. The assistance amount varies by course type, up to ₹6,00,000/- annual family income.
required_documents: Caste Certificate from the Competent Authorities
Income Certificate (Competent Authority) (Form No. 16 required for Govt. Employee)
Break Affidavit (If Break Gap is more than One Year)
First Page of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Cheque

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy to traditional fishermen in Goa for purchasing or constructing new fishing craft less than 26 feet for inland fishing. It aims to uplift the traditional fishing community by reducing the financial burden of acquiring necessary equipment.
required_documents: Original Invoice towards Purchase/Construction of New Fibre Reinforced Plastic (FRP)
Vessel Registration Certificate issued by Captain of Ports
River Gill Net Registration Certificate and License Certificate issued by the Department of Fisheries
Other Backward Class (OBC) (Kharvi) Certificate or Profession Certificate

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to ST Students under Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana
summary: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana provides additional financial assistance of up to ₹15,000/- to Scheduled Tribe students in Goa to cover food and travel expenses that are not fully met by the Post Matric Scholarship. It offers a maintenance allowance for both day scholars and hostellers studying in recognized institutions.
required_documents: Attested Copies of Mark Sheet/Passing Certificate of the Exam Passed in the Academic Year
Attested Copy of Income Certificate Issued by Competent Authority for the Year
Attested Copy of Schedule Tribes Certificate Issued by the Competent Authority
Attested Copies of the Hostel Receipt
Attested Copy of Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad
department: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to 100 selected Scheduled Caste (SC) students for pursuing Masters and Ph.D. programs abroad in specified fields. It offers up to ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. and ₹10,00,000/- for Masters, covering tuition and living expenses at accredited foreign universities.
required_documents: Offer Letter From Accredited Foreign University
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Employer (For Employed Candidates)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability
department: Department of Sports & Youth Services Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to pursue coaching courses conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala. It aims to help them become qualified coaches and improve their employability through skill development.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance as a 50% subsidy for the construction or renovation of value-added fisheries units and the purchase of equipment. It aims to support individuals and groups in setting up value-added seafood processing units in Goa.
required_documents: Proof of Availability of Land/Ownership Documents

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture
summary: The scheme aims to revive, preserve, and protect the traditional Goan Maand culture, including folk art forms, folklore, and folk music. It provides financial support, infrastructure, and honorariums to Maand Gurus, trainers, assistants, and trainees to maintain cultural heritage and pass traditions to future generations.
required_documents: An undertaking whether their village Maand is still in existence or not
No Objection Certificate from the concerned Devasthan/ Maand
Original/ Copy of the Utilization Certificate (if any grant was sanctioned in preceding years)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Funeral Rites
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 10,000 to Scheduled Caste families in the Union Territory of Puducherry to perform funeral rites and overcome immediate financial hardship upon the death of a family member.
required_documents: Recent Passport-Size Photograph of the Applicant

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to War Widows of Defence Forces
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 to widows of Defence Force personnel who were killed in action during the declared wars of 1962, 1965, and 1971. The assistance is granted in addition to the family pension they already receive from the Government of India.
required_documents: Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number
Casualty Certificate from the concerned record office
Applicant’s Photo ID card (Ration Card/Driving License)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to WW II Veteran and Widows of WW II Veterans
department: Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹10,000 to World War-II veterans and their widows who are bonafide residents of Haryana and facing financial distress. Beneficiaries must not be receiving any other pension or financial assistance from the government.
required_documents: Copy of Ex-serviceman/Widow of Ex-Serviceman Identity Card
A copy of the Bank Passbook linked with the Aadhaar Number

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the widow or dependent of a registered worker who worked in industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana and died due to any reason. The application must be submitted within two years from the date of death.

eligibility_rules.value: registered worker in industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization/Smart Card /Office ID Proof
Affidavit (fully dependent upon the deceased worker and earlier he/she has not availed of the said scheme)
Ration Card / ESI Card / Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Unmarried
ministry: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) Department
department: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) Department
summary: The Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹2750 to unmarried persons aged 45 years and above in Haryana. The scheme aims to offer social security to eligible individuals whose verified annual family income is up to ₹1,80,000.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered workers in Haryana who have visually, physically, or mentally disabled dependent children with a disability ranging from 70% to 100%. Assistance of ₹20,000/- per year is given for 70% to 90% disability, and ₹30,000/- per year for 91% to 100% disability. The child must be unmarried and have no source of income.

eligibility_rules.value: worker in industrial or commercial establishment
registered worker with Haryana Labour Welfare Board

required_documents: ID proof of the worker issued by the organization

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Traditional Artisans (Panchavrutthi Scheme)
summary: The Panchavrutthi Scheme provides financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 (comprising a loan and subsidy) to traditional artisans of the Vishwakarma community in Karnataka. It aims to help them purchase modern tools and upgrade their technological skills to enhance their trade and craftsmanship.

eligibility_rules.value: Gold & Silver work, Sculpture, Blacksmith, Woodwork & Handicrafts, Metallurgy

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Widower
ministry: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) Department
department: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) Department
summary: The Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme provides social security through a monthly financial assistance of ₹2,750 to eligible widowers in Haryana. Beneficiaries must be at least 40 years old with a verified annual income of up to ₹3.00 lakh. The assistance continues until the beneficiary turns 60 years old.
required_documents: Domicile Proof/Proof of Haryana residency for at least 15 years

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses
summary: This scheme provides one-time financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 to cover the interest component of educational loans for children of government and aided institution teachers/lecturers studying medical or engineering courses. It aims to reduce the financial burden on families by directly transferring the sanctioned amount to the borrower's bank account.

eligibility_rules.value: Teacher/Lecturer in Government or Aided Institution

required_documents: Certified Mark Sheets of all years/semesters
Proof of Educational Loan (availed from a nationalized bank)
Teacher’s life membership (LMS) card attested by the head of the institution
Proof of school attendance (from 1st to 10th standard) certified by the head of the school and Taluk Constituent Education Officer
HRMS Copy or recruitment approval for teachers from aided institutions

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy to registered fish vendors in Goa for purchasing accessories like crates, weighing balances, and insulated boxes to ensure hygienic fish vending. General category applicants receive a 50% subsidy up to ₹10,000, while SC, ST, and women applicants receive a 60% subsidy up to ₹12,000.
required_documents: Original Invoice from registered dealers for the purchase of accessories required for Fish Vending
Identity Card (Fish Vendor) issued by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa
Mandate Form along with Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Financial Grant for Sports Associations
ministry: Tourism, Art-Culture, Sports, and Youth Affairs Department
department: Tourism, Art-Culture, Sports, and Youth Affairs Department
summary: The Financial Grant for Sports Associations scheme provides financial assistance to recognized state-level sports associations in Jharkhand. It aims to support the organization of sports competitions, conduct training camps, and promote overall sports development in the state.
required_documents: Audit Reports of the Last 3 Years
An Undertaking Ensuring Compliance with Departmental Guidelines

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers (JKBOCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the dependents of registered construction workers in the event of the worker's death. It is administered by the Jammu and Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to support the bereaved families.
required_documents: Original Death Certificate of the Worker
Attested Age Proof of the Worker
Duly attested copy of the Bank Passbook of the nominee/legal heir OR a cancelled cheque
Copy of the Aadhaar Card or Biometric Card of the deceased
Copy of the Aadhaar Card or Biometric Card of the nominee/claimant

scheme_name: Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
department: Information & Public Relations Department, Government of Odisha
summary: The Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme provides financial assistance to working journalists or their legal heirs in cases of permanent incapacitation or death. An ex-gratia of ₹4,00,000 is given in the event of death, and ₹2,00,000 for permanent incapacitation.
required_documents: Copy of accreditation card for accredited journalist

scheme_name: Financial Assistive Devices for Persons with Disabilities
department: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam
summary: This scheme provides loans of up to ₹5 lakhs to persons with disabilities in Haryana for purchasing assistive devices such as motorized tricycles, scooty, hearing aids, and screen readers. The financial assistance aims to improve their employability or support self-employment prospects.
required_documents: Resident Proof/Address Proof/Ownership Proof i.e. Haryana Domicile Certificate

scheme_name: Financial Incentives To Mothers Who Deliver A Girl Child (Mamta)
department: Directorate of Women And Child Development
summary: The Mamta scheme provides a one-time financial incentive of ₹ 10,000 to mothers who deliver a live girl child in a registered medical institution in Goa. The initiative aims to improve the female child sex ratio in the state and is available to all mothers regardless of their socio-economic status.
required_documents: Certified/Self-Attested Copy of Birth Report/Certificate from Registered Institution
Proof of Residence in Goa for at least 3 years OR Marriage Certificate and Residential Certificate of Husband

scheme_name: Financial Support Scheme for Farm Mechanization (FSSM)
summary: The Financial Support Scheme for Farm Mechanization (FSSM) provides financial subsidies to small and marginal farmers and recognized farmer groups in West Bengal. It aims to facilitate agricultural mechanization to ensure better productivity and minimize cultivation costs.

scheme_name: Financial Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
summary: This scheme provides a one-time fixed financial assistance of ₹ 50,000 to SC/ST patients suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases in Assam. It aims to help economically backward patients afford advanced medical treatment.
required_documents: Medical certificate of the applicant and relevant documents
Bank Account details with IFSC (copy of Front Page of Bank Pass Book)

scheme_name: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to the wife upon the premature death of the head of a family belonging to the Saharia primitive tribe. The assistance aims to help the family manage immediate financial burdens after the loss.

scheme_name: Financial Support Scheme
summary: The Financial Support Scheme by Delhi University provides equity and access to quality education by offering tuition fee waivers to economically weak students. It aims to reduce the financial burden of undergraduate and postgraduate students from low-income families.
required_documents: Copy of EWS/OBC-NCL Certificate or Annual Family Income Certificate
Self-attested copies of latest income Tax Returns (2022-23) of father, mother, unmarried sister(s), and unmarried brother(s) below 25 years
Copy of PAN card(s) of family members

scheme_name: First Self Marriage Expenses
department: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
summary: The First Self Marriage Expenses scheme provides financial assistance of ₹30,000/- to registered construction workers in Maharashtra towards their first self-marriage expenses. The initiative aims to support construction workers financially during significant life events.

eligibility_rules.value: registered under Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to meritorious Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan who have passed their board or university exams in the first division. The objective is to motivate regular college students by offering a direct financial incentive of up to ₹3,500/-.

scheme_name: Fish Extension, Research, and Training Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
summary: The Fish Extension, Research, and Training Scheme promotes sustainable fishing practices and enhances fish production through scientific research, extension, and skill development. It provides financial and technical assistance, training subsidies, and research grants to fish farmers, extension workers, and fishery stakeholders.

eligibility_rules.value: registered fish farmer, fishery extension worker, or related entity in the fisheries sector

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
ministry: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
summary: This scholarship scheme provides financial assistance to students from the North Eastern States pursuing recognized diploma, degree, post-graduate, M.Phil., or Ph.D. courses within the country. The scholarship is disbursed through the National Scholarship Portal and is available to students whose family annual income does not exceed ₹8,00,000.

scheme_name: Fish Marketing Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Cooperation
department: Fisheries Division, Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Cooperation, Government of Jharkhand
summary: The Fish Marketing Scheme provides financial assistance and subsidies to fisheries cooperative societies and their members for fish marketing and transportation. It helps beneficiaries purchase four-wheeler transport vans and set up aquarium shops to improve livelihood opportunities in the fisheries sector.
required_documents: Membership Proof of Fisheries Cooperative Society

scheme_name: Fishermen Accident Relief Scheme
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
summary: The Fishermen Accident Relief Scheme provides financial assistance to the legal heirs of deceased fishermen in Gujarat. Assistance is granted in cases of death in a Pakistan jail, getting lost in the sea, or accidental death while fishing at sea.
required_documents: Identity of resident of Gujarat State
Copy of Boat Call, License, and Movement Book
Copy of Bank Passbook of Legal Heir

scheme_name: Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme provides two years of specialized fitter training at ITI, Guindy, for hearing-impaired candidates along with a monthly stipend of ₹300. It aims to enhance the skills and employability of persons with hearing disabilities.

scheme_name: Financial assistance for Marriage for the Construction Worker
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of registered building and construction workers themselves or up to two of their children. The assistance amount varies based on the gender of the applicant or their children.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Floriculture Development Scheme
summary: The Floriculture Development Scheme motivates farmers to adopt commercial floriculture by providing subsidized planting materials and free low-cost polyhouses. It aims to increase farmers' income through the cultivation of low-volume, high-value flower crops.
required_documents: Documents proof of possessing agricultural land

scheme_name: Food Bill Assistance
summary: The Food Bill Assistance scheme by the Government of Gujarat provides financial support of ₹1,500 per month for 10 months to students from non-reserved categories who live away from their home taluka in hostels to pursue education. It aims to ease the living and educational expenses of eligible students enrolled in professional or higher secondary courses.
required_documents: Application form in the prescribed format
Letter of Admission to School/College (Bona Fide)

scheme_name: Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme (ST Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme provides improved varieties of fodder seeds to Scheduled Tribe farmers in Gujarat. The initiative aims to promote widespread publicity, demonstration, and adaptation of improved fodder cultivation among local farmers.
required_documents: Proof of possessing 10 Guntha of land

scheme_name: Fodder Minikits under Schedule Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The Fodder Minikits scheme provides improved varieties of fodder seed minikits (ranging from 3 Kg to 10 Kg) to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Caste category in Gujarat. The initiative aims to promote widespread publicity, demonstration, and adaptation of improved fodder seeds among farmers who own at least 10 Guntha of land.
required_documents: Proof of possessing 10 Guntha of land

scheme_name: Food Safety & Standards Authority Of India (FSSAI) Internship Scheme
department: Food Safety & Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
summary: The FSSAI Internship Program provides students pursuing graduate, post-graduate, or higher degrees with unique learning opportunities in food regulation and food safety administration. Interns are attached to various divisions and labs for a duration of 2 to 6 months and receive a monthly stipend of ₹10,000 upon successful completion.
required_documents: Letter from Institute indicating student status

scheme_name: Forest And Climate Change Internship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
summary: The Forest And Climate Change Internship Scheme engages students pursuing graduation, post-graduation, or research degrees to work as interns across various divisions of the Ministry. It provides young academic talent with short-term exposure to the Ministry's functioning and offers a monthly stipend of ₹10,000.
required_documents: Mark Sheet / Degree of Graduation / Post Graduation
A Letter from the Supervisor / Head of the Department / Principal indicating their Status in the Institution
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Institution

scheme_name: Fodder Minikits under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department
summary: The Fodder Minikits scheme provides improved varieties of fodder seeds to general category farmers in Gujarat for demonstration and adaptation. Eligible beneficiaries receive fodder seed minikits ranging from 3 Kg to 10 Kg, provided they meet land possession requirements.
required_documents: Proof of possessing 10 Guntha of land

scheme_name: Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya)
summary: The Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya) provides temporary and substitute family care for children in difficult circumstances, such as those affected by family breakdown, illness, abandonment, or disaster. It offers financial allowances to eligible foster families to help meet the basic needs, maintenance, and care of the placed children.

scheme_name: Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries
summary: The Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH aims to support fishermen cooperatives and enhance fish production in Jharkhand. It provides financial aid, administrative support, infrastructure development, marketing assistance, and welfare measures to strengthen cooperative operations and improve the socio-economic status of fishermen.
required_documents: Proof of Registration of Cooperative Society
Membership List of the Cooperative Society
Recent Audit Reports of the Society
Bank Account Details of the Cooperative Society

scheme_name: Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme
summary: The Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme by the Government of Jharkhand provides financial support of ₹3000 via DBT to Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 8. The scheme aims to promote education by ensuring better accessibility to schools.

scheme_name: Foreign Education Scheme
department: Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation
summary: The Foreign Education Scheme supports meritorious students from unreserved and economically weaker sections in Gujarat to pursue higher education abroad. It provides financial assistance up to ₹15,00,000 at a simple interest rate of 4% to cover tuition fees and other educational expenses.
required_documents: Admission Letter from the foreign university/college

scheme_name: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
summary: This scheme provides free bicycles to students belonging to Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes in Rajasthan studying in classes 6 to 11. It aims to facilitate their commute between home and school, promoting education among these communities with equal benefits for boys and girls.

eligibility_rules.value: Denotified Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, Semi-Nomadic Tribes
Class 6, Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, Class 10, Class 11

required_documents: Student's Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Free Books Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
department: Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana
summary: This scheme aims to encourage Scheduled Caste (SC) students in Haryana to pursue higher education by providing financial assistance of ₹2,000 per annum for purchasing books. It is applicable to eligible SC students studying in government colleges across the state.

scheme_name: Free Bus Pass for Media Persons
summary: The Free Bus Pass for Media Persons scheme provides free bus passes in Puducherry Road Transport Corporation buses to eligible media professionals for their professional travel needs. The pass is valid for one year and is available to media workers meeting specific residency and service criteria.

scheme_name: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
summary: The Food Bill Assistance to SC Students scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month for up to 10 months to Scheduled Caste students residing in college-affiliated hostels in Gujarat. The scheme aims to support their education by easing food-related expenses for families with an annual income up to ₹6 lakhs.
required_documents: Caste Certificate from the Competent Authority
Form no.16 required for Govt. Employee
Break Affidavit (If Break Gap is more than One Year)
First Page of Bank Passbook/Cancelled Cheque

scheme_name: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
department: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare
summary: The Free Caste Hostel scheme provides monthly scholarships ranging from ₹1,230 to ₹1,270 for 10 months to students belonging to De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic tribes studying in local educational institutions of Madhya Pradesh. It aims to support their education by offering hostel facilities and financial assistance.

scheme_name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students provides high-quality coaching to economically disadvantaged SC and OBC candidates to help them clear competitive examinations for jobs or secure admission in reputed educational institutions. Selected students receive a monthly stipend and can choose an institute of their own preference.
required_documents: Details of the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account

scheme_name: Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
summary: The Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities scheme provides financial assistance to voluntary organizations to offer free coaching to students with disabilities for competitive exams and higher education admissions. It aims to improve their academic performance, boost employment opportunities, and empower them to compete effectively. Eligible students must have at least 40% disability and family income below ₹6,00,000 per annum.
required_documents: Mark sheets of the previous qualifying examination

scheme_name: Free Distribution of Blankets and Chappals to Senior Citizen
summary: This scheme provides poor senior citizens in Puducherry with one blanket and one pair of chappals every year. It aims to support elderly residents who are recipients of the Old Age Pension.

scheme_name: Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme by the Government of Puducherry provides free distribution of 15 Kgs of rice per month or equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to eligible differently abled persons. The selection of beneficiaries is periodical and depends on the availability of funds.

scheme_name: Free Cycles to SC Girl Students Studying in Standard IX (Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana)
department: Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Government of Gujarat
summary: The Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana provides free bicycles to Scheduled Caste girl students studying in the 9th standard in Gujarat. The scheme aims to reduce dropout rates among girls and facilitate easier commute to school, subject to an annual family income limit.
required_documents: Caste Certificate from the Competent Authorities

scheme_name: Free Distribution of Text Books to Students
summary: Launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, this scheme provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools. It aims to support students' education by reducing financial burdens on families.

scheme_name: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners / Participants Of National/ International Events
summary: This scheme aims to assist medal-winning sportspersons and participants of national and international sporting events in pursuing higher education. It covers tuition fees, hostel facilities, and provides allowances to motivate them to achieve excellence in both sports and academics.

eligibility_rules.value: Medal winner of National games or participant in recognized international sporting events
UGC recognized universities, colleges, deemed universities, central/state funded institutions, or Institutes of National Importance

required_documents: Attested Certificate of participation or medal winner proof

scheme_name: Free Education Scheme
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: The Free Education Scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides financial assistance to students from Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and De-notified Communities (DNC). It covers special fees, non-refundable compulsory fees, and examination fees for students pursuing 3-year undergraduate programs in Government and Government Aided Arts and Science Colleges.

eligibility_rules.value: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, Denotified Communities

required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority)
Admission letter or proof of enrollment
Bank account details for fee reimbursement

scheme_name: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, and Law)
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: This Tamil Nadu government scheme provides financial assistance to students from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities pursuing professional courses. It covers tuition fees, special fees, non-refundable compulsory fees, and full examination fees for eligible students whose family income is below ₹1,00,000 annually and who have no graduates in the family.
required_documents: Admission letter or proof of enrollment

scheme_name: Free Education Scholarship for Three-Year Diploma (Polytechnic Courses)
ministry: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance, including the full payment of tuition fees, compulsory non-refundable fees, and examination fees, to students from Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) in Tamil Nadu. It aims to support eligible students pursuing a three-year diploma in Government and Government Aided Polytechnics.
required_documents: Admission letter or proof of enrollment

scheme_name: Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
department: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
summary: This Madhya Pradesh state scheme provides free quality coaching and training for competitive examinations to economically disadvantaged youth belonging to backward and minority classes. It aims to improve employment opportunities by offering training near their residence with stipend support and academic facilities.

scheme_name: Free Medical Card for Media Persons
summary: The Free Medical Card for Media Persons scheme provides free medical facilities and treatment in government hospitals, including A-Class Special Wards, to press correspondents and their families in Puducherry. Eligible media persons receive identification cards to avail of these healthcare benefits.

scheme_name: Free Scooty Distribution for Girls (GEN-CATEGORY-EWS)
summary: The Free Scooty Distribution for Girls scheme aims to encourage meritorious girl students from the economically weaker section of the general category in Rajasthan. Eligible students who score 85% or above in Class 10th or 12th examinations receive a free scooty, along with a helmet and petrol.

scheme_name: Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
summary: The Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme provides free motorized tricycles to individuals with severe physical disabilities in Uttar Pradesh to enhance their mobility, independence, and social rehabilitation. Eligible beneficiaries receive a grant of up to ₹25,000 towards the actual price of the tricycle.

scheme_name: Free Passport Scheme
summary: The Free Passport Scheme by the Government of Haryana encourages higher education by reimbursing passport application fees for final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students. Eligible students enrolled in government colleges can receive a fee reimbursement of up to ₹1,500/- through their respective institutions.
required_documents: Address proof (Aadhaar card, Electricity bill, Water bill, Telephone bill, Proof of gas connection, Voter ID, Income tax assessment order, Registered rent agreement, or Photo passbook of bank account)
Proof of date of birth (Birth certificate issued by a municipal body or Secondary school leaving certificate)

scheme_name: Free Studentship
summary: The Free Studentship scheme by the Government of Meghalaya provides financial assistance for tuition and other fees to students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories. The program helps cover educational costs for regular students pursuing studies in recognized institutions across various streams.
required_documents: Mark-sheet and Certificate (High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) Matriculation or any equivalent Examination)

scheme_name: Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows
ministry: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
summary: The scheme aims to provide free notebooks to the children of poor widows studying up to higher secondary courses to support their education. It has also been extended to children residing in government children's homes and service homes.
required_documents: Necessary Certificate from the Government Children's Home / Service Home

scheme_name: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
summary: This scheme provides 10 kg of free rice to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families through fair-price shops during natural calamities and on two important festive occasions every year. It aims to support vulnerable populations in the Union Territory of Pondicherry by ensuring food security during times of need.
required_documents: BPL Ration Card by the Civil Supplies Department, Pondicherry

scheme_name: Free Supply of Sarees and Dhothies to the Poor People
summary: This scheme provides two sets of clothing items, including sarees, blouse pieces, lungis, and towels, once a year to poor individuals as a social security measure. Beneficiaries are identified using Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department data in Puducherry.
required_documents: BPL Ration Card by the Civil Supplies Department, Pondicherry

scheme_name: Free Supply of Text Books
summary: The 'Free Supply of Text Book' scheme by the Government of NCT of Delhi provides financial assistance for purchasing textbooks, writing materials, and geometry boxes to students. It aims to ensure equitable access to educational resources for all students enrolled in Government and Aided Schools from Nursery to Class XII.
required_documents: Admission Proof (Fee Receipt or School ID Card)

scheme_name: Free Travel in S.T Bus to the Disabled Persons
summary: This scheme provides free travel facilities in all types of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation buses to Persons with Disabilities. Beneficiaries can travel for free on all state routes as well as up to the last station on out-of-state routes.
required_documents: Disability Medical Certificate from the District Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent

scheme_name: Fruit Development Scheme
summary: The Fruit Development Scheme by the Government of Meghalaya provides farmers with good quality planting materials, horticultural tools, and implements at a 50% subsidy or free of cost through convergence with MGNREGA. It aims to promote fruit cultivation across the state.
required_documents: Documents proof of possessing own or leased land

scheme_name: Free Travelling Facility (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance for travel expenses to registered construction workers and up to four family members to visit famous religious or historical places once every four years. The reimbursed amount covers Haryana Roadways ordinary fare rates or actual Second Class railway fare.

scheme_name: Fruit Processing Centre
summary: The Fruit Processing Centre scheme disseminates technical know-how on fruit preservation to youth entrepreneurs, farmers, and housewives in Meghalaya. It offers practical training and demonstration on processing fruits and vegetables to manufacture quality products like squashes, jams, and juices.

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance
department: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme provides financial aid of ₹10,000 for funeral expenses to the nominated legal heir of a registered construction worker in the event of their death. It is implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to support grieving families.

eligibility_rules.value: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

scheme_name: Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme by the Government of Gujarat offers health check-ups for male Shramyogis above 45 years and female Shramyogis above 35 years working in the organized sector. Eligible workers, whose Labour Welfare Fund has been regularly paid for the past year, can receive this medical check-up benefit once a year.
required_documents: A copy of the identity card issued by the contractor to the worker/labour

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme provides financial aid of ₹5,000 to the nominees or dependents of a deceased registered construction worker in Assam to help cover funeral expenses. The deceased worker must have had an active membership with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
required_documents: ABOCWWB ID Card of the deceased worker
Attested Copy of ID Card of the Deceased Worker
Death Certificate Issued by Government Doctor/Appropriate Authority
Certificate of Guardianship with consent from the other family members and minor nominee
