Copy of Payslip of Account Paybook

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance (CBOCWWB)
department: Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹5000 to the legal heirs of registered construction workers upon their death. The assistance is aimed at helping the family cover funeral expenses, provided the worker was a registered member for at least six months.
required_documents: Copy of the Aadhaar card of the deceased registered worker
Death Certificate issued by a Competent Authority
Copy of the BOCW Card of the deceased worker
A copy of the salary slip of the deceased registered worker

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹5,000 to the nominees or dependents of registered deceased construction workers for funeral expenses. The deceased worker must have had an active membership with the Board.
required_documents: Copy of the nomination/legal heir certificate
Registration ID Card of deceased worker
Identity proof of nominee or dependent i.e. Aadhaar Card

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance (GBOCWWB)
department: Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Goa
summary: The Funeral Assistance (GBOCWWB) scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to the nominee or dependant of a deceased construction worker. It is administered by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to support families during a crisis.
required_documents: Receipt of Payment of First & Last Subscription with the Board
Document Establishing the Relationship between the Deceased Worker and the Applicant
Certificate from Builder or Inspector of the Area, in the case of nominee/dependant of the unregistered workers

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Assistance Scheme by the Government of Gujarat provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to the legal heir of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker's death during ongoing membership. The scheme aims to support the bereaved family by covering funeral expenses.
required_documents: Copy of bank passbook of heir
Self Declaration Form as per Resolution dated 20/09/2022 of Revenue Department

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme provides financial aid of ₹15,000 for funeral expenses to the nominee or legal heir of a registered construction worker in Haryana upon their death. The assistance is provided as a one-time benefit to help the family manage immediate funeral costs.
required_documents: Identity card of the registered deceased worker
Identity proof of the nominee/legal heir
Certificate of being a nominee/legal heir

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Funeral Assistance Scheme provides ₹3,000/- for the last rites of destitute individuals, unclaimed bodies, and families registered under labour schemes in Madhya Pradesh. It aims to ease the financial burden on poor families struggling to afford final rites.
required_documents: Certificate issued by the place of cremation/resting place/graveyard etc. of the deceased
FIR in case of death due to accident, quarrel etc.
FIR and Panchnama in case of unclaimed dead body
Doctor's certificate in case of death in hospital

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
department: Labour Department, Union Territory of Puducherry
summary: The Funeral Assistance Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹7,000/- to the nominees or dependents of a registered deceased construction worker towards funeral expenses. The assistance is credited directly through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) upon application submission within two months of the worker's death.
required_documents: Duly Filled and Signed Application Form
Birth Certificate/Transfer Certificate/Doctor Certificate for Age Verification
Experience Certificate to Be Obtained From a Registered Engineer/contractor/association/trade Union
Proof of Blood Group (Medical Health Card)

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance for the Construction Worker
summary: The Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers scheme provides financial support of ₹10,000/- for funeral expenses to the nominees or dependents of a registered construction worker in the event of their death. It is administered by the Sikkim Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (PULWS)
summary: The Funeral Assistance Scheme provides ₹7,000/- as financial assistance to the nominee of a deceased unorganized worker in Puducherry to help cover funeral expenses. The amount is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the nominee's bank account.

value: Workers Employed in Shops & Catering Establishments
Workers Engaged in Bricks and Tiles Manufacturing
Workers Engaged in Distribution of Liquid Petroleum Gas Cylinder

required_documents: Society ID Card/ Proof of Registration

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers
summary: The Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 to the nominees or dependents of registered deceased construction workers. It aims to support families in covering funeral expenses following the death of a registered member of the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

scheme_name: Funeral Assistance- Haryana Silicosis Board
summary: The Funeral Assistance scheme provides financial aid of ₹15,000 to the dependent or nominee of a deceased worker confirmed to have suffered from Silicosis in Haryana. The assistance is intended to help cover the costs of performing funerary rituals.
required_documents: Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Identity Card of the deceased worker
Death Certificate/Post Mortem Report of the worker
Proof of relation with the deceased worker

scheme_name: Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers scheme provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 to the nominee of a deceased registered construction worker to help cover funeral expenses. It is administered by the Labour Department of West Bengal for registered members of the welfare board.
required_documents: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age

scheme_name: Funeral Financial Assistant (APB&OCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Financial Assistant scheme provides cash financial assistance of ₹1000 to the families of deceased registered construction workers in Arunachal Pradesh for funeral expenses. It is implemented through the Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB) to support families upon the worker's death.
required_documents: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc.
Original copy of the registration card of the worker
Bank Account number/ front page of the passbook

scheme_name: Funeral Benefit (MBOCWWB)
department: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Benefit scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000 to the legal nominees or dependents of a deceased registered construction worker in Meghalaya to help cover funeral expenses. The deceased worker must have been a resident of Meghalaya and actively registered with the MBOCWWB.

eligibility_rules.value: Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Challan/Receipt of the Monthly Subscription paid
Nominee's ID Proof (Voter ID, Licence or others)
Guardian Certificate (in case Applicant is Minor)

scheme_name: Funeral Support Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
summary: The Funeral Support Scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 to the nominees or dependents of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker's death. It aims to support the bereaved family of registered workers under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
required_documents: Bank account details/copy of bank passbook
Identity proof of the nominee/legal heir

scheme_name: Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana
summary: This scheme by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh aims to empower unorganized workers, specifically retail vegetable and fruit/flower vendors. It provides financial assistance of Rs 700 per beneficiary for purchasing scales, weights, and baskets.

scheme_name: Funeral and Ex-Gratia (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The Funeral and Ex-Gratia scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board of Karnataka provides financial assistance of ₹4,000 for funeral expenses and an ex-gratia payment of ₹71,000 to the nominee upon the death of a registered construction worker. The scheme aims to help mitigate the financial burden caused by the sudden demise of the worker.

scheme_name: FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program promotes a novel skilling ecosystem by incentivizing the cost of eligible digital upskilling courses in 10 in-demand technologies. It provides authentic certifications and financial reimbursements up to ₹14,500 to eligible citizens who successfully complete paid technical courses.
required_documents: Bank Account Statement Showing the Account Number and IFSC Code

scheme_name: Gitanjali Housing Scheme
summary: The Gitanjali Housing Scheme aims to provide proper, free-of-cost shelters and affordable homes to homeless people and the economically weaker sections in rural and non-municipal urban areas of West Bengal. It prioritizes individuals affected by natural calamities, disasters, or government projects, as well as those on the BPL list with low monthly income.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar card, voter ID, PAN card, passport, or driving license)
Address proof (Aadhaar card, voter ID, electricity bill, water bill, or telephone bill)
Proof of age (birth certificate or school leaving certificate)
beneficiary_categories: Poor People in Rural and Urban areas

scheme_name: GROUP WORKSHED SCHEME
summary: The Group Workshed Scheme facilitates the establishment of worksheds for shuttleless looms in powerloom clusters to improve working conditions, work efficiency, and global competitiveness. It provides financial subsidies for the construction of worksheds based on beneficiary categories and infrastructure requirements.

scheme_name: GST Exemption Certificate Scheme
summary: The GST Exemption Certificate Scheme provides a GST concession to orthopedically disabled persons on the purchase of a car. Eligible applicants receive a certificate allowing them to pay 18% GST with zero cess instead of 28% GST and applicable cess.
required_documents: Unique Disability ID card (UDID) or Disability certificate
Income Tax Return filed for the last three years

scheme_name: Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
summary: The Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana provides financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- in three installments to eligible Gadiya Lohar families in Rajasthan for constructing permanent houses. The scheme aims to facilitate permanent settlement and promote the social and economic integration of the Gadiya Lohar community.

scheme_name: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme
summary: The Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-Aid Scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹10,000 to the Gadia Lohar community in Rajasthan. The grant is intended to help them purchase raw materials and become self-reliant in their business.

scheme_name: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students
summary: The Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana provides additional financial assistance to OBC (Dhangar) students in Goa to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance. It offers monthly allowances to help cover food, travel, and disability-related expenses for eligible students.

scheme_name: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students
summary: The Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students provides additional financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students in Goa to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance. It covers food, travel, and disability-related expenses for eligible students.
required_documents: Caste Certificate (Valid for 3 years from date of issue)
Income Certificate (Valid for 3 years from date of issue)

scheme_name: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan)
summary: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan) aims to keep rural areas clean and generate wealth and energy by converting cattle dung and organic waste into biogas and organic manure. It supports villages in achieving ODF-plus status under the Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II while increasing rural household incomes.
required_documents: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTN)

scheme_name: Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana
summary: The Uttar Pradesh Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana provides financial assistance and full reimbursement for medical treatment of serious illnesses to registered construction workers and their families who are not covered under Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana. Benefits are applicable for treatments in government, autonomous, or NHA/SACHIS empanelled hospitals with no maximum limit on the amount.
required_documents: Copy of construction worker registration card
Copy of bank passbook for account number, branch name and IFSC code
Certificate of being an unmarried daughter or a daughter below 21 years of age

scheme_name: Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance and scholarships to the children of workers employed in registered factories, commercial establishments, and shops in Uttar Pradesh. The assistance is aimed at encouraging academic excellence across various levels of education from high school to postgraduate studies.

eligibility_rules.value: worker in registered factory, commercial establishment, or shop

required_documents: Attested photocopy of the online filled application form related to the scheme
Photocopy of bank passbook of son/daughter or worker with IFS code
Marksheet of High School, Intermediate, Graduation, or Masters exam

scheme_name: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme
summary: The Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme by the Government of Gujarat aims to empower widowed women by offering regular financial support. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension directly deposited into their accounts to ensure self-reliance and dignity.

scheme_name: Ganga Kalyana Scheme
summary: The Ganga Kalyana Scheme provides fully subsidized bore wells, pump sets, and electrification to small and marginal farmers belonging to minority communities in rural areas to improve agricultural irrigation. Financial allocations vary by district for individual bore well projects, ranging from Rs 2.25 Lakhs to Rs 3.75 Lakhs.
required_documents: Caste certificate issued by the competent authority
Income certificate issued by the competent authority
Copy of the Aadhaar Card (Proof of Residence)
Small/ Marginal Farmer Certificate issued by Competent Authority
Copy of the Bank Pass Book

scheme_name: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
summary: The Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme provides financial assistance for the remarriage of widowed women to help them reintegrate into society. Eligible beneficiaries receive financial support through Direct Bank Transfer and National Savings Certificates.

scheme_name: Gaon Ki Beti
summary: The Gaon Ki Beti scheme aims to provide financial assistance to talented girls from rural areas to encourage them to pursue higher education. Selected students receive a monthly scholarship to help them continue their studies and build a bright future.
required_documents: Current college code and branch code
Mobile number and email id of the candidate

scheme_name: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
summary: Gargi Puruskar Yojana provides financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 annually to girl students studying in classes 11 and 12 who have secured a minimum of 75% marks in class 10. The scheme aims to encourage girl education across all classes without any income or caste restrictions.

scheme_name: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
summary: Garima Greh aims to provide safe shelter along with basic amenities like food, clothing, medical care, and counseling to destitute and abandoned transgender persons. The scheme also focuses on empowering them through skill development programs to help them lead a dignified life.

scheme_name: Gau Palan Yojana
summary: Gau Palan Yojana by the Government of Uttarakhand promotes cow rearing by providing financial assistance for the purchase of milch cows. Eligible beneficiaries from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes receive a 90% subsidy up to ₹36,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer.
required_documents: Purchase Receipt or Proforma Invoice of the Cow

scheme_name: Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)
ministry: Ministry of Animal Husbandry, Government of Madhya Pradesh
summary: The Gausevak Training scheme aims to empower educated unemployed rural youth in Madhya Pradesh with self-employment opportunities and primary veterinary skills. It provides fully funded training, stipends, and kits for initial and refresher courses to help them serve remote rural areas.

scheme_name: Gatidhara Scheme
department: Transport Department, Government of West Bengal
summary: The Gatidhara Scheme was launched by the Government of West Bengal to provide financial support and generate self-employment for registered unemployed youth in the transport sector. Eligible beneficiaries receive a subsidy of 30% of the ex-showroom price of a commercial vehicle, up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/-.
required_documents: Proof of enrollment in Employment Bank

scheme_name: Gaushala Vikas Yojana
summary: The Gaushala Vikas Yojana provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000 for infrastructure development to eligible registered gaushalas in Rajasthan. The scheme aims to support institutions that have maintained at least 100 cattle consistently for the past two years and possess land ownership or a long-term lease of at least 20 years.
required_documents: Estimate approved by competent level for getting the construction work done
Copy of Registration number and date under the Rajasthan Societies Registration Act, 1958, or Rajasthan Gaushala Act, 1960
Bank details including name, branch, address, account number, and IFSC code verified by the bank

scheme_name: Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence
summary: The Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence provides financial assistance to meritorious students belonging to the Brahmin community in Andhra Pradesh who achieve top ranks in their respective courses, ranging from SSC to Professional Education.
required_documents: Aadhar Card of the Student Parents

scheme_name: General Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The General Pension scheme provides a monthly pension to registered construction workers in Assam who have completed 60 years of age and have worked for at least one year. The benefit includes a base pension amount plus an additional increment for every completed year of service from the year of registration.
required_documents: Experience Certificate/Employers Certificate (90 days working record)

scheme_name: Funeral Grant (Sainik Welfare)
summary: Funeral Grant is a welfare scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund that provides financial assistance of ₹12,000 upon the death of an ex-serviceman (to the widow) or ₹10,000 upon the death of an ex-serviceman's widow (to a family member). The deceased must have been registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry during their lifetime.
required_documents: Death Certificate of the ESM/ ESM's Widow
Certificate to remove the Body, issued by the competent authority

scheme_name: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)
department: School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
summary: The General Poor Class Scholarship provides financial assistance to economically weaker students studying in Classes 6 to 8 in government schools. Girl students receive ₹300 per year and boy students receive ₹200 per year to support their education.

scheme_name: Gen Next Competition
department: Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles, and Khadi Department
summary: The Gen Next Competition scheme aims to preserve the traditional handicrafts of Tamil Nadu by encouraging youngsters to enter the field through a craft competition. Eligible young artisans compete in various handicraft categories and are rewarded with a cash prize, a silver medal, and a certificate.
required_documents: Address Proof (Family Card / Voter ID Card / Driving License)
Artisan's Affidavit on ₹20/- Stamp Paper, attested by a First Class Criminal Judge or Notary Public
Recommendation Certificate, attested by any of the Managers of Poombucar Outlets and Manufacturing Plants

scheme_name: General Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh
summary: The General Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh provides financial assistance to financially disadvantaged students from the General caste enrolled in Class 9 or 10. The scheme aims to bridge the financial gap, encourage students to complete secondary education, and alleviate the financial burden on families.
required_documents: Mark sheet of your last qualifying examination

scheme_name: General Surgery Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
summary: The General Surgery Scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Punjab, provides financial assistance for general surgery to registered construction workers and their family members. Beneficiaries can receive financial coverage of up to ₹50,000 or actual expenses, whichever is less.

scheme_name: Generator Subsidy
department: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department
summary: The Generator Subsidy scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides financial assistance to new and existing Micro, Small, and Medium Manufacturing Enterprises. It offers a 25% subsidy on the cost of purchasing a generator with a capacity of up to 320 KVA, capped at a maximum of ₹5,00,000.

eligibility_rules.value: Micro, Small, and Medium Manufacturing Enterprises

scheme_name: Generator Subsidy-Tamil Nadu
summary: The Generator Subsidy scheme provides financial assistance to manufacturers in Tamil Nadu by offering a 25% subsidy, up to a maximum of ₹1,50,000, on the cost of generator sets with a capacity of up to 125 KVA. Eligible enterprises must claim the subsidy within six months from the date of purchase or installation.
required_documents: Proof of purchase or installation of the generator set
Invoice and receipt of the generator
Proof of enterprise registration (MSME registration certificate)
Bank account details for subsidy transfer
Installation certificate from a certified technician

scheme_name: Ghar Ghar Aushodhi Yojana
summary: The Rajasthan Ghar Ghar Aushadhi Yojana aims to promote the use of Ayurvedic and medicinal herbs like Tulsi, Ashwagandha, Giloy, and Kalmegh to boost citizens' immunity and health. Each family is provided with 24 saplings over a period of 5 years to encourage planting at home.

scheme_name: Gharaunda-Group Home for Adults Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: The Gharaunda scheme aims to set up group homes to provide an assured home and minimum quality of care services throughout the life of adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, and Multiple Disabilities. It ensures acceptable living standards, basic medical care, and vocational activities for persons with disabilities.

eligibility_rules.value: Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, Multiple Disabilities

required_documents: Birth certificate or Date of Birth proof of the PwD
BPL certificate or Income certificate of Parent or Guardian
ID proof of parent or guardian
LG certificate in case parents are not the guardians or PwD is above 18

scheme_name: Gharelu Hinsa Ki Pidita Ke Liye Sahayta Yojana
summary: This scheme provides financial compensation and support to women and girls in Madhya Pradesh who have suffered physical harm or injuries resulting from domestic violence. Compensation amounts vary based on the extent of disability caused by the abuse, ranging up to ₹4,00,000/-.
required_documents: Any other relevant documents related to the domestic violence incident

scheme_name: Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana
summary: This scheme was launched by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh to empower female unorganized workers by providing them with essential equipment and items such as a cycle, umbrella, and slippers or shoes. Beneficiaries receive this assistance to ease their daily commute and labor.

scheme_name: Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme
summary: The Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme provides financial incentives to girl students in Arunachal Pradesh to ensure they remain in school during their menstrual periods and to raise awareness about menstrual hygiene. Eligible students receive ₹50 per month through direct benefit transfer for sanitary napkins.
required_documents: Bank details of the applicant/concerned girl student

scheme_name: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
department: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare
summary: The Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th provides a financial incentive of ₹3,000 to girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities who enroll in Class 11 for the first time. The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girls from these specific communities in Madhya Pradesh.
required_documents: Bonafide Certificate of a Recognised Institution

scheme_name: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
summary: The Go Green Scheme offers financial assistance to construction and industrial workers in Gujarat for purchasing battery-operated electric two-wheelers to reduce carbon emissions. Beneficiaries receive a subsidy of up to 30% or ₹30,000, along with a reimbursement of RTO registration and road taxes.

scheme_name: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Go-Green Shramik Scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers in Gujarat for purchasing battery-operated two-wheelers. It aims to promote environmental awareness, reduce commuting time and costs, and help workers live in cleaner residential areas away from construction sites.

scheme_name: Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme (GBOCWWB)
department: Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)
summary: The Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme provides a one-time subsidy of up to ₹48,000 or 50% of the ex-showroom price on the purchase of battery-operated tricycles (e-rickshaws) to registered construction workers who have suffered a disability due to an accident at a construction site. Additionally, it reimburses the initial registration fee and road tax to help disabled workers earn a livelihood and support their families.
required_documents: RTO of the registered construction worker
Certificate of incapacity from the Certifying Civil Surgeon

scheme_name: Goa Mediclaim Scheme
summary: The Goa Mediclaim Scheme provides financial assistance to permanent residents of Goa for availing super-speciality medical treatments that are not available in government hospitals. It covers various critical ailments and treatments such as dialysis, ICU care, surgeries, and organ transplants up to specified ceiling limits.
required_documents: Medical Certificate From a Treating Doctor
Income Certificate in the Prescribed Form ‘B’ or Pension Payment Order (PPO)

scheme_name: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The PRABHAT scheme provides technical and vocational training to sex workers and sexually abused women to help them earn a livelihood and rehabilitate. Beneficiaries receive a monthly stipend of ₹2,500 for up to three months while undergoing training. The scheme aims to empower victims of commercial sexual exploitation through skill development.

scheme_name: Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award
department: Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa
summary: The Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award scheme recognizes and rewards one meritorious library and one librarian serving in Government or Government-aided libraries in Goa. It aims to encourage excellence in library management and services, contributing to the state's library movement.
required_documents: Photographs of the Library with the Collection

scheme_name: Goa State Cultural Award
summary: The Goa State Cultural Award honours eminent personalities and artists par excellence for their lifetime achievements and extraordinary contributions to art and culture in Goa. Awardees receive a certificate, shawl, sriphal, a financial purse of ₹1,00,000, and monthly financial assistance under the Kala Samman scheme.
required_documents: Photograph of Performance/ Felicitations/ Contribution in the Particular Field

scheme_name: Goa State Cultural Award for Institution
summary: The Goa State Cultural Award for Institution recognizes and appreciates cultural institutions in Goa for their extraordinary contributions to art and culture. The scheme provides a memento and a financial purse of up to ₹3,00,000 to boost cultural environments and encourage new talents.

scheme_name: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008
department: Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
summary: The Goa State Export Market Development Scheme encourages local industries to improve and establish their goods in export markets. It provides interest-free loans of up to ₹5,00,000 for participating in international exhibitions and undertaking market study tours abroad.
required_documents: Financial Statement duly certified by a Chartered Accountant for the last preceding three years

scheme_name: Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008
department: Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
summary: The Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for Industries promotes industrial growth, creates employment for local youth, and revives sick industrial units. It offers financial incentives including local employment subsidies, capital contribution preferences, and increased interest subsidy limits for eligible manufacturing enterprises.
required_documents: Registration Details With the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Declaration Executed Before a Magistrate Regarding Employee Eligibility
Green Social Security Card for Employees
Revival Plan Approval for Sick Units (if Applicable)

scheme_name: Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme, 2008
department: Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
summary: The scheme encourages industrial units in Goa to obtain national and international certifications and patent rights to maintain quality standards and promote industrial growth. It provides financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 or actual expenses incurred, whichever is less, for obtaining these certifications or patents.
required_documents: Documentary Proof of Certification From Indian Standard Institute/international Standard Organization or Any International Certification or Patent Right or Any Other International Certification
Proof of Permanent Registration or Acknowledgment With Entrepreneurs Memorandum II by Director of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Clearance Certificate From High Powered Coordination Committee

scheme_name: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme
summary: The Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme aims to improve the welfare of retired working journalists in Goa and support their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family welfare benefits amounting to 50% of the pension in the event of the journalist's death.
required_documents: Statement Issued By The Newspaper Concerned (Annexure-III)
Attested Copy To Prove The Date Of Birth
Employment Certificate From The Newspaper Establishment

scheme_name: Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme
department: Department of Industries, Government of Goa
summary: The Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme provides financial assistance and maida purchase subsidies to traditional bakers in Goa. The scheme aims to protect and promote the traditional occupation of bread-making while maintaining affordable prices for essential Goan breads.
required_documents: Affidavit Sworn By The Applicant Declaring The Contents Mentioned In The Application Are True
Copy Of ID/Registration Of Membership Of Bakers Association
Recommendation From All Goa Bakers Association
Raw Material Purchase Bills For Maida For The Previous 6 Month

scheme_name: Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme Scheme
summary: The Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme Scheme provides financial assistance and subsidies to educated unemployed individuals belonging to tribal communities in Goa for setting up micro, small, manufacturing, service, and trade enterprises. Beneficiaries receive a 40% subsidy on the total loan amount and mandatory entrepreneurship training.
required_documents: Valid Caste Certificate from Competent Authority

scheme_name: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa reimburses an amount equivalent to the actual VAT paid on High-Speed Diesel (H.S.D.) oil consumed by registered fishing vessels. It aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen by subsidizing their fuel costs based on a limited quota.
required_documents: Fishermen Corpus Fund Form Duly Filled
Report on VAT Charged on HSD Oil by the Oil Company

scheme_name: Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants And Awards Scheme
summary: The Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants and Awards Scheme provides an annual financial grant of ₹ 10,000/- to eligible local bodies (Panchayats and Municipal bodies) for administrative expenses incurred on organizing activities of their Village or Municipal Child Committees. The scheme aims to support local bodies that actively establish and maintain child committees to discuss and resolve children's issues.
required_documents: Documents showing the activities of the Child Committee

scheme_name: Goat Unit Scheme On Grants And Bank Loans
summary: The Goat Unit Scheme by the Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to improve beneficiaries' economic status through goat rearing. It provides grants and bank loans to purchase (10+1) goat units for milk and meat production, offering a 40% subsidy for general applicants and a 60% subsidy for SC/ST beneficiaries.

scheme_name: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
summary: The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly gross pension of ₹ 2,500/- to retired seamen, those invalidated on medical grounds, or eligible widows. Beneficiaries must meet specific residency, age, and service criteria to qualify for the scheme.
required_documents: Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) / Seafarers Identity Document
Birth Certificate or School Leaving Certificate

scheme_name: Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
summary: This scheme aims to distribute free goggles to needy visually impaired persons to protect them from sunlight and moisture. Applications are accepted offline through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled Person

scheme_name: Godhan Nyay Yojana
summary: Godhan Nyay Yojana is an initiative by the Chhattisgarh government to purchase cow dung from cattle herders to increase their income and promote organic farming. The procured cow dung is converted into vermicompost by women's self-help groups in Gauthans and sold to farmers at nominal rates.

scheme_name: Gomant Vibhushan Award
summary: The Gomant Vibhushan Award honours and recognizes renowned personalities of Goan origin who have made distinguished and extraordinary contributions in fields such as art and culture, literature, sports, science, social work, and public affairs at the national or international level. The award includes a memento, citation, and a financial purse of ₹5,00,000 and is presented once every two years.
required_documents: Copy of ID Proof of Recommender

scheme_name: Good Samaritan Scheme
summary: The Scheme for Good Samaritan grants a cash award of ₹ 5,000 to individuals who save the life of a fatal road accident victim by providing immediate medical assistance within the Golden Hour. Its objective is to motivate the general public to help road accident victims in emergency situations without fear of police or hospital harassment.

scheme_name: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana
summary: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana is a state-level health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Odisha. It covers the indoor and outdoor medical expenses of working journalists and newspaper hawkers along with their eligible family members, and provides financial assistance in cases of death or permanent incapacitation.
required_documents: Birth Certificate/ Matric Certificate / Voter Card / PAN card / Passport / DL
Accreditation Certificate in case of a freelance journalist
Photocopy of the dependent family member

scheme_name: Gopal Incentive Scheme
summary: The Gopal Incentive Scheme aims to promote the rearing of Indian high-breed cattle and encourage increased milk production in Madhya Pradesh. It offers cash awards and rewards to livestock farmers and breeders to incentivize cattle rearing and boost the population of productive Indian high-breed bovine animals.

scheme_name: Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana
department: Higher Education Department, Govt. of Odisha
summary: Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana is a financial assistance scheme by the Government of Odisha aimed at making higher education inclusive for underprivileged students. It provides an annual financial assistance of ₹ 20,000 to eligible students pursuing regular graduation and post-graduation courses in the state.
required_documents: College ID Card of the Student
Income Certificate of the Parent / Guardian
Medical Certificate from the concerned Medical Officer regarding suffering from HIV/AIDS, if required
Certificate relating to Households without Shelter from the Competent Revenue Authority, if required
Certificate towards being a Single Mother Family, if required

scheme_name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana
summary: This scheme provides financial compensation and assistance to registered farmers and one family member in case of accidental death or permanent disability. It aims to support families facing critical financial situations due to the loss or injury of the earning head in a farming household.
required_documents: Age proof evidence by birth certificate or School leaving certificate

scheme_name: Government Hostel for Working Women/ Girl Students
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The Government Hostel for Working Women/Girl Students initiative provides safe, suitable, and inexpensive accommodation with essential facilities like furnished rooms and common areas. It is designed to support working women and female college students by offering heavily subsidized monthly rent.
required_documents: Pay Certificate from the Organization/Firm (for Working Woman)
Study Certificate from the Institution (for Student)
Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department

scheme_name: Gopal Ratna Award Scheme
department: Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services
summary: The Gopal Ratna Award Scheme honours eminent dairy farmers in Goa who achieve the highest individual milk production through scientific dairy farming. It aims to encourage youth to take up dairy businesses and help the state achieve self-sufficiency in milk production by providing a cash prize, memento, and certificate.
required_documents: Evidence of Membership from a registered Dairy Co-operative Society/ Bachat Gat/ Self Help Groups
Records showing details of the number of animals, stage of lactation of each animal, milk yield, date of calving, address of cattle shed etc.
Proof of registration of dairy farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services

scheme_name: Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded - Tamil Nadu
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
summary: This scheme provides special education, vocational training, daily living skills training, food, uniforms, boarding, medicine, and lodging facilities to children with intellectual disabilities. It aims to support the overall development and empowerment of differently-abled children aged 4 to 18 years in Tamil Nadu.
required_documents: National Identity Card of the Differently Abled

scheme_name: Government Institutions for Teaching and Training of Persons with Disabilities
summary: This scheme provides free education, pre-professional training, hostel, food, clothing, and residential facilities for the rehabilitation of children with disabilities in Chhattisgarh. It aims to support children aged 6 to 10 years from lower-income families.

scheme_name: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired
summary: This scheme facilitates education, self-confidence development, and holistic support for visually impaired and hearing-impaired children in Puducherry. It provides free boarding, lodging, academic education, music training, uniforms, textbooks, educational necessities, and daily living needs.

scheme_name: Government Working Women’s Hostel
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Government Working Women’s Hostel scheme provides safe accommodation and food facilities for working women from lower and middle-income groups who live far from their families. Beneficiaries can stay in the hostel for up to 3 years while paying subsidized monthly rent.
required_documents: Certificate showing that the applicant belongs to a District / Place other than the place where the hostel is located

scheme_name: Government of Goa State Scholarship to NDA Cadets
summary: The State Scholarship to NDA Cadets by the Government of Goa provides financial assistance and an outfit allowance to underprivileged cadets from Goa undergoing training at the National Defence Academy. It aims to support cadets from economically disadvantaged backgrounds who have opted to serve in the Defence Services.
required_documents: ID Proof of National Defence Academy (NDA)

scheme_name: Grama Jyothi
summary: The Grama Jyothi program aims to achieve comprehensive rural development by decentralizing power and ensuring transparency and accountability at the Gram Panchayat level. It focuses on providing basic amenities like electricity, water supply, and sanitation through functional and financial convergence of various departments.

scheme_name: Grant For Organizing Conference
summary: The Grant for Organizing Conference (GOC) scheme by AICTE provides financial assistance to eligible institutions for organizing onsite and online national and international conferences. Its objective is to promote high standards in technical education by offering a forum for academicians and professionals to share knowledge, experiences, innovations, and research.
required_documents: Proforma for permission/clearance of the Government of India for organizing International Conference

scheme_name: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summary: The Government Service Home scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu provides institutional care, protection, education, and vocational training to widows, destitute women, deserted women, adolescent girls, and differently-abled women along with their children. Beneficiaries receive free accommodation, food, education, vocational training, and necessary supplies like textbooks, uniforms, and sanitary napkins.
required_documents: Certificate/Proof of Disability, in case of differently abled
Death Certificate of the Husband, in case of widows
Certificate showing Class Last Studied, if available

scheme_name: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home
department: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance
summary: The scheme provides financial grants to registered NGOs for operating old age homes that accommodate elderly men and women, destitute, and disabled individuals. It ensures beneficiaries receive essential facilities such as food, accommodation, lodging, boarding, and medical assistance.
required_documents: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Maharashtra
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)
Any other document required by the District Social Welfare Office

scheme_name: Grant For Purchase Of Tools (HBOCWWB)
department: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
summary: The Grant for Purchase of Tools scheme provides financial assistance of ₹8,000 to registered construction workers in Haryana for purchasing new tool kits. This grant can be availed once every three years by eligible members with at least one year of regular membership.

eligibility_rules.value: Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

required_documents: Undertaking along with price of tools and source of purchase

scheme_name: Grant Of Financial Assistance For The Funeral Expenses Of Old Age/ Destitute Pensioner
summary: The Government of Puducherry provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹500 to Old Age and Destitute Pensioners suffering from T.B. or Cancer to help cover their medical expenses in addition to their regular pension.
required_documents: Medical Certificate from the Medical Authority of the Government Hospital or Institution
Photocopy of the old age pension book

scheme_name: Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons
summary: The scheme encourages and supports marriages between differently-abled individuals and those without disabilities by providing a financial incentive of ₹1,00,000. The incentive is distributed as ₹20,000 in cash and ₹80,000 in National Savings Certificates (NSC).

scheme_name: Grant Scheme for Marriage of Daughters of Destitute Widow
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- for the marriage of the daughters of destitute widows who are recipients of a widow pension. It supports low-income families and those belonging to the BPL category in Uttarakhand.
required_documents: Antyodaya Card/ BPL Certificate/ Income Certificate
Copy of marriage certificate issued by the Registration Office
Certificate of date of birth of the bridegroom/bride (High School Certificate/Birth Certificate/Family Register/Aadhaar Card)

scheme_name: Grant Scheme for Marriage of SC and ST Girls
summary: The Grant Scheme for Marriage of SC and ST Girls provides financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to eligible brides from Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or BPL families in Uttarakhand to help cover marriage expenses. Assistance is available for a maximum of two daughters per family.
required_documents: Antyodaya Card/ BPL Certificate/ Income Certificate
Copy of marriage certificate issued by the Registration Office
Self-declaration regarding number of beneficiaries in the family

scheme_name: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students
summary: The Grant of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students is implemented by the Government of Puducherry to provide financial assistance for primary education. It aims to prevent parents from sending girls to work by compensating for potential lost income, supporting girls studying in standard I to V.

scheme_name: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme
department: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications
summary: This scheme by the Government of Goa provides a one-time grant towards capital expenses for educational institutes to set up or expand incubation centers within their campuses. Eligible institutes affiliated with a recognized public university can receive up to ₹10,00,000 for this purpose.
required_documents: Copy of plan expenditure of proposed expenses
Form and documents as mentioned in Annexure 1 for Educational Institutes
Aadhaar linked bank account of the Principal/ Director of the institute

scheme_name: Grant for Purchase of Bicycle (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)
summary: The Grant for Purchase of Bicycle scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹3,500/- to registered construction workers in Bihar for purchasing a bicycle. To be eligible, workers must have been continuous members of the Board for at least one year with active membership at the time of application. The benefit is disbursed upon the submission of a valid purchase receipt.
required_documents: Identity proof worker i.e. Aadhaar Card
Photo of construction worker's bicycle with BOCW Board Name Plate
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Grant for Purchase of Tools (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)
summary: The Grant for Purchase of Tools scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 to registered construction workers in Bihar who have completed skill upgradation training. The funds are intended for purchasing trade-related tools to enhance their employability and work efficiency.
required_documents: Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Grant for the Purchase of Tools/ Protective Gear for the Construction Workers
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000 to registered construction workers for purchasing necessary tools and protective gear. The benefit can be availed once every three years by eligible members of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers
department: Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹5,000 to registered construction workers for purchasing work-related tools once every 5 years. It aims to support eligible members of the fund in procuring necessary equipment for their occupation.

scheme_name: Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Tool Purchase Grant scheme provides a one-time reimbursement of up to ₹4,000 to registered construction workers for purchasing work-related tools upon producing original bills or vouchers. Beneficiaries must be registered with the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least one year.
required_documents: Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy
Original Bill or Voucher for tool purchase

scheme_name: Grant for the Repair of House (BBOCWWB)
department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: The Grant for the Repair of House scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to registered construction workers in Bihar who have been members of the Board for at least three years. The assistance is intended for house repairs and is provided only once to each eligible worker, excluding those who have previously received benefits for house construction, bicycles, or tools.
required_documents: Identity proof worker i.e. Aadhaar Card
Photo of the house being repaired with registered construction worker
LPC issued by the Circle Officer as ownership certificate of the land
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

scheme_name: Grant of 50% Subsidy for the Purchase of Aquarium and Its Accessories
summary: The scheme provides a 50% subsidy for the purchase of an aquarium and its accessories to propagate aquarium keeping among the public. It aims to support residents of Puducherry who possess a pucca house or commercial place to set up an aquarium unit.
required_documents: Resident Certificate of Union Territory of Puducherry
Proof of Possession of a Pucca House/Commercial Place

scheme_name: Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu
summary: This scholarship scheme provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 per annum to students belonging to the UT of Puducherry who are studying in Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu. The benefit is disbursed directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer.

eligibility_rules.value: Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu

required_documents: Residential/Domicile Certificate, issued by the Officer of the Revenue Department not below the rank of a Deputy Tahsildar
Proof of Admission into Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Marriage of Poor Brides Living Below Poverty Line
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to poor brides living below the poverty line to help meet their marriage expenses. It is granted for the first marriage of the eligible bride, subject to income and residency criteria.
required_documents: Birth Certificate / TC of Bride Groom
Certificate by MLA or Gazetted officer

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance for the purchase of textbooks and notebooks to school-going children of eligible industrial workers in Goa. It aims to support the educational needs of children studying in classes 1st to 4th in recognized schools.
required_documents: Proof of Regular Employment and Service Duration
School Enrollment Documents of the Student

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
summary: This scheme by the Government of Puducherry provides monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities to help them maintain a minimum standard of living. The grant amount varies based on the percentage of disability and the age of the applicant.

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 to poor parents in Puducherry who have only one living girl child studying in the 8th to 10th standard. The amount is deposited as a fixed deposit in the girl's name to promote small family norms and ease future financial burdens.
required_documents: Residence Certificate From the Revenue Department
Income Certificate From the Revenue Department
Certificate from MP/MLA/Commissioner of Municipality/Commune Panchayat/Revenue Officer
Certificate of Birth of the Girl Child

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹12,000 to poor Scheduled Caste pregnant and lactating women in Puducherry to support their health and well-being. The assistance is distributed as pre-natal and post-natal monthly cash grants for up to two deliveries.
required_documents: Certificate Issued by the Medical Superintendent of Maternity Hospital/Medical Officer in-charge

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,600 per annum for the purchase of one set of school uniforms to the children of eligible industrial workers in Goa. It aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income workers for their children's education in standards 1st to 4th.
required_documents: Proof of Regular Employment and Service Duration
Salary Statement/Income Certificate of the Worker
Disability Certificate of the Student, if applicable

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support of ₹25,000/- to eligible press reporters in Puducherry. Applicants must have served continuously for at least 10 years in a newspaper or magazine registered with the Registrar of Newspapers, Government of India.

scheme_name: Grant of Financial Incentives for Hotels, Resorts, and Tourism Projects
department: Department of Industrial Development (Tourism), Government of Puducherry
summary: Launched in 2004, this scheme provides financial incentives, capital grants, and subsidies to private entrepreneurs for developing hotels, resorts, heritage hotels, and tourism infrastructure in Puducherry. It aims to boost the tourism sector by supporting eligible projects completed and commissioned from 2005 onwards.
required_documents: Detailed project report in English about the infrastructure
Audited balance sheet and profit and loss statements from commencement
Approval and occupancy certificate issued by the Planning Authority of the respective regions of the Government of Puducherry

scheme_name: Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles
summary: The scheme provides a fuel subsidy of up to 50% of the cost of fuel to persons with disabilities who own motorised vehicles. It aims to ease the transportation costs for eligible differently abled residents of Puducherry.

scheme_name: Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person
summary: This scheme by the Government of Puducherry provides a financial incentive of ₹2,00,000 to encourage and support marriages between differently-abled individuals. The assistance is distributed as ₹40,000 in cash and ₹1,60,000 in National Savings Certificates (NSC).
required_documents: Aadhaar Card – Both Bride and Bridegroom
Ration Card - Both Bride and Bridegroom
Medical Certificate – Both Bride and Bridegroom
Caste Certificate - Both Bride and Bridegroom
NOC in Case of Other State Candidates
Voter ID Card – Both Bride and Bridegroom

scheme_name: Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹30,000 deposited in the name of girl children to families who have undergone family planning and have one or two girl children. The deposited amount matures when the girl child attains the age of 18 years, aiming to elevate the status of girl children and promote family planning.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department
Certificate of Marriage Registration of Parents
Certificate of Sterilization of Either of the Parents
Age Proof (Birth Certificate / TC) of Parents
Certificate of Birth of Girl Child/Children
Copy of the Family Ration Card & Election ID
Aadhar Card of Parents and Children

scheme_name: Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses
summary: The Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses is introduced by the Government of Puducherry to motivate Scheduled Caste people to maintain clean and tidy homes. Selected beneficiaries receive incentives in the form of household articles worth ₹500.

scheme_name: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
summary: The scheme provides a house construction subsidy of ₹4,00,000 in three installments along with building materials worth ₹1,00,000 to poor Scheduled Caste and economically backward class people who do not possess a house. Beneficiaries must own an eligible house site and meet specific annual income criteria based on their category.

eligibility_rules.value: Scheduled Caste, Other Economically Backward Class

scheme_name: Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 to eligible widows in Puducherry to help cover the marriage expenses of their first daughter. It aims to support vulnerable families by easing the financial burden of conducting a lawful marriage.
required_documents: Residence Certificate from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate from the Revenue Department
Death Certificate of the Bride's Father
Marriage Registration Certificate (Within 60 Days After Marriage)
Aadhaar Card of the Widow and Her Daughter (Bride)

scheme_name: Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees
summary: The Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to differently abled individuals undergoing technical or professional training. The initiative aims to support them in completing their vocational courses, empowering them to earn a livelihood and integrate into society.
required_documents: Attendance of trainees along with a completed certificate

scheme_name: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students
summary: The scheme aims to improve the educational status of handicapped children studying in standards 1st to 10th by providing financial assistance. It offers monthly stipends ranging from ₹200 to ₹300 to parents who are unable to send their children to school due to economic reasons.

scheme_name: Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges
department: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department
summary: The scheme encourages MSMEs to acquire quality standards and certifications for processes and products by reimbursing payments made to consultancy and certification agencies. It provides financial assistance up to ₹ 2,00,000 for National Level Certifications and up to ₹ 10,00,000 for International Level Certifications.
required_documents: Copy of Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum / Copy of Udyam Certificate
Certificate of Registration under the Indian Partnership Act / LLP / Societies Registration Act / Certificate of Incorporation
Proof for connected load (EB Meter card/online Statement)
Copy of invoices, cash bills, and stamped receipts

scheme_name: Grant of Stipend to the Differently Abled Trainees of the Vocational Training Institutes
summary: This scheme provides a fixed monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- to differently abled persons undergoing technical or professional training in recognized vocational training institutes. The financial assistance helps trainees successfully complete their courses and attain self-reliance.
required_documents: Attendance of the Trainee along with Completed Certificate

scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy For Setting up of Ice-Plant /Cold Storage/Fish Processing Unit
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare
summary: This fisheries development scheme aims to preserve fish and fishery products by facilitating the establishment of Ice Plant-cum-Cold Storage Units and Fish Processing Units. Eligible entities can avail of a 10% subsidy for setting up these facilities to support the fisheries sector.
required_documents: Declaration/Affidavit that the applicant has not availed any benefit of loan/subsidy from any other source for the intended purpose
A provisional loan sanction order from the bank
Necessary approvals from authorities such as Municipality, Department of Science and Technology, Inspector of Factories and Boilers, Agriculture Department, etc.

scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 2,500/- to bridegrooms from weaker sections for the purchase of Mangalyam. Applications must be submitted at least 15 days prior to the date of marriage.
required_documents: Residence Certificate of the Bridegroom from the Revenue Department
Income Certificate of the Bridegroom from the Revenue Department
Certificate from MP / MLA or the Commissioner of the Municipality / Commune Panchayat
Age Certificate / Age Proof of the Bride and Bridegroom

scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare
summary: This Puducherry government scheme aims to facilitate quick transportation of fish catches from landing centers to markets and prevent spoilage. It offers a 50% subsidy for the procurement of specified transport vehicles to eligible members of the fishermen community.
required_documents: Loan Sanction Order From the Bank
Quotation From the Dealer for the Vehicle
Driving License and Badge for Driving Moped/auto Goods Carrier or Transport Vehicle
Purchase Invoice Copies and Rc Book for Vehicle Verification
Copies of Mortgage Documents in Respect of the Beneficiary for Official Record

scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mobile Sea Food Van
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare
summary: The scheme provides a 75% departmental subsidy for purchasing a mobile seafood van to fisherwomen, SHGs, and Co-operative Societies in Puducherry. It aims to facilitate hygienic sales of fresh and processed fish in unserved areas at competitive prices.

eligibility_rules.value: Employed in Government, Government Undertaking, or societies

required_documents: Residential Certificate of the Union Territory of Puducherry
Proof of Membership with the Cooperative/SHG
Price Quotations of the Equipment Used for Fish Preparation
Certificates of Training on Fish Product Preparation

scheme_name: Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers
department: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers for building a house on their own land. Beneficiaries receive a token grant amount, with additional provisions for those covered under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.

eligibility_rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

required_documents: Attested copy of Proof of Age
Details of the establishment where the applicant is working
Proof regarding Submission of Registration fees
applicable_states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
summary: The Government of Puducherry provides a fixed transport allowance of ₹ 300 per month to eligible differently abled individuals. The benefit is distributed through Anganwadi Centres to support their mobility.
required_documents: Financial Assistance ID Card of Deceased

scheme_name: Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions
ministry: Ministry of School Education and Literacy, Jharkhand
summary: The Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions scheme aims to strengthen the infrastructure and ensure the holistic development of approved unaided secondary schools, permanent intermediate colleges, madrasas, and Sanskrit schools. It provides financial assistance for structural and educational development, including infrastructure, learning materials, and staff salaries.
required_documents: Institutional Registration Certificate (under Societies Registration Act, 1860)
Approval Certificate from the State Government or JAC
Constitution Document of the Managing Committee
Student Strength Proof (last three months’ attendance)
Details of Fund Usage (previous three financial years)

scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level
summary: This scheme provides financial grants to meritorious wards of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and their widows for achievements in sports at national and international levels. Grants range from ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 depending on the level of the sports achievement.

eligibility_rules.value: Ward of ESM / Ward of Widow of ESM

required_documents: Relevant Certificates of Achievements in Sports at National/International Level
Attested Copies for Participation and Sponsorship
Identity Card of the ESM / Widow of the ESM

scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)
summary: This welfare scheme provides lump sum financial grants of up to ₹18,000 to academically meritorious wards and widows of Ex-Servicemen who have secured top ranks in academics or gold medals in higher education. It aims to encourage educational excellence among the children of defense personnel.

eligibility_rules.value: Ward of Ex-Serviceman, Ward of Widow of Ex-Serviceman

required_documents: Identity Card of the ESM / Widow of the ESM

scheme_name: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces
summary: This scheme provides a financial grant of ₹15,000/- to the children of ex-servicemen for coaching after they successfully pass the written examination of competitive exams for recruitment into the Armed Forces such as NDA, CDS, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy.

eligibility_rules.value: NDA, CDS, IMA, OTA, Air Force, Naval Academy

required_documents: Proof of Passing the Written Examination (Admit card and result/scorecard/call letter)

scheme_name: Grant-In-Aid to Voluntary Organizations Working In The Area of Disabled Welfare
summary: Launched in 2018 by the Government of Chhattisgarh, this scheme supports voluntary organizations working for the welfare of disabled individuals by providing financial grants. It covers expenses for free education, training, residential arrangements, rehabilitation, operational costs, building rent, and office expenses.

eligibility_rules.value: registered and accredited by the Department

required_documents: Work Experience Proof (at least three years)
Bank Account Details of the Institution

scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)
department: Directorate of Women And Child Development
summary: This Goa state scheme provides financial assistance to registered Mahila Mandals and Women's Self-Help Groups to conduct training and orientation programs. The goal is to help members generate self-employment activities and ensure successful group functioning.
required_documents: Mahila Mandal/ Self Groups Copy of Registration Certificate
Last Two Years' Statement of Accounts
Detailed List of Prospective Beneficiaries With Educational Details

scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible NGOs running residential homes for orphans, destitute children, senior citizens, and disabled persons. NGOs receive ₹500 per month per inmate for 12 months, covering 90% of the grant-in-aid expenses while the NGO bears the remaining 10%.

scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals
summary: The Grant-in-Aid Scheme provides financial assistance to registered Mahila Mandals in Goa to conduct training and orientation programs for generating self-employment opportunities for women. It aims to encourage socio-educational activities and strengthen the functioning of women's groups by offering annual grants and raw material support.
required_documents: Last Two Years' Statement of Accounts
Project Report Specifying the Activities/training and List of Prospective Beneficiaries

scheme_name: Grant-in-aid (TB)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a Grant-in-Aid to indigent Scheduled Tribe and Scheduled Caste patients suffering from specified severe diseases in Mizoram. The assistance covers treatment costs and travel fare up to a maximum of Rs.2,500 per head.

scheme_name: Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings
summary: This scheme provides grant-in-aid to Village Education Committees and Urban Education Committees for undertaking urgent minor repairs of Government School buildings, especially prior to the monsoon. It covers up to 75% of the estimated cost with a ceiling limit of ₹ 50,000 per work.
required_documents: Identification details of the school and SEC/UEC
Photographs of the areas needing repair

scheme_name: Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations
summary: The Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations scheme covers 90% of the estimated maintenance cost for registered NGOs running residential homes for children, the aged, and vulnerable persons. It aims to support eligible non-profit organizations in providing care and shelter facilities.

scheme_name: Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
summary: This scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 to SC and ST patients suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases to help them afford advanced treatment. It aims to support economically disadvantaged individuals belonging to scheduled castes and scheduled tribes who face financial hardships during their medical treatment.

scheme_name: Green Business Scheme
department: National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
summary: The Green Business Scheme provides financial assistance in the form of loans for income-generating activities that help tackle climate change and mitigate the greenhouse effect, such as electric vehicles, solar gadgets, and poly houses. It is implemented by the NSFDC to support eligible beneficiaries with loan amounts up to 90% of the unit cost.

eligibility_rules.value: Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers, and their Dependents

beneficiary_categories: Dependents of Safai Karamcharis and Scavengers

scheme_name: Green House
summary: The Green House Scheme provides financial subsidies to farmers in Rajasthan for constructing greenhouses to cultivate horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, and fruits under controlled climatic conditions. The subsidy helps farmers overcome extreme weather challenges and ensures higher production and income throughout the year.
required_documents: Scheduled caste and scheduled tribe farmers' certificates

scheme_name: Green Passage Scheme
department: Higher Education Dept., Govt. of Odisha
summary: The Green Passage Scheme provides free higher education, including exemption from all academic and hostel fees, along with free accommodation and food, to orphaned students and children who lost their parents during the COVID-19 pandemic. It aims to support eligible students pursuing higher education in government or non-government institutions across Odisha.
required_documents: Income Certificate of the Guardian (if applicable)
Proof of Enrolment into the Current Course
Passing Certificate / Marksheet of the Previous Educational Qualification

scheme_name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: The Griha Aadhar Scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹ 1,500 to housewives and homemakers from middle, lower-middle, and poor sections of society in Goa to help them maintain a reasonable standard of living. The scheme aims to address the challenges of rising prices by directly supporting women with financial aid.
required_documents: Residence Certificate (15 years) of Self or Husband

scheme_name: Griha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
summary: The Griha Lakshmi scheme by the Government of Karnataka aims to empower women by providing a monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 to female heads of households. It helps eligible women manage household expenses and improve their quality of life.
required_documents: Copy of the Ration Card Where the Woman is Listed as the Head of the Family
Copy of the Aadhaar Card of the Beneficiary
Passbook of the Bank Account Linked With Aadhaar or RTGS Details for Non Aadhaar-linked Accounts
Any Document Proving Residence in Karnataka

scheme_name: Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers
summary: The Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers provides insurance cover to powerloom weavers in cases of natural death, accidental death, and partial or permanent disability due to accidents. Implemented in collaboration with the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India, it also offers financial support to the families of eligible weavers.

scheme_name: Group Insurance for Differently Abled Person Government Employees
summary: The Group Insurance for Differently Abled Person Government Employees scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a sum insured to the family of a differently-abled government employee in the unfortunate event of death due to an accident while in service. The benefit amount varies based on the employee group, ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹1,20,000.
required_documents: Proof of being a Government Servant

scheme_name: Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme For Coir Workers
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme provides financial protection to coir workers and their legal heirs against accidental death and permanent total or partial disabilities. It aims to offer succor to workers who face occupational hazards during coir processing activities.
required_documents: Certificate issued by Coir society, unit, establishment, or nominated officer of coir board
Disability certificate from a registered medical practitioner

scheme_name: Group Supply Of Goats And Sheep
summary: This Maharashtra government scheme provides a group of 10 goats and 1 buck to tribal beneficiaries at a 50 percent subsidy. It aims to increase income sources and create employment opportunities for farmers in tribal areas through collective livestock rearing.

scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance for Quality Certification
summary: The Gujarat Textile Policy provides financial assistance to industrial units in the textile sector for obtaining recognized national and international quality certifications like BIS, ISI, and Hallmark. The scheme reimburses 50% of certification fees and testing equipment costs up to ₹10,00,000 to promote quality and global competitiveness.
required_documents: Document of registration of the industrial undertaking
Documents related to legal possession of land with valid nonagriculture permission for industrial use
Copy of the possession letter (if plot or shed is in GIDC estate)

scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance to SHG for Job Work
summary: The Gujarat Textile Policy provides financial assistance to Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in textile job work to enhance financial stability and encourage women's participation. Eligible SHGs receive training and payroll assistance for female workers to strengthen the textile value chain and promote industrial activity.
required_documents: Document of registration of the industrial undertaking
Documents related to legal possession of land with valid nonagriculture permission for industrial use
Copy of the possession letter (if plot or shed is in GIDC estate)
